title: Locate-then-Sparsify: Attribution Guided Sparse Strategy for Visual Hallucination Mitigation
summary: Despite the significant advancements in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), their tendency to generate hallucinations undermines reliability and restricts broader practical deployment. Among the hallucination mitigation methods, feature steering emerges as a promising approach that reduces erroneous outputs in LVLMs without increasing inference costs. However, current methods apply uniform feature steering across all layers. This heuristic strategy ignores inter-layer differences, potentially disrupting layers unrelated to hallucinations and ultimately leading to performance degradation on general tasks. In this paper, we propose a plug-and-play framework called Locate-Then-Sparsify for Feature Steering (LTS-FS), which controls the steering intensity according to the hallucination relevance of each layer. We first construct a synthetic dataset comprising token-level and sentence-level hallucination cases. Based on this dataset, we introduce an attribution method based on causal interventions to quantify the hallucination relevance of each layer. With the attribution scores across layers, we propose a layerwise strategy that converts these scores into feature steering intensities for individual layers, enabling more precise adjustments specifically on hallucination-relevant layers. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that our LTS-FS framework effectively mitigates hallucination while preserving strong performance.

AI.title_translation: 定位然后稀疏化：归因引导的稀疏策略用于缓解视觉幻觉
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Locate-Then-Sparsify (LTS-FS) 的即插即用框架，通过量化每一层的幻觉相关性并据此调整特征引导强度，有效缓解大型视觉语言模型中的幻觉问题，同时保持良好性能。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的幻觉问题阻碍了其实际部署。现有的特征引导方法采用统一的跨层策略，忽视了层间差异，可能干扰非幻觉相关层，导致通用任务性能下降。因此，需要一种更精确的、基于层级幻觉相关性的特征引导策略。
AI.method: 本文提出了Locate-Then-Sparsify for Feature Steering (LTS-FS) 框架。首先，构建了一个包含token级和句子级幻觉情况的合成数据集。其次，引入了一种基于因果干预的归因方法来量化每一层的幻觉相关性。最后，提出了一种层级策略，将这些归因分数转换为针对每个单独层的特征引导强度，从而实现对幻觉相关层的精确调整。
AI.result: 在多个大型视觉语言模型和基准测试上进行的广泛实验表明，LTS-FS框架能够有效缓解幻觉，同时保持强大的性能。
AI.conclusion: LTS-FS框架通过根据层级幻觉相关性精确调整特征引导强度，提供了一种有效且不牺牲通用任务性能的视觉幻觉缓解策略。
AI.translation: 尽管大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）取得了显著进步，但它们产生幻觉的倾向损害了可靠性并限制了更广泛的实际部署。在幻觉缓解方法中，特征引导作为一种有前景的方法脱颖而出，它能够在不增加推理成本的情况下减少LVLMs中的错误输出。然而，当前的方法在所有层上应用统一的特征引导。这种启发式策略忽略了层间差异，可能扰乱与幻觉无关的层，并最终导致通用任务的性能下降。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为Locate-Then-Sparsify for Feature Steering (LTS-FS) 的即插即用框架，它根据每一层的幻觉相关性来控制引导强度。我们首先构建了一个包含token级和句子级幻觉情况的合成数据集。基于该数据集，我们引入了一种基于因果干预的归因方法来量化每一层的幻觉相关性。利用跨层的归因分数，我们提出了一种层级策略，将这些分数转换为针对每个单独层的特征引导强度，从而实现对幻觉相关层的更精确调整。在多个LVLMs和基准测试上进行的广泛实验表明，我们的LTS-FS框架能够有效缓解幻觉，同时保持强大的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Locate-Then-Sparsify for Feature Steering (LTS-FS) 的即插即用框架，旨在解决大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）中由于统一特征引导策略导致的幻觉缓解不足和性能下降问题。LTS-FS通过构建合成数据集、引入基于因果干预的归因方法来量化层级幻觉相关性，并基于此调整特征引导强度，从而实现对幻觉相关层的精确干预。实验证明，该框架能有效缓解幻觉并保持LVLMs的通用任务性能。
AI.keywords: 大型视觉语言模型, 幻觉缓解, 特征引导, 归因, 稀疏策略
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个层级感知的特征引导策略，通过归因方法精确识别与幻觉相关的层，并只对这些层进行稀疏化干预，避免了传统统一引导策略对无关层的性能影响。这种“定位然后稀疏化”的思想为LVLMs的可靠性提升提供了一个新颖且高效的解决方案，具有重要的实践意义和研究价值。

title: Persistent Story World Simulation with Continuous Character Customization
summary: Story visualization has gained increasing attention in computer vision. However, current methods often fail to achieve a synergy between accurate character customization, semantic alignment, and continuous integration of new identities. To tackle this challenge, in this paper we present EverTale, a story world simulator for continuous story character customization. We first propose an All-in-One-World Character Integrator to achieve continuous character adaptation within unified LoRA module, eliminating the need for per-character optimization modules of previous methods. Then, we incorporate a Character Quality Gate via MLLM-as-Judge to ensure the fidelity of each character adaptation process through chain-of-thought reasoning, determining whether the model can proceed to the next character or require additional training on the current one. We also introduce a Character-Aware Region-Focus Sampling strategy to address the identity degradation and layout conflicts in existing multi-character visual storytelling, ensuring natural multi-character generation by harmonizing local character-specific details with global scene context with higher efficiency. Experimental results show that our EverTale achieves superior performance against a wider range of compared methods on both single- and multi-character story visualization. Codes will be available.

AI.title_translation: 持续故事世界模拟与连续角色定制
AI.tldr: EverTale是一个故事世界模拟器，通过统一的LoRA模块、角色质量门和角色感知区域聚焦采样策略，实现了连续的角色定制和高质量的多角色故事可视化。
AI.motivation: 当前故事可视化方法在精确角色定制、语义对齐和新身份的连续集成方面存在协同不足的问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了EverTale，一个故事世界模拟器，用于连续故事角色定制。其方法包括：1. All-in-One-World Character Integrator：通过统一的LoRA模块实现连续角色适应，消除对每个角色独立优化模块的需求。2. Character Quality Gate：通过MLLM-as-Judge进行链式思考推理，确保角色适应过程的保真度，并判断是否进入下一角色或需额外训练。3. Character-Aware Region-Focus Sampling策略：解决多角色视觉故事讲述中的身份退化和布局冲突，通过协调局部角色细节与全局场景上下文实现高效自然的多角色生成。
AI.result: EverTale在单角色和多角色故事可视化方面，相对于更广泛的对比方法，取得了卓越的性能。
AI.conclusion: EverTale通过其创新方法有效解决了故事可视化中角色定制、语义对齐和连续集成的问题，并在实验中表现出优越性能。
AI.translation: 故事可视化在计算机视觉领域受到了越来越多的关注。然而，当前的方法往往无法在精确的角色定制、语义对齐和新身份的连续集成之间实现协同。为了解决这一挑战，本文提出了EverTale，一个用于连续故事角色定制的故事世界模拟器。我们首先提出了一个“一体化世界角色集成器”（All-in-One-World Character Integrator），通过统一的LoRA模块实现连续的角色适应，消除了以往方法中对每个角色单独优化模块的需求。然后，我们通过“MLLM-作为-判断器”（MLLM-as-Judge）引入了一个“角色质量门”（Character Quality Gate），通过思维链推理确保每个角色适应过程的保真度，判断模型是否可以进入下一个角色或需要对当前角色进行额外训练。我们还引入了一种“角色感知区域聚焦采样”（Character-Aware Region-Focus Sampling）策略，以解决现有多角色视觉故事讲述中的身份退化和布局冲突问题，通过以更高的效率协调局部角色特定细节与全局场景上下文来确保自然的多角色生成。实验结果表明，我们的EverTale在单角色和多角色故事可视化方面，相对于更广泛的对比方法，取得了卓越的性能。代码将可用。
AI.summary: 本文提出了EverTale，一个创新的故事世界模拟器，旨在解决现有故事可视化方法在角色定制、语义对齐和新身份连续集成方面的不足。EverTale通过引入一体化世界角色集成器（采用统一LoRA模块）、角色质量门（基于MLLM-as-Judge的保真度检查）和角色感知区域聚焦采样策略（解决多角色生成中的身份退化和布局冲突），实现了高效且高质量的连续角色定制和多角色故事可视化。实验证明，EverTale在单角色和多角色场景中均展现出卓越性能。
AI.keywords: 故事可视化, 角色定制, LoRA, MLLM, 多角色生成
AI.comments: 这项研究通过引入统一的LoRA模块、基于MLLM的质量控制和区域聚焦采样策略，在连续角色定制和多角色故事可视化方面取得了显著进展。其创新点在于将多个关键技术整合到一个框架中，有效解决了现有方法在效率和质量上的痛点，特别是在处理多角色交互和身份保持方面。

title: Surrogate-Assisted Genetic Programming with Rank-Based Phenotypic Characterisation for Dynamic Multi-Mode Project Scheduling
comments: 7 pages, 7 figures, accepted by IEEE Congress on Evolutionary Computation 2026. This is the version submitted for peer review. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary:
The dynamic multi-mode resource-constrained project scheduling problem (DMRCPSP) is of practical importance, as it requires making real-time decisions under changing project states and resource availability. Genetic Programming (GP) has been shown to effectively evolve heuristic rules for such decision-making tasks; however, the evolutionary process typically relies on a large number of simulation-based fitness evaluations, resulting in high computational cost. Surrogate models offer a promising solution to reduce evaluation cost, but their application to GP requires problem-specific phenotypic characterisation (PC) schemes of heuristic rules. There is currently a lack of suitable PC schemes for GP applied to DMRCPSP.
  This paper proposes a rank-based PC scheme derived from heuristic-driven ordering of eligible activity-mode pairs and activity groups in decision situations. The resulting PC vectors enable a surrogate model to estimate the fitness of unevaluated GP individuals. Based on this scheme, a surrogate-assisted GP algorithm is developed. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed surrogate-assisted GP can identify high-quality heuristic rules consistently earlier than the state-of-the-art GP approach for DMRCPSP, while introducing only marginal computational overhead. Further analyses demonstrate that the surrogate model provides useful guidance for offspring selection, leading to improved evolutionary efficiency.

AI.title_translation: 代理辅助遗传编程结合基于排序的表型特征化用于动态多模式项目调度
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于排序的表型特征化方案，并开发了一种代理辅助遗传编程算法，用于动态多模式资源受限项目调度问题，显著提高了进化效率并减少了计算成本。
AI.motivation: 动态多模式资源受限项目调度问题 (DMRCPSP) 具有重要的实际意义，但传统的遗传编程 (GP) 算法依赖大量模拟评估，导致计算成本高昂。代理模型可以降低评估成本，但它们在GP中的应用需要针对特定问题的表型特征化 (PC) 方案，而DMRCPSP目前缺乏合适的PC方案。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种基于排序的PC方案，该方案源自决策情境中符合条件的活动-模式对和活动组的启发式排序。由此产生的PC向量使代理模型能够估计未评估GP个体的适应度。基于此方案，开发了一种代理辅助GP算法。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的代理辅助GP算法能够比最先进的DMRCPSP GP方法更早地识别高质量的启发式规则，且只引入了微小的计算开销。进一步分析表明，代理模型为后代选择提供了有益的指导，从而提高了进化效率。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的代理辅助遗传编程方法通过引入基于排序的表型特征化方案和代理模型，有效解决了DMRCPSP中遗传编程的计算成本问题，显著提高了发现高质量启发式规则的效率。
AI.translation:
动态多模式资源受限项目调度问题（DMRCPSP）具有重要的实际意义，因为它需要在不断变化的项目状态和资源可用性下做出实时决策。遗传编程（GP）已被证明可以有效地进化出用于此类决策任务的启发式规则；然而，进化过程通常依赖于大量的基于模拟的适应度评估，导致计算成本高昂。代理模型为降低评估成本提供了一个有前景的解决方案，但它们在GP中的应用需要针对特定问题的启发式规则表型特征化（PC）方案。目前，DMRCPSP中GP应用缺乏合适的PC方案。
本文提出了一种基于排序的PC方案，该方案源自决策情境中符合条件的活动-模式对和活动组的启发式排序。由此产生的PC向量使代理模型能够估计未评估GP个体的适应度。基于此方案，开发了一种代理辅助GP算法。实验结果表明，所提出的代理辅助GP能够比最先进的DMRCPSP GP方法更早地识别高质量的启发式规则，同时只引入了微小的计算开销。进一步分析表明，代理模型为后代选择提供了有益的指导，从而提高了进化效率。
AI.summary: 本文针对动态多模式资源受限项目调度问题（DMRCPSP）中遗传编程（GP）计算成本高的问题，提出了一种基于排序的表型特征化（PC）方案。该方案通过将启发式规则转换为PC向量，使代理模型能够有效预测GP个体的适应度。在此基础上，开发了一种代理辅助GP算法，实验证明该算法能以较低的计算开销，比现有技术更早地发现高质量的启发式规则，并有效提高了进化效率。
AI.keywords: 动态多模式项目调度, 遗传编程, 代理模型, 表型特征化, 启发式规则
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个针对DMRCPSP中GP的基于排序的表型特征化方案，有效地将启发式规则映射到可供代理模型使用的特征向量，从而成功地将代理模型集成到遗传编程中，显著降低了计算成本并提高了搜索效率。这对于解决实际中复杂的动态调度问题具有重要意义。

title: VisBrowse-Bench: Benchmarking Visual-Native Search for Multimodal Browsing Agents
summary: The rapid advancement of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has enabled browsing agents to acquire and reason over multimodal information in the real world. But existing benchmarks suffer from two limitations: insufficient evaluation of visual reasoning ability and the neglect of native visual information of web pages in the reasoning chains. To address these challenges, we introduce a new benchmark for visual-native search, VisBrowse-Bench. It contains 169 VQA instances covering multiple domains and evaluates the models' visual reasoning capabilities during the search process through multimodal evidence cross-validation via text-image retrieval and joint reasoning. These data were constructed by human experts using a multi-stage pipeline and underwent rigorous manual verification. We additionally propose an agent workflow that can effectively drive the browsing agent to actively collect and reason over visual information during the search process. We comprehensively evaluated both open-source and closed-source models in this workflow. Experimental results show that even the best-performing model, Claude-4.6-Opus only achieves an accuracy of 47.6%, while the proprietary Deep Research model, o3-deep-research only achieves an accuracy of 41.1%. The code and data can be accessed at: https://github.com/ZhengboZhang/VisBrowse-Bench

AI.title_translation: VisBrowse-Bench：多模态浏览代理的视觉原生搜索基准测试
AI.tldr: 本文提出了VisBrowse-Bench，一个用于评估多模态浏览代理在视觉原生搜索中视觉推理能力的新基准，并发现现有模型在该任务上表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 现有基准在评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）驱动的浏览代理时存在两个局限性：一是视觉推理能力评估不足，二是忽略了网页中原生的视觉信息在推理链中的作用。
AI.method: 本文引入了VisBrowse-Bench基准，包含169个VQA实例，涵盖多个领域。它通过文本-图像检索和联合推理进行多模态证据交叉验证，评估模型在搜索过程中的视觉推理能力。数据由人类专家通过多阶段流程构建并经过严格手动验证。此外，还提出了一种代理工作流，以驱动浏览代理在搜索过程中主动收集和推理视觉信息。
AI.result: 在提出的工作流中，对开源和闭源模型进行了全面评估。结果显示，即使是表现最好的模型Claude-4.6-Opus也仅达到47.6%的准确率，而专有的Deep Research模型o3-deep-research仅达到41.1%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 即使是当前最先进的多模态模型，在视觉原生搜索任务中的视觉推理能力也远未达到理想水平，表明该领域仍有很大的改进空间。
AI.translation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的快速发展使得浏览代理能够获取并推理真实世界中的多模态信息。但现有基准存在两个局限性：一是视觉推理能力评估不足，二是忽略了网页中原生的视觉信息在推理链中的作用。为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了一个新的视觉原生搜索基准——VisBrowse-Bench。它包含169个VQA实例，涵盖多个领域，并通过文本-图像检索和联合推理进行多模态证据交叉验证，评估模型在搜索过程中视觉推理能力。这些数据由人类专家通过多阶段流程构建并经过严格手动验证。我们还提出了一种代理工作流，可以有效地驱动浏览代理在搜索过程中主动收集和推理视觉信息。我们在此工作流中全面评估了开源和闭源模型。实验结果表明，即使是表现最好的模型Claude-4.6-Opus也仅达到47.6%的准确率，而专有的Deep Research模型o3-deep-research仅达到41.1%的准确率。代码和数据可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/ZhengboZhang/VisBrowse-Bench
AI.summary: 本文针对现有基准在评估多模态浏览代理时对视觉推理能力和原生视觉信息关注不足的问题，提出了VisBrowse-Bench基准。该基准包含169个专家构建的VQA实例，旨在通过多模态证据交叉验证来评估模型的视觉推理能力。同时，提出了一种代理工作流以促进视觉信息的收集和推理。实验结果显示，当前最先进的模型（如Claude-4.6-Opus）在该基准上的准确率不足50%，凸显了多模态浏览代理在视觉原生搜索方面仍面临巨大挑战。
AI.keywords: 多模态浏览代理, 视觉原生搜索, 基准测试, 视觉问答, MLLMs
AI.comments: VisBrowse-Bench的创新点在于它明确关注了多模态浏览代理的“视觉原生搜索”能力，强调了网页中视觉信息的重要性，并设计了专门的VQA任务和工作流来评估这一能力。这对于推动MLLMs在真实世界场景中的应用具有重要意义，因为它揭示了现有模型在理解和利用视觉信息方面的显著不足。该基准的提出将有助于指导未来研究，开发更强大的多模态代理。

title: Jin-Xin relaxation as a shock-capturing method for high-order DG/FR schemes
summary: Jin-Xin relaxation is a method for approximating non-linear hyperbolic conservation laws by a linear system of hyperbolic equations with an $\varepsilon$ dependent stiff source term. The system formally relaxes to the original conservation law as $\varepsilon \to 0$. An asymptotic analysis of the Jin-Xin relaxation system shows that it can be seen as a convection-diffusion equation with a diffusion coefficient that depends on the relaxation parameter $\varepsilon$. This work makes use of this property to use the Jin-Xin relaxation system as a shock-capturing method for high-order discontinuous Galerkin (DG) or flux reconstruction (FR) schemes. The idea is to use a smoothness indicator to choose the $\varepsilon$ value in each cell, so that we can use larger $\varepsilon$ values in non-smooth regions to add extra numerical dissipation. We show how this can be done by using a single stage method by using the compact Runge-Kutta FR method that handles the stiff source term by using IMplicit-EXplicit Runge-Kutta (IMEX-RK) schemes. Numerical results involving Burgers' equation and the compressible Euler equations are shown to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.title_translation: 金-鑫弛豫作为高阶DG/FR格式的激波捕捉方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用金-鑫弛豫系统作为高阶DG/FR格式的激波捕捉方法，通过局部调整弛豫参数来增加非光滑区域的数值耗散。
AI.motivation: 在高阶DG/FR格式中，需要一种有效的激波捕捉方法来处理非光滑区域，而金-鑫弛豫系统具有可作为对流-扩散方程的特性，其扩散系数可调，因此可用于增加数值耗散。
AI.method: 利用光滑性指示器在每个网格单元中选择弛豫参数$\varepsilon$的值。在非光滑区域使用较大的$\varepsilon$值以增加额外的数值耗散。通过使用紧凑的Runge-Kutta FR方法和IMEX-RK方案处理刚性源项，实现了一个单阶段方法。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，该方法在Burgers方程和可压缩欧拉方程中均有效。
AI.conclusion: 金-鑫弛豫系统可以有效地作为高阶DG/FR格式的激波捕捉方法，通过局部调整弛豫参数来增加非光滑区域的数值耗散。
AI.translation: 金-鑫弛豫是一种通过具有$\varepsilon$依赖的刚性源项的线性双曲方程组来近似非线性双曲守恒律的方法。当$\varepsilon \to 0$时，该系统形式上弛豫到原始守恒律。对金-鑫弛豫系统的渐近分析表明，它可以被看作是一个对流-扩散方程，其扩散系数取决于弛豫参数$\varepsilon$。这项工作利用这一特性，将金-鑫弛豫系统用作高阶不连续伽辽金(DG)或通量重构(FR)格式的激波捕捉方法。其思想是使用光滑性指示器来选择每个单元中的$\varepsilon$值，从而在非光滑区域使用较大的$\varepsilon$值来增加额外的数值耗散。我们展示了如何通过使用紧凑的Runge-Kutta FR方法，并利用隐式-显式Runge-Kutta (IMEX-RK)方案处理刚性源项，通过单阶段方法实现这一点。涉及Burgers方程和可压缩欧拉方程的数值结果表明了所提出方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种将金-鑫弛豫系统作为高阶不连续伽辽金(DG)或通量重构(FR)格式激波捕捉方法的新策略。通过渐近分析，金-鑫弛豫系统被视为一个扩散系数依赖于弛豫参数$\varepsilon$的对流-扩散方程。该方法利用光滑性指示器在非光滑区域选择较大的$\varepsilon$值以增加数值耗散，并通过结合紧凑Runge-Kutta FR方法和IMEX-RK方案来实现。数值实验验证了该方法在Burgers方程和可压缩欧拉方程中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 金-鑫弛豫, 激波捕捉, DG格式, FR格式, 数值耗散
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将金-鑫弛豫系统作为一种可调的数值耗散机制引入到高阶DG/FR格式中，通过局部调整弛豫参数实现激波捕捉。这种方法提供了一种灵活且有效的处理非光滑解的途径，对于提高高阶方法的鲁棒性具有重要意义。结合IMEX-RK处理刚性源项是实现这一策略的关键。

title: Attention-guided Evidence Grounding for Spoken Question Answering
summary: Spoken Question Answering (Spoken QA) presents a challenging cross-modal problem: effectively aligning acoustic queries with textual knowledge while avoiding the latency and error propagation inherent in cascaded ASR-based systems. In this paper, we introduce Attention-guided Evidence Grounding (AEG), a novel end-to-end framework that leverages the internal cross-modal attention of Speech Large Language Models (SpeechLLMs) to explicitly locate and ground key evidence in the model's latent space. To address the diffuse attention distribution in pre-trained models, we propose Learning to Focus on Evidence (LFE), a supervised fine-tuning paradigm that calibrates the model's attention mechanism to distinguish query-relevant segments from irrelevant context. Experiments on SQuAD, HotpotQA, and MuSiQue demonstrate that AEG reduces hallucinations and achieves strong efficiency gains, outperforming large-scale cascaded baselines (Whisper-Large-v3 + Reranker) while reducing inference latency by approximately 62%.

AI.title_translation: 基于注意力引导的证据定位的口语问答
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为AEG的新型端到端框架，利用SpeechLLM的跨模态注意力来定位口语问答中的关键证据，并通过LFE微调来提高注意力聚焦能力，从而减少幻觉并提高效率，推理延迟降低了约62%。
AI.motivation: 解决口语问答中跨模态匹配的挑战，并避免基于ASR的级联系统的延迟和错误传播问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为Attention-guided Evidence Grounding (AEG) 的端到端框架，该框架利用SpeechLLM的内部跨模态注意力来定位和连接模型潜在空间中的关键证据。为了解决预训练模型中注意力分布分散的问题，提出了一种名为Learning to Focus on Evidence (LFE) 的监督微调方法，以校准模型的注意力机制。
AI.result: AEG框架减少了幻觉，实现了显著的效率提升，并且在推理延迟方面比大型级联基线（Whisper-Large-v3 + Reranker）降低了约62%。
AI.conclusion: AEG框架通过利用SpeechLLM的注意力机制，能够有效地在口语问答中定位证据，减少幻觉，并提高效率，为解决口语问答的挑战提供了一种新的途径。
AI.translation: 口语问答（Spoken QA）提出了一个具有挑战性的跨模态问题：在避免级联ASR系统固有的延迟和错误传播的同时，有效地将声学查询与文本知识进行匹配。在本研究中，我们介绍了一种名为Attention-guided Evidence Grounding (AEG) 的新型端到端框架，该框架利用SpeechLLM的内部跨模态注意力来显式地定位和连接模型潜在空间中的关键证据。为了解决预训练模型中注意力分布分散的问题，我们提出了一种名为Learning to Focus on Evidence (LFE) 的监督微调范式，以校准模型的注意力机制，区分与查询相关的片段和不相关的上下文。在SQuAD、HotpotQA和MuSiQue上的实验表明，AEG减少了幻觉，并实现了显著的效率提升，其性能优于大型级联基线（Whisper-Large-v3 + Reranker），同时推理延迟降低了约62%。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为AEG的端到端框架，用于解决口语问答中的跨模态匹配问题。AEG利用SpeechLLM的跨模态注意力来定位关键证据，并通过LFE微调来优化注意力聚焦。实验结果表明，AEG能够有效减少幻觉，提高效率，并显著降低推理延迟。
AI.keywords: 口语问答, 证据定位, 跨模态注意力, 端到端框架, SpeechLLM
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的AEG框架，通过利用SpeechLLM的内部注意力机制来解决口语问答中的证据定位问题，避免了传统级联方法的缺点。LFE微调方法的引入进一步增强了模型的聚焦能力。该方法在减少幻觉和提高效率方面取得了显著成果，尤其是在推理延迟方面的改进具有重要意义。然而，对于AEG框架在更广泛的口语理解任务中的泛化能力以及对不同类型语音输入（如嘈杂环境）的鲁棒性还需要进一步的研究。

title: PyPhonPlan: Simulating phonetic planning with dynamic neural fields and task dynamics
summary: We introduce PyPhonPlan, a Python toolkit for implementing dynamical models of phonetic planning using coupled dynamic neural fields and task dynamic simulations. The toolkit provides modular components for defining planning, perception and memory fields, as well as between-field coupling, gestural inputs, and using field activation profiles to solve tract variable trajectories. We illustrate the toolkit's capabilities through an example application:~simulating production/perception loops with a coupled memory field, which demonstrates the framework's ability to model interactive speech dynamics using representations that are temporally-principled, neurally-grounded, and phonetically-rich. PyPhonPlan is released as open-source software and contains executable examples to promote reproducibility, extensibility, and cumulative computational development for speech communication research.

AI.title_translation: PyPhonPlan：使用动态神经场和任务动力学模拟语音规划
AI.tldr: PyPhonPlan是一个Python工具包，用于通过耦合动态神经场和任务动态模拟来实现语音规划的动态模型，支持规划、感知和记忆场，并能模拟交互式语音动力学。它是一个开源软件，旨在促进语音通信研究的再现性、可扩展性和累积计算发展。
AI.motivation: 该研究的动机是为语音规划的动态模型提供一个模块化、开源的Python工具包，以促进语音通信研究的计算发展，并支持使用动态神经场和任务动力学进行模拟。
AI.method: 本文介绍了一个名为PyPhonPlan的Python工具包。该工具包通过耦合动态神经场和任务动态模拟来实现语音规划的动态模型。它提供模块化组件，用于定义规划、感知和记忆场、场间耦合、姿态输入，并利用场激活配置文件解决声道变量轨迹。通过一个模拟生产/感知循环的示例应用来演示其功能。
AI.result: PyPhonPlan工具包通过一个耦合记忆场的生产/感知循环模拟示例，展示了其建模交互式语音动力学的能力。这些模型使用时间原理化、神经接地和语音丰富的表示。该工具包作为开源软件发布，包含可执行示例。
AI.conclusion: PyPhonPlan工具包为语音规划的动态模型提供了一个开源、模块化、可扩展的平台，旨在促进语音通信研究的再现性、可扩展性和累积计算发展。它能够使用时间原理化、神经接地和语音丰富的表示来建模交互式语音动力学。
AI.translation: 我们引入了PyPhonPlan，这是一个Python工具包，用于使用耦合动态神经场和任务动态模拟来实现语音规划的动态模型。该工具包提供模块化组件，用于定义规划、感知和记忆场，以及场间耦合、姿态输入，并利用场激活配置文件来解决声道变量轨迹。我们通过一个示例应用展示了该工具包的功能：模拟与耦合记忆场的生产/感知循环，这证明了该框架能够使用时间原理化、神经接地和语音丰富的表示来建模交互式语音动力学。PyPhonPlan作为开源软件发布，包含可执行示例，以促进语音通信研究的再现性、可扩展性和累积计算发展。
AI.summary: PyPhonPlan是一个新颖的Python工具包，旨在通过结合动态神经场和任务动力学来模拟语音规划过程。它提供模块化组件以构建规划、感知和记忆模型，并能模拟复杂的交互式语音动力学。该工具包是开源的，并附带示例，旨在推动语音通信研究的计算进步和可重复性。
AI.keywords: PyPhonPlan, 语音规划, 动态神经场, 任务动力学, 语音通信
AI.comments: PyPhonPlan的创新在于提供了一个开源、模块化的Python工具包，将动态神经场和任务动力学相结合，用于模拟语音规划。这为研究人员提供了一个灵活的平台，能够构建和测试复杂的交互式语音动力学模型，其对可重复性和可扩展性的强调对于推进计算语音研究至关重要。其神经接地和语音丰富的表示方法也增强了模型的理论深度和实用性。

title: OGScene3D: Incremental Open-Vocabulary 3D Gaussian Scene Graph Mapping for Scene Understanding
summary: Open-vocabulary scene understanding is crucial for robotic applications, enabling robots to comprehend complex 3D environmental contexts and supporting various downstream tasks such as navigation and manipulation. However, existing methods require pre-built complete 3D semantic maps to construct scene graphs for scene understanding, which limits their applicability in robotic scenarios where environments are explored incrementally. To address this challenge, we propose OGScene3D, an open-vocabulary scene understanding system that achieves accurate 3D semantic mapping and scene graph construction incrementally. Our system employs a confidence-based Gaussian semantic representation that jointly models semantic predictions and their reliability, enabling robust scene modeling. Building on this representation, we introduce a hierarchical 3D semantic optimization strategy that achieves semantic consistency through local correspondence establishment and global refinement, thereby constructing globally consistent semantic maps. Moreover, we design a long-term global optimization method that leverages temporal memory of historical observations to enhance semantic predictions. By integrating 2D-3D semantic consistency with Gaussian rendering contribution, this method continuously refines the semantic understanding of the entire scene.Furthermore, we develop a progressive graph construction approach that dynamically creates and updates both nodes and semantic relationships, allowing continuous updating of the 3D scene graphs. Extensive experiments on widely used datasets and real-world scenes demonstrate the effectiveness of our OGScene3D on open-vocabulary scene understanding.

AI.title_translation: OGScene3D：用于场景理解的增量式开放词汇3D高斯场景图映射
AI.tldr: OGScene3D是一个增量式开放词汇3D场景理解系统，通过置信度高斯语义表示、分层3D语义优化和渐进式图构建，实现准确的3D语义映射和场景图构建，解决了现有方法需要预构建完整地图的限制。
AI.motivation: 现有方法需要预先构建完整的3D语义地图来构建场景图以进行场景理解，这限制了它们在环境被增量探索的机器人场景中的适用性。
AI.method: 本文提出了OGScene3D系统，该系统包含：1. 基于置信度的高斯语义表示，用于联合建模语义预测及其可靠性，实现鲁棒的场景建模。2. 分层3D语义优化策略，通过局部对应建立和全局细化实现语义一致性，从而构建全局一致的语义地图。3. 长期全局优化方法，利用历史观测的时间记忆增强语义预测，并整合2D-3D语义一致性与高斯渲染贡献，持续细化整个场景的语义理解。4. 渐进式图构建方法，动态创建和更新节点和语义关系，实现3D场景图的持续更新。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的数据集和真实世界场景上的大量实验证明了OGScene3D在开放词汇场景理解方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: OGScene3D通过其增量式开放词汇3D场景图映射方法，有效解决了现有方法对预构建完整地图的局限性，实现了鲁棒且一致的场景理解，在机器人应用中具有重要意义。
AI.translation: 开放词汇场景理解对于机器人应用至关重要，它使机器人能够理解复杂的3D环境背景，并支持导航和操作等各种下游任务。然而，现有方法需要预先构建完整的3D语义地图来构建场景图以进行场景理解，这限制了它们在环境被增量探索的机器人场景中的适用性。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了OGScene3D，一个开放词汇场景理解系统，它能够增量地实现准确的3D语义映射和场景图构建。我们的系统采用基于置信度的高斯语义表示，共同建模语义预测及其可靠性，从而实现鲁棒的场景建模。在此表示的基础上，我们引入了一种分层3D语义优化策略，通过局部对应建立和全局细化实现语义一致性，从而构建全局一致的语义地图。此外，我们设计了一种长期全局优化方法，利用历史观测的时间记忆来增强语义预测。通过将2D-3D语义一致性与高斯渲染贡献相结合，该方法持续细化整个场景的语义理解。此外，我们开发了一种渐进式图构建方法，动态创建和更新节点和语义关系，从而实现3D场景图的持续更新。在广泛使用的数据集和真实世界场景上的大量实验证明了我们的OGScene3D在开放词汇场景理解方面的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了OGScene3D，一个用于增量式开放词汇3D场景理解的系统。它解决了现有方法需要预构建完整3D语义地图的局限性。OGScene3D通过基于置信度的高斯语义表示实现鲁棒建模，采用分层3D语义优化构建全局一致的语义地图，并利用长期全局优化增强语义预测。此外，它还设计了渐进式图构建方法以动态更新3D场景图。实验证明了其在开放词汇场景理解方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 开放词汇, 3D场景图, 增量式映射, 高斯语义, 场景理解
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个能够增量构建开放词汇3D场景图的系统，解决了传统方法对完整预构建地图的依赖。通过结合置信度高斯表示、分层语义优化和渐进式图构建，提高了在动态探索环境中机器人场景理解的实用性，对机器人导航和操作等下游任务具有重要意义。

title: Micro-AU CLIP: Fine-Grained Contrastive Learning from Local Independence to Global Dependency for Micro-Expression Action Unit Detection
summary: Micro-expression (ME) action units (Micro-AUs) provide objective clues for fine-grained genuine emotion analysis. Most existing Micro-AU detection methods learn AU features from the whole facial image/video, which conflicts with the inherent locality of AU, resulting in insufficient perception of AU regions. In fact, each AU independently corresponds to specific localized facial muscle movements (local independence), while there is an inherent dependency between some AUs under specific emotional states (global dependency). Thus, this paper explores the effectiveness of the independence-to-dependency pattern and proposes a novel micro-AU detection framework, micro-AU CLIP, that uniquely decomposes the AU detection process into local semantic independence modeling (LSI) and global semantic dependency (GSD) modeling. In LSI, Patch Token Attention (PTA) is designed, mapping several local features within the AU region to the same feature space; In GSD, Global Dependency Attention (GDA) and Global Dependency Loss (GDLoss) are presented to model the global dependency relationships between different AUs, thereby enhancing each AU feature. Furthermore, considering CLIP's native limitations in micro-semantic alignment, a microAU contrastive loss (MiAUCL) is designed to learn AU features by a fine-grained alignment of visual and text features. Also, Micro-AU CLIP is effectively applied to ME recognition in an emotion-label-free way. The experimental results demonstrate that Micro-AU CLIP can fully learn fine-grained micro-AU features, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

AI.title_translation: Micro-AU CLIP：从局部独立到全局依赖的细粒度对比学习用于微表情动作单元检测
AI.tldr: 提出Micro-AU CLIP框架，通过局部独立建模和全局依赖建模，结合细粒度对比学习，显著提升微表情动作单元检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有微表情动作单元（Micro-AU）检测方法从整张人脸图像/视频中学习AU特征，这与AU固有的局部性相冲突，导致对AU区域的感知不足。而AU既有局部独立性（每个AU对应局部肌肉运动），又存在全局依赖性（AU间在特定情感下有依赖关系）。
AI.method: 论文提出了Micro-AU CLIP框架，将AU检测分解为局部语义独立性建模（LSI）和全局语义依赖性建模（GSD）。在LSI中，设计了Patch Token Attention (PTA) 来将AU区域内的局部特征映射到同一特征空间。在GSD中，提出了Global Dependency Attention (GDA) 和Global Dependency Loss (GDLoss) 来建模不同AU之间的全局依赖关系，从而增强AU特征。此外，为了解决CLIP在微语义对齐方面的局限性，设计了microAU对比损失（MiAUCL）以通过视觉和文本特征的细粒度对齐来学习AU特征。
AI.result: Micro-AU CLIP能够充分学习细粒度的微表情动作单元特征，并实现了最先进的性能。它还可以有效地应用于无情感标签的微表情识别。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的Micro-AU CLIP框架通过结合局部独立性建模和全局依赖性建模，并引入细粒度的对比学习机制，有效地解决了现有微表情动作单元检测方法的局限性，实现了对微表情动作单元的精确感知和检测，并达到了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 微表情（ME）动作单元（Micro-AUs）为细粒度真实情感分析提供了客观线索。大多数现有的Micro-AU检测方法从整个人脸图像/视频中学习AU特征，这与AU固有的局部性相冲突，导致对AU区域的感知不足。事实上，每个AU独立对应特定的局部面部肌肉运动（局部独立性），而在特定情感状态下，一些AU之间存在固有的依赖关系（全局依赖性）。因此，本文探讨了从独立到依赖模式的有效性，并提出了一种新颖的微表情动作单元检测框架Micro-AU CLIP，它独特地将AU检测过程分解为局部语义独立性建模（LSI）和全局语义依赖性建模（GSD）。在LSI中，设计了Patch Token Attention (PTA)，将AU区域内的几个局部特征映射到相同的特征空间；在GSD中，提出了Global Dependency Attention (GDA) 和Global Dependency Loss (GDLoss) 来建模不同AU之间的全局依赖关系，从而增强每个AU特征。此外，考虑到CLIP在微语义对齐方面的固有局限性，设计了microAU对比损失（MiAUCL）以通过视觉和文本特征的细粒度对齐来学习AU特征。同时，Micro-AU CLIP被有效地应用于无情感标签的微表情识别。实验结果表明，Micro-AU CLIP能够充分学习细粒度的微表情动作单元特征，实现了最先进的性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有微表情动作单元（Micro-AU）检测方法忽略AU局部性和AU间依赖性的问题，提出了一种新颖的Micro-AU CLIP框架。该框架将AU检测分解为局部语义独立性建模（LSI）和全局语义依赖性建模（GSD），分别通过Patch Token Attention和Global Dependency Attention/Loss来处理。此外，引入microAU对比损失（MiAUCL）以实现视觉和文本特征的细粒度对齐。实验证明，Micro-AU CLIP能有效学习细粒度Micro-AU特征，并达到SOTA性能，还可应用于无情感标签的微表情识别。
AI.keywords: 微表情动作单元检测, 对比学习, 局部独立性, 全局依赖性, CLIP
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于其独特的“从局部独立到全局依赖”的建模范式，这很好地契合了微表情动作单元的生理学特性。通过将检测过程分解并引入专门的注意力机制和损失函数，有效地解决了现有方法感知不足的问题。此外，将CLIP模型进行细粒度微语义对齐的改进，并将其应用于无情感标签的微表情识别，也展现了其方法的通用性和潜力。该研究为微表情分析领域提供了新的视角和高性能的解决方案。

title: Toward Deep Representation Learning for Event-Enhanced Visual Autonomous Perception: the eAP Dataset
summary: Recent visual autonomous perception systems achieve remarkable performances with deep representation learning. However, they fail in scenarios with challenging illumination.While event cameras can mitigate this problem, there is a lack of a large-scale dataset to develop event-enhanced deep visual perception models in autonomous driving scenes. To address the gap, we present the eAP (event-enhanced Autonomous Perception) dataset, the largest dataset with event cameras for autonomous perception. We demonstrate how eAP can facilitate the study of different autonomous perception tasks, including 3D vehicle detection and object time-to-contact (TTC) estimation, through deep representation learning. Based on eAP, we demonstrate the ffrst successful use of events to improve a popular 3D vehicle detection network in challenging illumination scenarios. eAP also enables a devoted study of the representation learning problem of object TTC estimation. We show how a geometryaware representation learning framework leads to the best eventbased object TTC estimation network that operates at 200 FPS. The dataset, code, and pre-trained models will be made publicly available for future research.

AI.title_translation: 迈向事件增强视觉自主感知的深度表示学习：eAP数据集
AI.tldr: eAP是一个新的大规模事件相机数据集，用于在挑战性光照下改进自动驾驶场景中的视觉感知，例如3D车辆检测和物体接触时间估计。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉自主感知系统在挑战性光照下表现不佳。尽管事件相机可以缓解此问题，但目前缺乏一个大规模数据集来开发自动驾驶场景中事件增强的深度视觉感知模型。
AI.method: 本文提出了eAP（事件增强自主感知）数据集，这是用于自主感知的最大事件相机数据集。研究人员通过深度表示学习，利用eAP数据集促进了3D车辆检测和物体接触时间（TTC）估计等自主感知任务的研究。
AI.result: 基于eAP数据集，首次成功利用事件信息改进了在挑战性光照场景下的流行3D车辆检测网络。eAP还支持对物体接触时间估计的表示学习问题进行专门研究，并展示了几何感知表示学习框架如何实现最佳的事件基物体接触时间估计网络，该网络能以200 FPS运行。
AI.conclusion: eAP数据集的引入及其在3D车辆检测和物体接触时间估计任务中的应用，证明了事件相机在挑战性光照条件下增强自主感知系统的潜力，并为未来的研究提供了资源。
AI.translation: 最近的视觉自主感知系统通过深度表示学习取得了显著的性能。然而，它们在具有挑战性光照的场景中表现不佳。虽然事件相机可以缓解这个问题，但目前缺乏一个大规模数据集来开发自动驾驶场景中事件增强的深度视觉感知模型。为了弥补这一空白，我们提出了eAP（事件增强自主感知）数据集，这是用于自主感知的最大事件相机数据集。我们展示了eAP如何通过深度表示学习促进不同自主感知任务的研究，包括3D车辆检测和物体接触时间（TTC）估计。基于eAP，我们展示了首次成功利用事件来改进在挑战性光照场景下的流行3D车辆检测网络。eAP还使得对物体接触时间估计的表示学习问题进行了专门研究。我们展示了几何感知表示学习框架如何实现最佳的事件基物体接触时间估计网络，该网络能以200 FPS运行。数据集、代码和预训练模型将公开发布以供未来研究。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有视觉自主感知系统在挑战性光照条件下性能受限的问题，提出了eAP（事件增强自主感知）数据集。该数据集是目前最大规模的事件相机数据集，旨在促进自动驾驶领域事件增强深度视觉感知模型的发展。研究利用eAP数据集在3D车辆检测和物体接触时间（TTC）估计任务中取得了显著进展，包括首次成功利用事件改进了在恶劣光照下的3D车辆检测网络，并开发出高效的事件基TTC估计网络。eAP数据集、代码和预训练模型将公开，以支持未来的研究。
AI.keywords: 事件相机, 自主感知, 深度表示学习, eAP数据集, 3D车辆检测
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于构建并发布了迄今为止最大的事件相机数据集eAP，专门用于自主感知，有效弥补了该领域大规模数据集的空白。通过实验证明，利用事件数据能够显著提升传统视觉感知系统在挑战性光照条件下的性能，特别是在3D车辆检测和物体接触时间估计方面，展现了事件相机在未来自动驾驶中的巨大潜力。数据集和相关资源的公开将极大地推动该领域的研究进展。

title: DriveFix: Spatio-Temporally Coherent Driving Scene Restoration
summary: Recent advancements in 4D scene reconstruction, particularly those leveraging diffusion priors, have shown promise for novel view synthesis in autonomous driving. However, these methods often process frames independently or in a view-by-view manner, leading to a critical lack of spatio-temporal synergy. This results in spatial misalignment across cameras and temporal drift in sequences. We propose DriveFix, a novel multi-view restoration framework that ensures spatio-temporal coherence for driving scenes. Our approach employs an interleaved diffusion transformer architecture with specialized blocks to explicitly model both temporal dependencies and cross-camera spatial consistency. By conditioning the generation on historical context and integrating geometry-aware training losses, DriveFix enforces that the restored views adhere to a unified 3D geometry. This enables the consistent propagation of high-fidelity textures and significantly reduces artifacts. Extensive evaluations on the Waymo, nuScenes, and PandaSet datasets demonstrate that DriveFix achieves state-of-the-art performance in both reconstruction and novel view synthesis, marking a substantial step toward robust 4D world modeling for real-world deployment.

AI.title_translation: DriveFix：时空一致的驾驶场景恢复
AI.tldr: DriveFix是一个新的框架，使用交错的扩散Transformer来修复4D驾驶场景，确保修复后的图像在时间和空间上保持一致，解决了现有方法中的错位和漂移问题，并在基准测试中取得了SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 现有的4D场景重建方法（特别是基于扩散先验的方法）通常独立处理帧或按视角处理，导致跨摄像头的空间错位和序列中的时间漂移，这表明它们缺乏时空协同性。
AI.method: DriveFix采用了一种交错的扩散Transformer架构，其中包含专门的模块来明确建模时间依赖性和跨摄像头空间一致性。它通过以历史上下文为条件进行生成，并整合了几何感知的训练损失，以确保恢复的视图遵循统一的3D几何。
AI.result: DriveFix通过强制恢复的视图遵守统一的3D几何，实现了高保真纹理的一致传播，并显著减少了伪影。在Waymo、nuScenes和PandaSet数据集上的评估显示，DriveFix在重建和新视角合成方面均达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: DriveFix在Waymo、nuScenes和PandaSet数据集上的广泛评估表明，它在重建和新视角合成方面取得了最先进的性能，标志着在实现稳健的4D世界模型以用于实际部署方面迈出了重要一步。
AI.translation: 最近，4D场景重建方面的进展，特别是利用扩散先验的方法，在自动驾驶中的新视角合成方面显示出潜力。然而，这些方法通常独立处理帧或按视角处理，导致关键的时空协同性缺失。这导致了跨摄像头的空间错位和序列中的时间漂移。我们提出了DriveFix，一个确保驾驶场景时空一致性的新颖多视图恢复框架。我们的方法采用了一种交错的扩散Transformer架构，带有专门的模块来明确建模时间依赖性和跨摄像头空间一致性。通过以历史上下文为条件进行生成，并整合几何感知的训练损失，DriveFix强制恢复的视图遵循统一的3D几何。这使得高保真纹理的一致传播成为可能，并显著减少了伪影。在Waymo、nuScenes和PandaSet数据集上的广泛评估表明，DriveFix在重建和新视角合成方面均取得了最先进的性能，标志着在实现稳健的4D世界模型以用于实际部署方面迈出了重要一步。
AI.summary: DriveFix是一个新颖的多视图恢复框架，旨在解决现有4D场景重建方法中因独立处理帧而导致的时空不一致性问题。它通过使用交错的扩散Transformer和几何感知的损失，明确地对时间依赖性和跨摄像头空间一致性进行建模，从而实现了高保真、在时间和空间上都一致的驾驶场景恢复。
AI.keywords: 4D场景重建, 扩散先验, 时空一致性, 自动驾驶, 扩散Transformer
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个专门用于解决自动驾驶场景中现有4D重建方法缺乏时空一致性的框架。通过使用交错的扩散Transformer架构和几何感知的损失函数，它有效地将时间依赖性和跨视角空间一致性集成到生成过程中，这是迈向真实世界部署的关键一步。主要局限性可能在于对计算资源的需求，尽管摘要中没有明确提及。

title: NeSy-Route: A Neuro-Symbolic Benchmark for Constrained Route Planning in Remote Sensing
summary: Remote sensing underpins crucial applications such as disaster relief and ecological field surveys, where systems must understand complex scenes and constraints and make reliable decisions. Current remote-sensing benchmarks mainly focus on evaluating perception and reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). They fail to assess planning capability, stemming either from the difficulty of curating and validating planning tasks at scale or from evaluation protocols that are inaccurate and inadequate. To address these limitations, we introduce NeSy-Route, a large-scale neuro-symbolic benchmark for constrained route planning in remote sensing. Within this benchmark, we introduce an automated data-generation framework that integrates high-fidelity semantic masks with heuristic search to produce diverse route-planning tasks with provably optimal solutions. This allows NeSy-Route to comprehensively evaluate planning across 10,821 route-planning samples, nearly 10 times larger than the largest prior benchmark. Furthermore, a three-level hierarchical neuro-symbolic evaluation protocol is developed to enable accurate assessment and support fine-grained analysis on perception, reasoning, and planning simultaneously. Our comprehensive evaluation of various state-of-the-art MLLMs demonstrates that existing MLLMs show significant deficiencies in perception and planning capabilities. We hope NeSy-Route can support further research and development of more powerful MLLMs for remote sensing.

AI.title_translation: 遥感约束路径规划的神经符号基准：NeSy-Route
AI.tldr: 遥感应用需要复杂的场景理解和决策能力，但现有基准主要关注感知和推理，忽略了规划能力。本文提出了NeSy-Route，一个大规模神经符号基准，用于遥感约束路径规划。它通过自动生成包含最优解的任务来解决数据稀疏和评估不准确的问题，并提供分层评估协议来同时评估感知、推理和规划能力。实验表明，现有模型在感知和规划方面存在显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感基准未能充分评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的规划能力，因为大规模规划任务的创建和验证困难，且评估协议不准确。这阻碍了在灾难响应和生态调查等关键应用中可靠决策系统的发展。
AI.method: 引入了一个名为NeSy-Route的大规模神经符号基准，该基准包含一个自动数据生成框架。该框架结合了高保真语义掩码和启发式搜索，以生成具有可证明最优解的多样化路径规划任务。此外，还开发了一个三级分层神经符号评估协议，用于同时评估感知、推理和规划能力。
AI.result: 对最先进的MLLMs进行的全面评估表明，它们在感知和规划能力方面存在显著缺陷。
AI.conclusion: NeSy-Route基准的提出为遥感领域多模态大语言模型的规划能力评估提供了新的解决方案，并揭示了当前模型在该领域存在的不足，有望推动相关研究和发展。
AI.translation: 遥感支撑着诸如灾难救助和生态实地调查等关键应用，在这些应用中，系统必须理解复杂的场景和约束并做出可靠的决策。当前的遥感基准主要关注评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的感知和推理能力。它们未能评估规划能力，这要么源于大规模策划和验证规划任务的困难，要么源于不准确和不充分的评估协议。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了NeSy-Route，一个用于遥感约束路径规划的大规模神经符号基准。在该基准内，我们引入了一个自动数据生成框架，该框架集成了高保真语义掩码和启发式搜索，以生成具有可证明最优解的多样化路径规划任务。这使得NeSy-Route能够全面评估近10,821个路径规划样本的规划能力，其规模是先前最大基准的近10倍。此外，还开发了一个三级分层神经符号评估协议，以实现准确评估并支持同时对感知、推理和规划进行细粒度分析。我们对各种最先进MLLMs进行的全面评估表明，现有的MLLMs在感知和规划能力方面存在显著缺陷。我们希望NeSy-Route能够支持开发更强大的遥感MLLMs的进一步研究和开发。
AI.summary: NeSy-Route是一个新提出的、大规模的神经符号基准，旨在解决遥感领域多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在规划能力评估方面的不足。该基准通过自动生成包含最优解的路径规划任务，克服了传统方法在数据创建和验证上的困难，并采用分层评估协议来同时衡量感知、推理和规划能力。通过对现有模型的评估，NeSy-Route揭示了它们在感知和规划方面的局限性，并为未来研究提供了基础。
AI.keywords: 遥感, 路径规划, 神经符号学习, 基准测试, 多模态大语言模型
AI.comments: 该研究填补了遥感领域多模态大语言模型评估基准的空白，特别是在规划能力方面。自动数据生成框架和分层评估协议的设计具有创新性，能够提供更准确、更细粒度的评估。然而，该基准的有效性仍需在更广泛的模型和应用场景中得到验证。

title: Three-Dimensional Affine Spatial Logics
summary: We focus on a branch of region-based spatial logics dealing with affine geometry. The research on this topic is scarce: only a handful of papers investigate such systems, mostly in the case of the real plane. Our long-term goal is to analyse certain family of affine logics with inclusion and convexity as primitives interpreted over real spaces of increasing dimensionality. In this article we show that logics of different dimensionalities must have different theories, thus justifying further work on different dimensions. We then focus on the three-dimensional case, exploring the expressiveness of this logic and consequently showing that it is possible to construct formulas describing a three-dimensional coordinate frame. The final result, making use of the high expressive power of this logic, is that every region satisfies an affine complete formula, meaning that all regions satisfying it are affine equivalent.

AI.tldr: 研究了基于区域的空间逻辑，重点关注仿射几何，并探讨了三维情况下的表达能力，证明了所有区域都满足一个仿射完备公式。
AI.motivation: 研究稀少的基于区域的空间逻辑在仿射几何中的应用，特别是随着维度增加的仿射逻辑，目标是分析具有包含和凸性作为原语的仿射逻辑。
AI.method: 探讨了不同维度逻辑的理论差异，并专注于三维情况，分析其表达能力，构建描述三维坐标系的公式。
AI.result: 证明了不同维度的逻辑具有不同的理论；在三维情况下，构建了描述三维坐标系的公式；证明了所有区域都满足一个仿射完备公式，意味着所有满足该公式的区域都是仿射等价的。
AI.conclusion: 三维仿射空间逻辑具有强大的表达能力，足以描述三维坐标系，并且所有区域都满足一个仿射完备公式。
AI.translation: 我们关注基于区域的空间逻辑的一个分支，该分支处理仿射几何。关于这个主题的研究很少：只有少数论文研究了这类系统，而且大多是针对实数平面的情况。我们的长期目标是分析一类以包含和凸性作为原语，并在维度不断增加的实数空间上解释的仿射逻辑。在本文中，我们证明了不同维度的逻辑必须有不同的理论，从而证明了在不同维度上进行进一步研究的合理性。然后，我们专注于三维情况，探索该逻辑的表达能力，并因此证明了构建描述三维坐标系的公式是可能的。最终的结果是，利用该逻辑的高表达能力，每个区域都满足一个仿射完备公式，这意味着所有满足该公式的区域都是仿射等价的。
AI.summary: 本文研究了基于区域的空间逻辑在仿射几何中的应用，特别是三维情况。研究表明，不同维度的逻辑理论不同。在三维空间中，该逻辑具有足够的表达能力来描述坐标系，并且证明了所有区域都满足一个仿射完备公式，即它们都是仿射等价的。
AI.keywords: 空间逻辑, 仿射几何, 三维逻辑, 包含, 凸性
AI.comments: 这项研究在空间逻辑领域具有重要意义，特别是在仿射几何方面。通过在高维度空间中引入包含和凸性作为原语，该研究为理解和操作复杂的空间关系提供了新的视角。三维情况下的结果尤其令人兴奋，因为它不仅展示了逻辑的表达能力，还为几何推理和空间数据处理开辟了新的可能性。然而，该研究也可能存在一些局限性，例如在处理非仿射变换或更复杂的几何结构时，该逻辑的适用性可能需要进一步探讨。

title: Omnilingual MT: Machine Translation for 1,600 Languages
summary:
High-quality machine translation (MT) can scale to hundreds of languages, setting a high bar for multilingual systems. However, compared to the world's 7,000 languages, current systems still offer only limited coverage: about 200 languages on the target side, and maybe a few hundreds more on the source side, supported due to cross-lingual transfer. And even these numbers have been hard to evaluate due to the lack of reliable benchmarks and metrics.
  We present Omnilingual Machine Translation (OMT), the first MT system supporting more than 1,600 languages. This scale is enabled by a comprehensive data strategy that integrates large public multilingual corpora with newly created datasets, including manually curated MeDLEY bitext.
  We explore two ways of specializing a Large Language model (LLM) for machine translation: as a decoder-only model (OMT-LLaMA) or as a module in an encoder-decoder architecture (OMT-NLLB). Notably, all our 1B to 8B parameter models match or exceed the MT performance of a 70B LLM baseline, revealing a clear specialization advantage and enabling strong translation quality in low-compute settings. Moreover, our evaluation of English-to-1,600 translations further shows that while baseline models can interpret undersupported languages, they frequently fail to generate them with meaningful fidelity; OMT-LLaMA models substantially expand the set of languages for which coherent generation is feasible. Additionally, OMT models improve in cross-lingual transfer, being close to solving the "understanding" part of the puzzle in MT for the 1,600 evaluated. Our leaderboard and main human-created evaluation datasets (BOUQuET and Met-BOUQuET) are dynamically evolving towards Omnilinguality and freely available.

AI.title_translation: 全语言机器翻译：支持1600种语言的机器翻译
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了首个支持超过1600种语言的机器翻译系统OMT，通过整合现有语料库和新创建的数据集，并探索了两种专门化大型语言模型（LLM）的方法。结果表明，OMT系统在低计算资源下也能达到或超过大型基线模型的性能，并显著提高了对支持不足语言的翻译能力和跨语言迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有机器翻译系统覆盖的语言数量有限（约数百种），远低于全球7000种语言的总数，且缺乏可靠的评估基准和指标。
AI.method: 提出Omnilingual Machine Translation (OMT)系统，支持超过1600种语言。通过综合数据策略，整合大型公开多语言语料库和新创建的数据集（包括手动整理的MeDLEY双语文本）。探索了两种将大型语言模型（LLM）专门化用于机器翻译的方法：作为解码器模型（OMT-LLaMA）或作为编码器-解码器架构的模块（OMT-NLLB）。
AI.result: 所有1B至8B参数的OMT模型在机器翻译性能上均达到或超过了70B LLM基线模型。OMT-LLaMA模型显著扩展了能够生成连贯翻译的语言范围，解决了低资源语言的生成问题。OMT模型在跨语言迁移方面也有所改进，在所评估的1600种语言中，基本解决了机器翻译中的“理解”问题。OMT系统在低计算资源下表现出色。
AI.conclusion: OMT系统是首个支持超过1600种语言的机器翻译系统，通过创新的数据策略和LLM专门化方法，显著提高了翻译质量，尤其是在支持不足的语言方面，并为机器翻译的“全语言”目标奠定了基础。
AI.translation:
高质量的机器翻译（MT）可以扩展到数百种语言，为多语言系统设定了很高的标准。然而，与世界上7000种语言相比，目前的系统仍然覆盖有限：目标端约有200种语言，由于跨语言迁移，源端可能还有几百种语言。而且由于缺乏可靠的基准和指标，这些数字甚至难以评估。
我们提出了Omnilingual Machine Translation (OMT)，这是第一个支持超过1600种语言的MT系统。这种规模得益于一个全面的数据策略，该策略整合了大型公开多语言语料库和新创建的数据集，包括手动整理的MeDLEY双语文本。
我们探索了两种将大型语言模型（LLM）专门化用于机器翻译的方法：作为解码器模型（OMT-LLaMA）或作为编码器-解码器架构的模块（OMT-NLLB）。值得注意的是，我们所有的1B到8B参数模型在MT性能上都达到了或超过了一个70B LLM基线模型，这揭示了明显的专门化优势，并在低计算设置下实现了强大的翻译质量。此外，我们对英语到1600种语言的翻译评估进一步表明，虽然基线模型可以理解支持不足的语言，但它们经常无法有意义地生成它们；OMT-LLaMA模型大大扩展了连贯生成可行的语言集。此外，OMT模型在跨语言迁移方面有所改进，基本解决了MT中1600种评估语言的“理解”难题。我们的排行榜和主要的、人类创建的评估数据集（BOUQuET和Met-BOUQuET）正在动态发展，朝着全语言化方向发展，并且是免费提供的。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了Omnilingual Machine Translation (OMT)系统，这是首个支持超过1600种语言的机器翻译系统。OMT通过整合现有语料库和新创建的数据集，并采用专门化的大型语言模型（LLM）方法（OMT-LLaMA和OMT-NLLB），实现了前所未有的语言覆盖范围。实验证明，OMT系统在低计算资源下表现优异，能够达到甚至超越大型基线模型的性能，并显著提高了对支持不足语言的翻译质量和跨语言迁移能力。该研究还发布了相关的评估数据集和排行榜，推动了机器翻译向全语言化的发展。
AI.keywords: 全语言机器翻译, 大型语言模型, 低资源语言, 跨语言迁移, OMT
AI.comments: 该研究在机器翻译领域取得了重大突破，首次实现了对超过1600种语言的支持，极大地扩展了机器翻译的应用范围。OMT系统在低计算资源下的优异表现，为资源匮乏的语言提供了可行的翻译解决方案。然而，摘要中并未详细说明“手动整理的MeDLEY双语文本”的具体内容和规模，以及评估指标的鲁棒性，这些是未来研究可以关注的方向。另外，虽然提到了“理解”问题的解决，但对于“生成”质量的详细评估和与人类翻译的对比可以进一步阐述。

title: Learning to Predict, Discover, and Reason in High-Dimensional Discrete Event Sequences
comments: PhD dissertation, 131 pages of main content, 202 pages in total
summary: Electronic control units (ECUs) embedded within modern vehicles generate a large number of asynchronous events known as diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs). These discrete events form complex temporal sequences that reflect the evolving health of the vehicle's subsystems. In the automotive industry, domain experts manually group these codes into higher-level error patterns (EPs) using Boolean rules to characterize system faults and ensure safety. However, as vehicle complexity grows, this manual process becomes increasingly costly, error-prone, and difficult to scale. Notably, the number of unique DTCs in a modern vehicle is on the same order of magnitude as the vocabulary of a natural language, often numbering in the tens of thousands. This observation motivates a paradigm shift: treating diagnostic sequences as a language that can be modeled, predicted, and ultimately explained. Traditional statistical approaches fail to capture the rich dependencies and do not scale to high-dimensional datasets characterized by thousands of nodes, large sample sizes, and long sequence lengths. Specifically, the high cardinality of categorical event spaces in industrial logs poses a significant challenge, necessitating new machine learning architectures tailored to such event-driven systems. This thesis addresses automated fault diagnostics by unifying event sequence modeling, causal discovery, and large language models (LLMs) into a coherent framework for high-dimensional event streams. It is structured in three parts, reflecting a progressive transition from prediction to causal understanding and finally to reasoning for vehicle diagnostics. Consequently, we introduce several Transformer-based architectures for predictive maintenance, scalable sample- and population-level causal discovery frameworks and a multi-agent system that automates the synthesis of Boolean EP rules.
comment: PhD dissertation, 131 pages of main content, 202 pages in total

AI.title_translation: 学习在高维离散事件序列中进行预测、发现和推理
AI.tldr: 面对现代汽车中数万种DTCs组成的复杂诊断序列，传统的手动规则制定方法已不可行。本论文将诊断序列类比为“语言”，开发了基于Transformer的预测模型、可扩展的因果发现框架，以及一个能自动生成故障规则的多智能体系统，旨在实现高维事件流的自动化诊断、理解和推理。
AI.motivation: 现代车辆电子控制单元（ECU）生成大量异步诊断故障码（DTCs），形成复杂的时序序列，反映车辆健康状况。人工分组这些代码以识别错误模式（EP）的方法随着车辆复杂性增加变得成本高昂、易出错且难以扩展，特别是DTCs的基数（数量级）非常高，传统统计方法无法有效处理。
AI.method: 引入Transformer-based架构进行预测性维护；开发可扩展的样本级和总体级因果发现框架；构建一个多智能体系统以自动化布尔错误模式（EP）规则的合成。
AI.result: 提出了用于预测性维护的Transformer-based架构；开发了可扩展的样本级和总体级因果发现框架；设计了一个自动化综合布尔EP规则的多智能体系统。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过整合事件序列建模、因果发现和大型语言模型（LLMs），建立了一个统一的框架，以实现高维事件流的预测、因果理解和推理，最终目标是自动化布尔错误模式（EP）规则的合成，以解决汽车故障诊断的挑战。
AI.translation: 现代车辆中嵌入的电子控制单元（ECU）会生成大量被称为诊断故障代码（DTCs）的异步事件。这些离散事件形成了复杂的时序序列，反映了车辆子系统不断演变的状态。在汽车行业中，领域专家使用布尔规则手动将这些代码分组为更高级别的错误模式（EPs），以表征系统故障并确保安全。然而，随着车辆复杂性的增加，这种手动过程变得越来越昂贵、容易出错且难以扩展。值得注意的是，现代车辆中唯一DTCs的数量与自然语言的词汇量处于同一数量级，通常有数万个。这一观察促使范式转变：将诊断序列视为一种可以被建模、预测并最终被解释的语言。传统的统计方法无法捕捉丰富的依赖关系，并且无法扩展到以数千个节点、大样本量和长序列长度为特征的高维数据集。特别是，工业日志中分类事件空间的高基数带来了重大挑战，需要为这种事件驱动系统量身定制新的机器学习架构。本论文通过将事件序列建模、因果发现和大型语言模型（LLMs）统一到一个连贯的框架中，来解决高维事件流的自动化故障诊断问题。它分为三个部分，反映了从预测到因果理解，再到车辆诊断推理的渐进转变。因此，我们引入了用于预测性维护的几种基于Transformer的架构、可扩展的样本级和总体级因果发现框架，以及一个自动合成布尔EP规则的多智能体系统。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在通过将汽车诊断事件序列视为一种可建模的“语言”，解决由高维离散事件序列（DTCs）带来的传统人工诊断方法的局限性。研究提出了一个统一的框架，整合了序列预测、因果发现和大型语言模型（LLMs）的技术，以实现对车辆健康演变的高效建模、预测和推理。
AI.keywords: DTCs, 离散事件序列, 故障诊断, 因果发现, Transformer模型
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将高维离散事件序列（DTCs）视为一种“语言”进行建模，并整合了预测、因果发现和大型语言模型（LLM）的概念，以解决汽车诊断中人工规则制定的局限性。其重要性在于为自动化的、可扩展的汽车故障诊断提供了一个统一的框架。局限性（基于摘要）是其是否能在真实、动态变化的车辆系统中保持鲁棒性并未在摘要中说明。

title: Systematization of Knowledge: The Design Space of Digital Payment Systems with Potential for CBDC
summary: Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) are proposed as a public response to the uptake of privately run digital payments, with the digital euro, under development by the European Central Bank (ECB), serving as a prominent example. This momentum provides a unique opportunity to fundamentally rethink the future of money, and, assuming wide adoption, to establish payment systems that offer strong cryptographic security and privacy guarantees from the start. While the central banks in charge are investigating privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs), they often conclude that PETs are immature or insufficiently scalable. Moreover, these efforts tend to examine primitives in isolation, offering little insight into how a system using these PETs would scale. This systematisation of knowledge, therefore, provides a structured, top-down technical analysis of 36 payment system designs of complete system proposals that can inform CBDC designs or were explicitly proposed for this application. We identify recurring design patterns, technical trade-offs, and implementation challenges. Concluding, we highlight research gaps, including offline payments and post-quantum security.

AI.title_translation: 系统化知识：具有央行数字货币潜力的数字支付系统设计空间
AI.tldr: 该论文对36种数字支付系统设计进行了系统性分析，重点关注其在央行数字货币（CBDC）设计中的应用，识别了设计模式、技术权衡和挑战，并指出了离线支付和后量子安全等研究空白。
AI.motivation: 为应对私人数字支付的兴起，中央银行提出了央行数字货币（CBDC）。此举为重新构想货币未来提供了契机，可以从一开始就建立具备强大加密安全和隐私保障的支付系统。然而，中央银行在探索隐私增强技术（PET）时，常认为其不成熟或扩展性不足，且仅孤立地研究基本原理，缺乏系统性洞察。因此，需要对现有支付系统设计进行系统化分析，为CBDC设计提供信息。
AI.method: 通过对36种完整的数字支付系统设计（包括为CBDC设计的提案）进行系统化的、自上而下的技术分析，识别了重复出现的设计模式、技术权衡和实施挑战。
AI.result: 识别了数字支付系统的设计模式、技术权衡和实施挑战。论文还指出了包括离线支付和后量子安全在内的研究差距。
AI.conclusion: 该论文对36种数字支付系统设计进行了系统化分析，为CBDC设计提供了指导，并强调了离线支付和后量子安全等领域的研究需求。
AI.translation: 中央银行数字货币（CBDC）被提议作为对私人运营数字支付的回应，欧洲中央银行（ECB）正在开发的数字欧元是其中的一个突出例子。这一势头提供了一个独特的机会，可以从根本上重新思考金钱的未来，并假设广泛采用，从一开始就建立提供强大加密安全和隐私保证的支付系统。虽然负责的中央银行正在研究隐私增强技术（PET），但他们常常得出结论，认为PETs不成熟或扩展性不足。此外，这些努力倾向于孤立地检查原语，对使用这些PETs的系统的扩展性几乎没有见解。因此，这种知识系统化提供了一种结构化的、自上而下的技术分析，涵盖了36种完整的系统提案的设计，可以为CBDC设计提供信息或明确为该应用提出。我们识别了重复出现的设计模式、技术权衡和实施挑战。最后，我们强调了包括离线支付和后量子安全在内的研究差距。
AI.summary: 本研究对36种数字支付系统设计进行了全面的技术分析，旨在为中央银行数字货币（CBDC）的设计提供信息。通过识别重复出现的设计模式、技术权衡和实施挑战，该论文为理解和构建更安全、更注重隐私的支付系统提供了宝贵的见解，并指出了离线支付和后量子安全等关键的研究领域。
AI.keywords: 数字支付系统, 央行数字货币, 隐私增强技术, 设计模式, 技术权衡
AI.comments: 该研究通过对大量现有数字支付系统设计的系统化分析，为CBDC的设计提供了重要的参考框架。其识别出的设计模式、技术权衡和实施挑战，以及指出的研究差距，都极具价值。然而，对于所分析的36种设计如何进行选择和评估的标准，以及分析的深度和细节可以进一步阐述。

title: A Human-Centred Architecture for Large Language Models-Cognitive Assistants in Manufacturing within Quality Management Systems
summary: Large Language Models-Cognitive Assistants (LLM-CAs) can enhance Quality Management Systems (QMS) in manufacturing, fostering continuous process improvement and knowledge management. However, there is no human-centred software architecture focused on QMS that enables the integration of LLM-CAs into manufacturing in the current literature. This study addresses this gap by designing a component-based architecture considering requirement analysis and software development process. Validation was conducted via iterative expert focus groups. The proposed architecture ensures flexibility, scalability, modularity, and work augmentation within QMS. Moreover, it paves the way for its operationalization with industrial partners, showcasing its potential for advancing manufacturing processes.

title: ADAPT: Adaptive Dual-projection Architecture for Perceptive Traversal
summary: Agile humanoid locomotion in complex 3D en- vironments requires balancing perceptual fidelity with com- putational efficiency, yet existing methods typically rely on rigid sensing configurations. We propose ADAPT (Adaptive dual-projection architecture for perceptive traversal), which represents the environment using a horizontal elevation map for terrain geometry and a vertical distance map for traversable- space constraints. ADAPT further treats its spatial sensing range as a learnable action, enabling the policy to expand its perceptual horizon during fast motion and contract it in cluttered scenes for finer local resolution. Compared with voxel-based baselines, ADAPT drastically reduces observation dimensionality and computational overhead while substantially accelerating training. Experimentally, it achieves successful zero-shot transfer to a Unitree G1 Humanoid and signifi- cantly outperforms fixed-range baselines, yielding highly robust traversal across diverse 3D environtmental challenges.

title: An Interpretable Machine Learning Framework for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Drug Response Analysis
summary: Lung cancer is a condition where there is abnormal growth of malignant cells that spread in an uncontrollable fashion in the lungs. Some common treatment strategies are surgery, chemotherapy, and radiation which aren't the best options due to the heterogeneous nature of cancer. In personalized medicine, treatments are tailored according to the individual's genetic information along with lifestyle aspects. In addition, AI-based deep learning methods can analyze large sets of data to find early signs of cancer, types of tumor, and prospects of treatment. The paper focuses on the development of personalized treatment plans using specific patient data focusing primarily on the genetic profile. Multi-Omics data from Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer have been used to build a predictive model along with machine learning techniques. The value of the target variable, LN-IC50, determines how sensitive or resistive a drug is. An XGBoost regressor is utilized to predict the drug response focusing on molecular and cellular features extracted from cancer datasets. Cross-validation and Randomized Search are performed for hyperparameter tuning to further optimize the model's predictive performance. For explanation purposes, SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) was used. SHAP values measure each feature's impact on an individual prediction. Furthermore, interpreting feature relationships was performed using DeepSeek, a large language model trained to verify the biological validity of the features. Contextual explanations regarding the most important genes or pathways were provided by DeepSeek alongside the top SHAP value constituents, supporting the predictability of the model.

title: Decoding the Critique Mechanism in Large Reasoning Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) exhibit backtracking and self-verification mechanisms that enable them to revise intermediate steps and reach correct solutions, yielding strong performance on complex logical benchmarks. We hypothesize that such behaviors are beneficial only when the model has sufficiently strong "critique" ability to detect its own mistakes. This work systematically investigates how current LRMs recover from errors by inserting arithmetic mistakes in their intermediate reasoning steps. Notably, we discover a peculiar yet important phenomenon: despite the error propagating through the chain-of-thought (CoT), resulting in an incorrect intermediate conclusion, the model still reaches the correct final answer. This recovery implies that the model must possess an internal mechanism to detect errors and trigger self-correction, which we refer to as the hidden critique ability. Building on feature space analysis, we identify a highly interpretable critique vector representing this behavior. Extensive experiments across multiple model scales and families demonstrate that steering latent representations with this vector improves the model's error detection capability and enhances the performance of test-time scaling at no extra training cost. Our findings provide a valuable understanding of LRMs' critique behavior, suggesting a promising direction to control and improve their self-verification mechanism. Our code is available at https://github.com/mail-research/lrm-critique-vectors.

title: Behavioral Steering in a 35B MoE Language Model via SAE-Decoded Probe Vectors: One Agency Axis, Not Five Traits
summary: We train nine sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on the residual stream of Qwen 3.5-35B-A3B, a 35-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with a hybrid GatedDeltaNet/attention architecture, and use them to identify and steer five agentic behavioral traits. Our method trains linear probes on SAE latent activations, then projects the probe weights back through the SAE decoder to obtain continuous steering vectors in the model's native activation space. This bypasses the SAE's top-k discretization, enabling fine-grained behavioral intervention at inference time with no retraining. Across 1,800 agent rollouts (50 scenarios times 36 conditions), we find that autonomy steering at multiplier 2 achieves Cohen's d = 1.01 (p < 0.0001), shifting the model from asking the user for help 78% of the time to proactively executing code and searching the web. Cross-trait analysis, however, reveals that all five steering vectors primarily modulate a single dominant agency axis (the disposition to act independently versus defer to the user), with trait specific effects appearing only as secondary modulations in tool-type composition and dose-response shape. The tool-use vector steers behavior (d = 0.39); the risk-calibration vector produces only suppression. We additionally show that steering only during autoregressive decoding has zero effect (p > 0.35), providing causal evidence that behavioral commitments are computed during prefill in GatedDeltaNet architectures.

title: Faulty Coffees: Barriers to Adoption of an In-the-wild Robo-Barista
comments: Accepted for publication in Failing Forward, Design and Deployment Lessons from Real-World Human-Robot Interaction Workshop at HRI 2026, March 16, 2026, Edinburgh, Scotland
summary: We set out to study whether task-based narratives could influence long-term engagement with a service robot. To do so, we deployed a Robo-Barista for five weeks in an over-50's housing complex in Stockton, England. Residents received a free daily coffee by interacting with a Furhat robot assigned to either a narrative or non-narrative dialogue condition. Despite designing for sustained engagement, repeat interaction was low, and we encountered curiosity trials without retention, technical breakdowns, accessibility barriers, and the social dynamics of a housing complex setting. Rather than treating these as peripheral issues, we foreground them in this paper. We reflect on the in-the-wild realities of our experiment and offer lessons for conducting longitudinal Human-Robot Interaction research when studies unravel in practice.
comment: Accepted for publication in Failing Forward, Design and Deployment Lessons from Real-World Human-Robot Interaction Workshop at HRI 2026, March 16, 2026, Edinburgh, Scotland

title: SpikeCLR: Contrastive Self-Supervised Learning for Few-Shot Event-Based Vision using Spiking Neural Networks
summary: Event-based vision sensors provide significant advantages for high-speed perception, including microsecond temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and low power consumption. When combined with Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs), they can be deployed on neuromorphic hardware, enabling energy-efficient applications on embedded systems. However, this potential is severely limited by the scarcity of large-scale labeled datasets required to effectively train such models. In this work, we introduce SpikeCLR, a contrastive self-supervised learning framework that enables SNNs to learn robust visual representations from unlabeled event data. We adapt prior frame-based methods to the spiking domain using surrogate gradient training and introduce a suite of event-specific augmentations that leverage spatial, temporal, and polarity transformations. Through extensive experiments on CIFAR10-DVS, N-Caltech101, N-MNIST, and DVS-Gesture benchmarks, we demonstrate that self-supervised pretraining with subsequent fine-tuning outperforms supervised learning in low-data regimes, achieving consistent gains in few-shot and semi-supervised settings. Our ablation studies reveal that combining spatial and temporal augmentations is critical for learning effective spatio-temporal invariances in event data. We further show that learned representations transfer across datasets, contributing to efforts for powerful event-based models in label-scarce settings.

title: Iris: Bringing Real-World Priors into Diffusion Model for Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: In this paper, we propose \textbf{Iris}, a deterministic framework for Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) that integrates real-world priors into the diffusion model. Conventional feed-forward methods rely on massive training data, yet still miss details. Previous diffusion-based methods leverage rich generative priors yet struggle with synthetic-to-real domain transfer. Iris, in contrast, preserves fine details, generalizes strongly from synthetic to real scenes, and remains efficient with limited training data. To this end, we introduce a two-stage Priors-to-Geometry Deterministic (PGD) schedule: the prior stage uses Spectral-Gated Distillation (SGD) to transfer low-frequency real priors while leaving high-frequency details unconstrained, and the geometry stage applies Spectral-Gated Consistency (SGC) to enforce high-frequency fidelity while refining with synthetic ground truth. The two stages share weights and are executed with a high-to-low timestep schedule. Extensive experimental results confirm that Iris achieves significant improvements in MDE performance with strong in-the-wild generalization.

title: PKINet-v2: Towards Powerful and Efficient Poly-Kernel Remote Sensing Object Detection
summary: Object detection in remote sensing images (RSIs) is challenged by the coexistence of geometric and spatial complexity: targets may appear with diverse aspect ratios, while spanning a wide range of object sizes under varied contexts. Existing RSI backbones address the two challenges separately, either by adopting anisotropic strip kernels to model slender targets or by using isotropic large kernels to capture broader context. However, such isolated treatments lead to complementary drawbacks: the strip-only design can disrupt spatial coherence for regular-shaped objects and weaken tiny details, whereas isotropic large kernels often introduce severe background noise and geometric mismatch for slender structures. In this paper, we extend PKINet, and present a powerful and efficient backbone that jointly handles both challenges within a unified paradigm named Poly Kernel Inception Network v2 (PKINet-v2). PKINet-v2 synergizes anisotropic axial-strip convolutions with isotropic square kernels and builds a multi-scope receptive field, preserving fine-grained local textures while progressively aggregating long-range context across scales. To enable efficient deployment, we further introduce a Heterogeneous Kernel Re-parameterization (HKR) Strategy that fuses all heterogeneous branches into a single depth-wise convolution for inference, eliminating fragmented kernel launches without accuracy loss. Extensive experiments on four widely-used benchmarks, including DOTA-v1.0, DOTA-v1.5, HRSC2016, and DIOR-R, demonstrate that PKINet-v2 achieves state-of-the-art accuracy while delivering a $\textbf{3.9}\times$ FPS acceleration compared to PKINet-v1, surpassing previous remote sensing backbones in both effectiveness and efficiency.

title: Detecting Sentiment Steering Attacks on RAG-enabled Large Language Models
summary: The proliferation of large-scale IoT networks has been both a blessing and a curse. Not only has it revolutionized the way organizations operate by increasing the efficiency of automated procedures, but it has also simplified our daily lives. However, while IoT networks have improved convenience and connectivity, they have also increased security risk due to unauthorized devices gaining access to these networks and exploiting existing weaknesses with specific attack types. The research proposes two lightweight deep learning (DL)-based intelligent intrusion detection systems (IDS). to enhance the security of IoT networks: the proposed convolutional neural network (CNN)-based IDS and the proposed long short-term memory (LSTM)-based IDS. The research evaluated the performance of both intelligent IDSs based on DL using the CICIoT2023 dataset. DL-based intelligent IDSs successfully identify and classify various cyber threats using binary, grouped, and multi-class classification. The proposed CNN-based IDS achieves an accuracy of 99.34%, 99.02% and 98.6%, while the proposed LSTM-based IDS achieves an accuracy of 99.42%, 99.13%, and 98.68% for binary, grouped, and multi-class classification, respectively.

title: Learning Human-Object Interaction for 3D Human Pose Estimation from LiDAR Point Clouds
summary: Understanding humans from LiDAR point clouds is one of the most critical tasks in autonomous driving due to its close relationships with pedestrian safety, yet it remains challenging in the presence of diverse human-object interactions and cluttered backgrounds. Nevertheless, existing methods largely overlook the potential of leveraging human-object interactions to build robust 3D human pose estimation frameworks. There are two major challenges that motivate the incorporation of human-object interaction. First, human-object interactions introduce spatial ambiguity between human and object points, which often leads to erroneous 3D human keypoint predictions in interaction regions. Second, there exists severe class imbalance in the number of points between interacting and non-interacting body parts, with the interaction-frequent regions such as hand and foot being sparsely observed in LiDAR data. To address these challenges, we propose a Human-Object Interaction Learning (HOIL) framework for robust 3D human pose estimation from LiDAR point clouds. To mitigate the spatial ambiguity issue, we present human-object interaction-aware contrastive learning (HOICL) that effectively enhances feature discrimination between human and object points, particularly in interaction regions. To alleviate the class imbalance issue, we introduce contact-aware part-guided pooling (CPPool) that adaptively reallocates representational capacity by compressing overrepresented points while preserving informative points from interacting body parts. In addition, we present an optional contact-based temporal refinement that refines erroneous per-frame keypoint estimates using contact cues over time. As a result, our HOIL effectively leverages human-object interaction to resolve spatial ambiguity and class imbalance in interaction regions. Codes will be released.

title: Prompts Blend Requirements and Solutions: From Intent to Implementation
comments: 9 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Submitted to EASE 2026
summary: AI coding assistants are reshaping software development by shifting focus from writing code to formulating prompts. In chat-focused approaches such as vibe coding, prompts become the primary arbiter between human intent and executable software. While Requirements Engineering (RE) emphasizes capturing, validating, and evolving requirements, current prompting practices remain informal and adhoc. We argue that prompts should be understood as lightweight, evolving requirement artifacts that blend requirements with solution guidance. We propose a conceptual model decomposing prompts into three interrelated components: Functionality and Quality (the requirement), General Solutions (architectural strategy and technology choices) and Specific Solutions (implementation-level constraints). We assess this model using existing prompts, examining how these components manifest in practice. Based on this model and the initial assessment, we formulate four hypotheses: prompts evolve toward specificity, evolution varies by user characteristics, engineers using prompting engage in increased requirement validation and verification, and progressive prompt refinement yields higher code quality. Our vision is to empirically evaluate these hypotheses through analysis of real-world AI-assisted development, with datasets, corpus analysis, and controlled experiments, ultimately deriving best practices for requirements-aware prompt engineering. By rethinking prompts through the lens of RE, we position prompting not merely as a technical skill, but as a central concern for software engineering's future.
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Submitted to EASE 2026

title: SseRex: Practical Symbolic Execution of Solana Smart Contracts
comments: This paper appeared on the 23rd Conference on Detection of Intrusions and Malware & Vulnerability Assessment (DIMVA '26) in July 2026
summary: Solana is rapidly gaining traction among smart contract developers and users. However, its growing adoption has been accompanied by a series of major security incidents, which have spurred research into automated analysis techniques for Solana smart contracts. Unfortunately, existing approaches do not address the unique and complex account model of Solana. In this paper, we propose SseRex, the first symbolic execution vulnerability detection approach for finding Solana-specific bugs such as missing owner checks, missing signer checks, and missing key checks, as well as arbitrary cross-program invocations. Our evaluation of 8,714 bytecode-only contracts shows that our approach outperforms existing approaches and identifies potential bugs in 467 different contracts. Additionally, we analyzed 120 open-source Solana projects and conducted in-depth case studies on four of them. Our findings reveal that subtle, easily overlooked issues often serve as the root cause of severe exploits, further highlighting the need for specialized analysis tools like SseRex.
comment: This paper appeared on the 23rd Conference on Detection of Intrusions and Malware & Vulnerability Assessment (DIMVA '26) in July 2026

title: Automated identification of Ichneumonoidea wasps via YOLO-based deep learning: Integrating HiresCam for Explainable AI
summary: Accurate taxonomic identification of parasitoid wasps within the superfamily Ichneumonoidea is essential for biodiversity assessment, ecological monitoring, and biological control programs. However, morphological similarity, small body size, and fine-grained interspecific variation make manual identification labor-intensive and expertise-dependent. This study proposes a deep learning-based framework for the automated identification of Ichneumonoidea wasps using a YOLO-based architecture integrated with High-Resolution Class Activation Mapping (HiResCAM) to enhance interpretability. The proposed system simultaneously identifies wasp families from high-resolution images. The dataset comprises 3556 high-resolution images of Hymenoptera specimens. The taxonomic distribution is primarily concentrated among the families Ichneumonidae (n = 786), Braconidae (n = 648), Apidae (n = 466), and Vespidae (n = 460). Extensive experiments were conducted using a curated dataset, with model performance evaluated through precision, recall, F1 score, and accuracy. The results demonstrate high accuracy of over 96 % and robust generalization across morphological variations. HiResCAM visualizations confirm that the model focuses on taxonomically relevant anatomical regions, such as wing venation, antennae segmentation, and metasomal structures, thereby validating the biological plausibility of the learned features. The integration of explainable AI techniques improves transparency and trustworthiness, making the system suitable for entomological research to accelerate biodiversity characterization in an under-described parasitoid superfamily.

title: Biased Compression in Gradient Coding for Distributed Learning
summary: Communication bottlenecks and the presence of stragglers pose significant challenges in distributed learning (DL). To deal with these challenges, recent advances leverage unbiased compression functions and gradient coding. However, the significant benefits of biased compression remain largely unexplored. To close this gap, we propose Compressed Gradient Coding with Error Feedback (COCO-EF), a novel DL method that combines gradient coding with biased compression to mitigate straggler effects and reduce communication costs. In each iteration, non-straggler devices encode local gradients from redundantly allocated training data, incorporate prior compression errors, and compress the results using biased compression functions before transmission. The server aggregates these compressed messages from the non-stragglers to approximate the global gradient for model updates. We provide rigorous theoretical convergence guarantees for COCO-EF and validate its superior learning performance over baseline methods through empirical evaluations. As far as we know, we are among the first to rigorously demonstrate that biased compression has substantial benefits in DL, when gradient coding is employed to cope with stragglers.

title: PashtoCorp: A 1.25-Billion-Word Corpus, Evaluation Suite, and Reproducible Pipeline for Low-Resource Language Development
summary: We present PashtoCorp, a 1.25-billion-word corpus for Pashto, a language spoken by 60 million people that remains severely underrepresented in NLP. The corpus is assembled from 39 sources spanning seven HuggingFace datasets and 32 purpose-built web scrapers, processed through a reproducible pipeline with Arabic-script tokenization, SHA-256 deduplication, and quality filtering. At 1.25B words across 2.81 million documents, PashtoCorp is 40x larger than the OSCAR Pashto subset and 83x larger than the previously largest dedicated Pashto corpus. Continued MLM pretraining of XLM-R-base on PashtoCorp reduces held-out perplexity by 25.1% (8.08->6.06). On WikiANN Pashto NER, the pretrained model improves entity F1 by 10% relative (19.0%->21.0%) and reduces training variance nearly 7x; the largest gain appears at 50 training sentences (+27%), with PashtoCorp covering 97.9% of WikiANN entity vocabulary. On Belebele Pashto reading comprehension, Gemma-3n achieves 64.6% accuracy, the first published LLM baseline for Pashto on this benchmark. A leave-one-out source ablation shows that Wikipedia (0.7% of documents) is the most critical source for NER: removing it alone reduces entity F1 by 47%. Corpus data, trained model, and code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ihanif/pashto-corpus, https://huggingface.co/ihanif/xlmr-pashto, and https://github.com/ihanif/pashto-corpus.

title: Toward Experimentation-as-a-Service in 5G/6G: The Plaza6G Prototype for AI-Assisted Trials
summary: This paper presents Plaza6G, the first operational Experiment-as-a-Service (ExaS) platform unifying cloud resources with next-generation wireless infrastructure. Developed at CTTC in Barcelona, Plaza6G integrates GPU-accelerated compute clusters, multiple 5G cores, both open-source (e.g., Free5GC) and commercial (e.g., Cumucore), programmable RANs, and physical or emulated user equipment under unified orchestration. In Plaza6G, the experiment design requires minimal expertise as it is expressed in natural language via a web portal or a REST API. The web portal and REST API are enhanced with a Large Language Model (LLM)-based assistant, which employs retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for up-to-date experiment knowledge and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for continuous domain fine-tuning. Over-the-air (OTA) trials leverage a four-chamber anechoic facility and a dual-site outdoor 5G network operating in sub-6~GHz and mmWave bands. Demonstrations include automated CI/CD integration with sub-ten-minute setup and interactive OTA testing under programmable propagation conditions. Machine-readable experiment descriptors ensure reproducibility, while future work targets policy-aware orchestration, safety validation, and federated testbed integration toward open, reproducible wireless experimentation.

title: Beyond Grading Accuracy: Exploring Alignment of TAs and LLMs
summary:
In this paper, we investigate the potential of open-source Large Language Models (LLMs) for grading Unified Modeling Language (UML) class diagrams. In contrast to existing work, which primarily evaluates proprietary LLMs, we focus on non-proprietary models, making our approach suitable for universities where transparency and cost are critical. Additionally, existing studies assess performance over complete diagrams rather than individual criteria, offering limited insight into how automated grading aligns with human evaluation.
  To address these gaps, we propose a grading pipeline in which student-generated UML class diagrams are independently evaluated by both teaching assistants (TAs) and LLMs. Grades are then compared at the level of individual criteria. We evaluate this pipeline through a quantitative study of 92 UML class diagrams from a software design course, comparing TA grades against assessments produced by six popular open-source LLMs. Performance is measured across individual criterion, highlighting areas where LLMs diverge from human graders. Our results show per-criterion accuracy of up to 88.56% and a Pearson correlation coefficient of up to 0.78, representing a substantial improvement over previous work while using only open-source models. We also explore the concept of an optimal model that combines the best-performing LLM per criterion. This optimal model achieves performance close to that of a TA, suggesting a possible path toward a mixed-initiative grading system. Our findings demonstrate that open-source LLMs can effectively support UML class diagram grading by explicitly identifying grading alignment. The proposed pipeline provides a practical approach to manage increasing assessment workloads with growing student counts.

title: One Kiss: Emojis as Agents of Genre Flux in Generative Comics
summary: Generative AI has made visual storytelling widely accessible, yet current prompt-based interactions often force users into a trade-off between precise control and creative flow. We present One Kiss, a co-creative comic generation system that introduces "Affective Steering". Instead of writing text prompts, users guide the tone of their story through emoji inputs, whose semantic ambiguity becomes a resource rather than a limitation. Unlike traditional text-to-image tools that rely on explicit descriptions, One Kiss uses a dual-stream input in which users define structural pacing by sketching panel frames and set atmospheric tone by pairing keywords with emojis. This mechanism enables "Genre Flux," where emotional inputs accumulate across panels and gradually shift the genre of a story. A preliminary study (N = 6) suggests that this soft steering approach may reframe the user's role from prompt engineer to narrative director, with ambiguity serving as a source of creative surprise rather than a loss of control.

title: Work Sharing and Offloading for Efficient Approximate Threshold-based Vector Join
summary: Vector joins - finding all vector pairs between a set of query and data vectors whose distances are below a given threshold - are fundamental to modern vector and vector-relational database systems that power multimodal retrieval and semantic analytics. Existing state-of-the-art approach exploits work sharing among similar queries but still suffers from redundant index traversals and excessive distance computations. We propose a unified framework for efficient approximate vector joins that (1) introduces soft work sharing to reuse traversal results beyond the join results of previous queries, (2) builds a merged index over both query and data vectors to further speedup graph explorations, and (3) improves robustness for out-of-distribution queries through an adaptive hybrid search strategy. Experiments on eight datasets demonstrate substantial improvements in efficiency-recall trade-off over the state of the art.

title: $D^3$-RSMDE: 40$\times$ Faster and High-Fidelity Remote Sensing Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: Real-time, high-fidelity monocular depth estimation from remote sensing imagery is crucial for numerous applications, yet existing methods face a stark trade-off between accuracy and efficiency. Although using Vision Transformer (ViT) backbones for dense prediction is fast, they often exhibit poor perceptual quality. Conversely, diffusion models offer high fidelity but at a prohibitive computational cost. To overcome these limitations, we propose Depth Detail Diffusion for Remote Sensing Monocular Depth Estimation ($D^3$-RSMDE), an efficient framework designed to achieve an optimal balance between speed and quality. Our framework first leverages a ViT-based module to rapidly generate a high-quality preliminary depth map construction, which serves as a structural prior, effectively replacing the time-consuming initial structure generation stage of diffusion models. Based on this prior, we propose a Progressive Linear Blending Refinement (PLBR) strategy, which uses a lightweight U-Net to refine the details in only a few iterations. The entire refinement step operates efficiently in a compact latent space supported by a Variational Autoencoder (VAE). Extensive experiments demonstrate that $D^3$-RSMDE achieves a notable 11.85% reduction in the Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) perceptual metric over leading models like Marigold, while also achieving over a 40x speedup in inference and maintaining VRAM usage comparable to lightweight ViT models.

title: Advancing Visual Reliability: Color-Accurate Underwater Image Enhancement for Real-Time Underwater Missions
summary: Underwater image enhancement plays a crucial role in providing reliable visual information for underwater platforms, since strong absorption and scattering in water-related environments generally lead to image quality degradation. Existing high-performance methods often rely on complex architectures, which hinder deployment on underwater devices. Lightweight methods often sacrifice quality for speed and struggle to handle severely degraded underwater images. To address this limitation, we present a real-time underwater image enhancement framework with accurate color restoration. First, an Adaptive Weighted Channel Compensation module is introduced to achieve dynamic color recovery of the red and blue channels using the green channel as a reference anchor. Second, we design a Multi-branch Re-parameterized Dilated Convolution that employs multi-branch fusion during training and structural re-parameterization during inference, enabling large receptive field representation with low computational overhead. Finally, a Statistical Global Color Adjustment module is employed to optimize overall color performance based on statistical priors. Extensive experiments on eight datasets demonstrate that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance across seven evaluation metrics. The model contains only 3,880 inference parameters and achieves an inference speed of 409 FPS. Our method improves the UCIQE score by 29.7% under diverse environmental conditions, and the deployment on ROV platforms and performance gains in downstream tasks further validate its superiority for real-time underwater missions.

title: Impact of File-Open Hook Points on Backup Ratio in ROFBS on XFS
summary:
