AI.comments: SynthChain的创新之处在于其构建了一个接近生产环境的多源测试平台和数据集，并提供了链级真实标签，这对于评估和开发高级软件供应链攻击的检测和取证工具至关重要。该研究通过量化单一和多源遥测的局限性，明确指出了多源数据融合在提高攻击链重建和检测覆盖率方面的显著优势，为未来防御策略提供了明确的方向。其释放的数据集和工件将对学术界和工业界在软件供应链安全领域的研究产生积极影响。

title: Cost Trade-offs in Matrix Inversion Updates for Streaming Outlier Detection
summary: Outlier detection identifies data points that deviate significantly from expected patterns, revealing anomalies that may require special attention. Incorporating online learning further improves accuracy by continuously updating the model to reflect the most recent data. When employing the Christoffel function as an outlier score, online learning requires updating the inverse of a matrix following a rank-k update, given the initial inverse. Surprisingly, there is no consensus on the optimal method for this task. This technical note aims to compare three different updating methods: Direct Inversion (DI), Iterative Sherman-Morrison (ISM), and Woodbury Matrix Identity (WMI), to identify the most suitable approach for different scenarios. We first derive the theoretical computational costs of each method and then validate these findings through comprehensive Python simulations run on a CPU. These results allow us to propose a simple, quantitative, and easy-to-remember rule that can be stated qualitatively as follows: ISM is optimal for rank-1 updates, WMI excels for small updates relative to matrix size, and DI is preferable otherwise. This technical note produces a general result for any problem involving a matrix inversion update. In particular, it contributes to the ongoing development of efficient online outlier detection techniques.

AI.title_translation: 流式异常检测中矩阵求逆更新的成本权衡
AI.tldr: 本文比较了三种用于在线异常检测中矩阵求逆更新的方法（DI、ISM、WMI），推导了它们的计算成本，并通过Python模拟验证，并提出了根据更新秩和矩阵大小选择最优方法的简单规则。
AI.motivation: 在采用Christoffel函数作为异常值分数时，在线学习需要根据初始逆矩阵更新一个经过秩-k更新的矩阵的逆。然而，对于这项任务的最佳方法目前没有共识。本文旨在比较三种不同的更新方法，以确定在不同场景下最合适的方法。
AI.method: 本文比较了三种矩阵求逆更新方法：直接求逆（DI）、迭代Sherman-Morrison（ISM）和Woodbury矩阵恒等式（WMI）。首先推导了每种方法的理论计算成本，然后通过在CPU上运行的综合Python模拟验证了这些发现。
AI.result: 研究结果表明：ISM 最适合秩-1 更新，WMI 在相对于矩阵大小的较小更新中表现出色，而 DI 在其他情况下更优。这些结果使得能够提出一个简单、定量且易于记忆的规则。
AI.conclusion: 本文为任何涉及矩阵求逆更新的问题提供了一个通用结果，并特别有助于高效在线异常检测技术的持续发展。
AI.translation: 异常检测识别出显著偏离预期模式的数据点，揭示可能需要特别关注的异常情况。结合在线学习通过不断更新模型以反映最新数据，进一步提高了准确性。当采用Christoffel函数作为异常值分数时，在线学习需要在给定初始逆矩阵的情况下，更新一个经过秩-k更新的矩阵的逆。令人惊讶的是，对于这项任务的最佳方法目前没有共识。本技术说明旨在比较三种不同的更新方法：直接求逆（DI）、迭代Sherman-Morrison（ISM）和Woodbury矩阵恒等式（WMI），以确定在不同场景下最合适的方法。我们首先推导了每种方法的理论计算成本，然后通过在CPU上运行的综合Python模拟验证了这些发现。这些结果使我们能够提出一个简单、定量且易于记忆的规则，可以定性地表述为：ISM 最适合秩-1 更新，WMI 在相对于矩阵大小的较小更新中表现出色，而 DI 在其他情况下更优。本技术说明为任何涉及矩阵求逆更新的问题提供了一个通用结果。特别是，它有助于高效在线异常检测技术的持续发展。
AI.summary: 本研究解决了在线异常检测中矩阵求逆更新方法选择不统一的问题。通过比较直接求逆（DI）、迭代Sherman-Morrison（ISM）和Woodbury矩阵恒等式（WMI）三种方法，推导并验证了它们的计算成本。研究结果提供了关于何时选择哪种方法的定量规则：ISM 适用于秩-1 更新，WMI 适用于相对较小的更新，而 DI 适用于其他情况。这项工作为高效在线异常检测提供了通用且实用的指导。
AI.keywords: 流式异常检测, 矩阵求逆更新, 计算成本, Sherman-Morrison, Woodbury恒等式
AI.comments: 该论文解决了在线学习和数值线性代数中的一个实际且重要的问题。其创新之处在于系统地比较了三种矩阵求逆更新方法，并提供了基于理论分析和实验验证的明确选择规则。这项工作不仅对在线异常检测领域具有直接贡献，其通用结果也适用于其他需要矩阵求逆更新的场景，具有广泛的实用价值。

title: Nonlinear Information Theory: Characterizing Distributional Uncertainty in Communication Models with Sublinear Expectation
summary: A mathematical framework for information-theoretic analysis is established, with a new viewpoint of describing transmitted messages and communication channels by the nonlinear expectation theory, beyond the framework of classical probability theory. The major motivation of this research is to emphasize the probabilistic distribution uncertainty within the ever increasingly complex communication networks, where random phenomena are often nonstationary, heterogeneous, and cannot be characterized by a single probability distribution. Based on the nonlinear expectation theory, in this paper we first explicitly define several fundamental concepts, such as nonlinear information entropy, nonlinear joint entropy, nonlinear conditional entropy and nonlinear mutual information, and establish their basic properties. Secondly, by using the strong law of large numbers under sublinear expectations, we propose a nonlinear source coding theorem, which shows that the nonlinear information entropy is the upper bound of the achievable coding rate of sources whose distributions are uncertain under the maximum error probability criterion, and determines a cluster point of the coding rate of such sources under the minimum error probability criterion. Thirdly, we propose a nonlinear channel coding theorem, which gives the explicit expression of the upper bound under the maximum error probability criterion and a cluster point under the minimum error probability criterion, respectively, for the achievable coding rate of communication channels whose distributions are uncertain. Additionally, we propose a nonlinear rate-distortion source coding theorem, proving that the rate distortion function based on the nonlinear mutual information is a cluster point of the lossy compression performance of uncertain-distribution sources under the minimum expected distortion criterion.

AI.title_translation: 非线性信息论：用次线性期望刻画通信模型中的分布不确定性
AI.tldr: 本文基于非线性期望理论，建立了一个非线性信息论框架，以处理通信模型中的分布不确定性，并定义了非线性熵、互信息等概念，提出了非线性信源编码、信道编码和率失真编码定理。
AI.motivation: 本研究的主要动机是强调并解决日益复杂的通信网络中存在的概率分布不确定性问题，因为其中的随机现象通常是非平稳、异构的，无法用单一概率分布来表征，从而超越了经典概率论的框架。
AI.method: 1. 建立了基于非线性期望理论的信息论分析数学框架。2. 明确定义了非线性信息熵、非线性联合熵、非线性条件熵和非线性互信息等基本概念，并建立了其基本性质。3. 利用次线性期望下的强大数定律，提出了非线性信源编码定理。4. 提出了非线性信道编码定理。5. 提出了非线性率失真信源编码定理。
AI.result: 1. 明确定义了非线性信息熵、非线性联合熵、非线性条件熵和非线性互信息等基本概念及其基本性质。2. 提出了非线性信源编码定理，表明非线性信息熵是分布不确定信源在最大错误概率准则下可实现编码率的上限，并在最小错误概率准则下确定了编码率的聚点。3. 提出了非线性信道编码定理，给出了分布不确定通信信道在最大错误概率准则下的可实现编码率上限和在最小错误概率准则下的聚点。4. 提出了非线性率失真信源编码定理，证明了基于非线性互信息的率失真函数是分布不确定信源在最小期望失真准则下有损压缩性能的聚点。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过定义关键概念并提出基本的编码定理（信源、信道和率失真），建立了一个全面的非线性信息论框架，为表征和处理通信系统中分布不确定性提供了坚实的理论基础。
AI.translation: 建立了一个信息论分析的数学框架，通过非线性期望理论描述传输消息和通信信道，超越了经典概率论的框架。这项研究的主要动机是强调日益复杂的通信网络中概率分布的不确定性，其中随机现象通常是非平稳、异构的，并且不能用单一概率分布来表征。基于非线性期望理论，本文首先明确定义了几个基本概念，如非线性信息熵、非线性联合熵、非线性条件熵和非线性互信息，并建立了它们的基本性质。其次，通过使用次线性期望下的强大数定律，我们提出了一个非线性信源编码定理，该定理表明非线性信息熵是在最大错误概率准则下，其分布不确定的信源可实现编码率的上限，并在最小错误概率准则下确定了此类信源编码率的一个聚点。第三，我们提出了一个非线性信道编码定理，该定理分别给出了在最大错误概率准则下和在最小错误概率准则下的聚点，用于分布不确定的通信信道的可实现编码率的明确表达式。此外，我们提出了一个非线性率失真信源编码定理，证明了基于非线性互信息的率失真函数是在最小期望失真准则下，不确定分布信源有损压缩性能的一个聚点。
AI.summary: 本文引入了一个基于非线性期望的非线性信息论框架，以应对具有分布不确定性的通信系统，超越了经典概率论。它定义了非线性熵和互信息等基本概念，并建立了非线性信源编码、信道编码和率失真定理，以表征具有不确定分布的系统可实现的编码率和有损压缩性能。
AI.keywords: 非线性信息论, 次线性期望, 分布不确定性, 信源编码, 信道编码
AI.comments: 这篇论文具有创新性，因为它扩展了经典信息论，以解决复杂通信网络中的分布不确定性问题，这是一个重要的实际挑战。通过利用非线性期望理论，它为单一概率分布不足的场景提供了一个更稳健的数学框架。基本定理（如非线性信源和信道编码）的建立对于在不确定性下开发未来的通信技术至关重要。

title: A Variational Pseudo-Observation Guided Nudged Particle Filter
summary: Nonlinear filtering with standard PF methods requires mitigative techniques to quell weight degeneracy, such as resampling. This is especially true in high-dimensional systems with sparse observations. Unfortunately, such techniques are also fragile when applied to systems with exceedingly rare events. Nonlinear systems with these properties can be assimilated effectively with a control-based PF method known as the nPF, but this method has a high computational cost burden. In this work, we aim to retain this strength of the nudged method while reducing the computational cost by introducing a variational method into the algorithm that acts as a continuous pseudo-observation path. By maintaining a PF representation, the resulting algorithm continues to capture an approximation of the filtering distribution, while reducing computational runtime and improving robustness to the "rare" event of switching phases. Preliminary testing of the new approach is demonstrated on a stochastic variant of the nonlinear and chaotic L63 model, which is used as a surrogate for mimicking "rare" events. The new approach helps to overcome difficulties in applying the nPF for realistic problems and performs favorably with respect to a standard PF with a higher number of particles.

AI.title_translation: 一种变分伪观测引导的扰动粒子滤波器
AI.tldr: 为了降低计算成本并提高处理罕见事件的鲁棒性，研究人员将变分方法集成到扰动粒子滤波器（nPF）中，创建了一个新的VPONPF算法，该算法通过连续的伪观测路径指导粒子，并在测试中优于标准PF。
AI.motivation: 标准粒子滤波器（PF）在处理高维系统和稀疏观测时需要缓解权重退化的技术，但这些技术在处理“极其罕见的事件”时很脆弱。基于控制的PF方法（nPF）可以有效处理这类系统，但计算成本很高。因此，动机在于在保持nPF处理稀有事件的优势的同时，降低其计算成本。
AI.method: 通过引入一个充当连续伪观测路径的变分方法到算法中，以降低计算成本，同时保持粒子滤波器的表示形式，从而继续捕获滤波分布的近似值。
AI.result: 所得算法通过保持PF表示，继续捕获滤波分布的近似值，同时减少了计算运行时间并提高了对“切换相”这一“罕见”事件的鲁棒性。与使用更多粒子的标准PF相比，新方法表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的新方法有助于克服在实际问题中应用nPF的困难，并且与使用更多粒子的标准PF相比表现出优势。
AI.translation: 标准的PF方法在非线性滤波中需要缓解权重退化的缓解技术，例如重采样。这在高维系统和稀疏观测中尤其如此。不幸的是，当应用于具有极其罕见事件的系统时，这些技术也很脆弱。具有这些特性的非线性系统可以有效地与一种称为nPF的基于控制的PF方法进行同化，但该方法的计算成本负担很高。在工作中，我们的目标是通过将一种充当连续伪观测路径的变分方法引入到算法中，来保留扰动方法的这一优势，同时降低计算成本。通过保持PF的表示形式，所得算法继续捕获滤波分布的近似值，同时减少了计算运行时间并提高了对“切换相”这一“罕见”事件的鲁棒性。在非线性、混沌L63模型的随机变体上演示了新方法的初步测试，该模型被用作模仿“罕见”事件的替代品。新方法有助于克服在实际问题中应用nPF的困难，并且与具有更多粒子的标准PF相比表现良好。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种变分伪观测引导的扰动粒子滤波器（VPONPF），旨在通过引入一个连续的变分伪观测路径来指导粒子，从而在保持扰动粒子滤波器（nPF）处理稀有事件的优势的同时，显著降低其高昂的计算成本。该方法在L63模型上的初步测试表明，它能有效应对罕见事件的挑战，并比标准PF具有更好的性能。
AI.keywords: 粒子滤波器, 扰动粒子滤波器, 变分方法, 伪观测, 稀有事件
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地将变分方法引入到粒子滤波器（PF）中，通过引入连续的伪观测路径来指导粒子，从而在保持nPF处理稀有事件的能力的同时，降低了计算成本。其重要性在于为高维、稀疏观测和罕见事件系统提供了一种更高效、更鲁棒的非线性滤波方案。局限性在于“初步测试”表明其性能良好，但未给出详细的性能对比或理论收敛性分析。

title: Learning Lineage-guided Geodesics with Finsler Geometry
summary: Trajectory inference investigates how to interpolate paths between observed timepoints of dynamical systems, such as temporally resolved population distributions, with the goal of inferring trajectories at unseen times and better understanding system dynamics. Previous work has focused on continuous geometric priors, utilizing data-dependent spatial features to define a Riemannian metric. In many applications, there exists discrete, directed prior knowledge over admissible transitions (e.g. lineage trees in developmental biology). We introduce a Finsler metric that combines geometry with classification and incorporate both types of priors in trajectory inference, yielding improved performance on interpolation tasks in synthetic and real-world data.

AI.title_translation: 学习谱系引导的芬斯勒几何测地线
AI.tldr: 该研究引入芬斯勒几何，结合连续几何先验和离散有向先验知识，改进了动态系统轨迹推断的插值性能。
AI.motivation: 轨迹推断旨在插值动态系统观测时间点之间的路径，以推断未见时间点的轨迹并更好地理解系统动力学。现有工作主要关注连续几何先验，但许多应用中存在离散、有向的先验知识（如发育生物学中的谱系树），这促使作者寻求结合这两种先验的方法。
AI.method: 引入一种芬斯勒度量，将几何学与分类相结合，并在轨迹推断中同时纳入连续几何先验（数据依赖的空间特征）和离散有向先验知识（可允许转换）。
AI.result: 在合成数据和真实世界数据上的插值任务中，性能得到改善。
AI.conclusion: 结合连续几何先验和离散有向先验的芬斯勒几何方法，能有效提高轨迹推断的插值性能。
AI.translation: 轨迹推断研究如何插值动态系统（如时间分辨的群体分布）观测时间点之间的路径，旨在推断未见时间点的轨迹并更好地理解系统动力学。先前的工作主要关注连续几何先验，利用数据依赖的空间特征来定义黎曼度量。在许多应用中，存在关于可允许转换的离散、有向先验知识（例如发育生物学中的谱系树）。我们引入了一种将几何学与分类相结合的芬斯勒度量，并在轨迹推断中结合了这两种类型的先验，从而在合成数据和真实世界数据上的插值任务中获得了改进的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种基于芬斯勒几何的新方法，用于动态系统的轨迹推断。该方法创新性地将连续几何先验与离散有向先验知识（如谱系树）相结合，通过引入一种结合几何和分类的芬斯勒度量，有效解决了现有方法仅侧重于连续几何先验的局限性。实验结果表明，该方法在合成数据和真实世界数据上的插值任务中均表现出显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 轨迹推断, 芬斯勒几何, 谱系引导, 几何先验, 动态系统
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将芬斯勒几何引入轨迹推断领域，并成功地将连续的几何先验与离散的谱系引导先验知识相结合。这对于需要考虑复杂动力学和离散转换规则的生物学等领域具有重要意义。该方法提高了轨迹插值的准确性，为理解系统动力学提供了更精细的工具。

title: Search2Motion: Training-Free Object-Level Motion Control via Attention-Consensus Search
summary: We present Search2Motion, a training-free framework for object-level motion editing in image-to-video generation. Unlike prior methods requiring trajectories, bounding boxes, masks, or motion fields, Search2Motion adopts target-frame-based control, leveraging first-last-frame motion priors to realize object relocation while preserving scene stability without fine-tuning. Reliable target-frame construction is achieved through semantic-guided object insertion and robust background inpainting. We further show that early-step self-attention maps predict object and camera dynamics, offering interpretable user feedback and motivating ACE-Seed (Attention Consensus for Early-step Seed selection), a lightweight search strategy that improves motion fidelity without look-ahead sampling or external evaluators. Noting that existing benchmarks conflate object and camera motion, we introduce S2M-DAVIS and S2M-OMB for stable-camera, object-only evaluation, alongside FLF2V-obj metrics that isolate object artifacts without requiring ground-truth trajectories. Search2Motion consistently outperforms baselines on FLF2V-obj and VBench.

AI.title_translation: Search2Motion：通过注意力共识搜索实现免训练对象级运动控制
AI.tldr: Search2Motion是一个免训练框架，用于图像到视频生成中的对象级运动编辑，通过目标帧控制和注意力共识搜索实现对象重定位，同时保持场景稳定并优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法需要轨迹、边界框、蒙版或运动场来控制对象运动，且在图像到视频生成中实现对象级运动编辑仍是一个挑战。此外，现有基准测试将对象和摄像机运动混淆，缺乏针对稳定摄像机和纯对象运动的评估。
AI.method: Search2Motion采用免训练的目标帧控制，利用第一帧-最后一帧运动先验实现对象重定位，同时保持场景稳定性。通过语义引导的对象插入和鲁棒的背景修复来构建可靠的目标帧。引入ACE-Seed（早期步长种子选择的注意力共识）搜索策略，利用早期步长自注意力图预测对象和摄像机动态，以提高运动保真度。还提出了S2M-DAVIS和S2M-OMB基准以及FLF2V-obj指标，用于稳定摄像机、仅对象评估，并隔离对象伪影。
AI.result: Search2Motion在FLF2V-obj和VBench上始终优于基线。早期步长自注意力图能够预测对象和摄像机动态，提供可解释的用户反馈。ACE-Seed策略在没有前瞻采样或外部评估器的情况下提高了运动保真度。
AI.conclusion: Search2Motion提供了一个免训练的对象级运动编辑框架，通过创新的目标帧控制和注意力共识搜索实现了卓越的性能。它还引入了新的基准和评估指标，以更好地评估图像到视频生成中的对象运动。
AI.translation: 我们提出了Search2Motion，一个用于图像到视频生成中对象级运动编辑的免训练框架。与需要轨迹、边界框、蒙版或运动场的现有方法不同，Search2Motion采用基于目标帧的控制，利用第一帧-最后一帧运动先验实现对象重定位，同时在不进行微调的情况下保持场景稳定性。通过语义引导的对象插入和鲁棒的背景修复实现可靠的目标帧构建。我们进一步表明，早期步长自注意力图可以预测对象和摄像机动态，提供可解释的用户反馈，并激发了ACE-Seed（早期步长种子选择的注意力共识），这是一种轻量级搜索策略，无需前瞻采样或外部评估器即可提高运动保真度。注意到现有基准将对象和摄像机运动混淆，我们引入了S2M-DAVIS和S2M-OMB用于稳定摄像机、仅对象评估，以及FLF2V-obj指标，该指标无需真实轨迹即可隔离对象伪影。Search2Motion在FLF2V-obj和VBench上始终优于基线。
AI.summary: Search2Motion是一个免训练的图像到视频生成框架，专注于对象级运动编辑。它通过目标帧控制和第一帧-最后一帧运动先验实现对象重定位和场景稳定。该框架利用语义引导的对象插入和背景修复构建目标帧，并引入ACE-Seed策略，通过早期自注意力图提高运动保真度。此外，它还提出了S2M-DAVIS、S2M-OMB基准和FLF2V-obj指标，用于更准确地评估对象运动。实验结果表明，Search2Motion在相关基准上优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 对象级运动控制, 图像到视频生成, 免训练, 注意力共识, 目标帧控制
AI.comments: Search2Motion的创新之处在于其免训练的对象级运动控制方法，避免了对复杂轨迹、边界框或蒙版的需求。通过引入目标帧控制和基于注意力共识的搜索策略（ACE-Seed），它提供了一种高效且可解释的运动编辑方案。此外，该论文通过提出新的基准和评估指标，解决了现有评估方法中对象和摄像机运动混淆的问题，对图像到视频生成领域的研究具有重要意义。

title: Evaluating Latent Space Structure in Timbre VAEs: A Comparative Study of Unsupervised, Descriptor-Conditioned, and Perceptual Feature-Conditioned Models
summary: We present a comparative evaluation of latent space organization in three Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) for musical timbre generation: an unsupervised VAE, a descriptor-conditioned VAE, and a VAE conditioned on continuous perceptual features from the AudioCommons timbral models. Using a curated dataset of electric guitar sounds labeled with 19 semantic descriptors across four intensity levels, we assess each model's latent structure with a suite of clustering and interpretability metrics. These include silhouette scores, timbre descriptor compactness, pitch-conditional separation, trajectory linearity, and cross-pitch consistency. Our findings show that conditioning on perceptual features yields a more compact, discriminative, and pitch-invariant latent space, outperforming both the unsupervised and discrete descriptor-conditioned models. This work highlights the limitations of one-hot semantic conditioning and provides methodological tools for evaluating timbre latent spaces, contributing to the development of more controllable and interpretable generative audio models.

AI.title_translation: 评估音色变分自编码器中的潜在空间结构：无监督、描述符条件和感知特征条件模型的比较研究
AI.tldr: 本文比较了三种音色VAE（无监督、描述符条件、感知特征条件）的潜在空间结构，发现感知特征条件模型产生了更紧凑、可区分且音高不变的潜在空间，优于其他两种模型。
AI.motivation: 旨在评估不同条件设置下音色VAE潜在空间的组织结构，以开发更可控和可解释的生成音频模型。
AI.method: 比较了三种音色VAE：无监督VAE、描述符条件VAE和基于AudioCommons音色模型连续感知特征的VAE。使用一个包含19个语义描述符和4个强度级别的电吉他声音数据集。评估指标包括轮廓系数、音色描述符紧凑性、音高条件分离、轨迹线性和跨音高一致性。
AI.result: 感知特征条件模型产生了更紧凑、可区分且音高不变的潜在空间，优于无监督和离散描述符条件模型。
AI.conclusion: 感知特征条件化能有效改善音色VAE的潜在空间结构，克服了单热语义条件化的局限性，并为评估音色潜在空间提供了方法论工具，有助于开发更可控和可解释的生成音频模型。
AI.translation: 我们对三种用于音乐音色生成的变分自编码器（VAE）中的潜在空间组织进行了比较评估：无监督VAE、描述符条件VAE和基于AudioCommons音色模型连续感知特征的VAE。使用一个包含19个语义描述符和四个强度级别标记的电吉他声音精选数据集，我们通过一套聚类和可解释性指标评估了每个模型的潜在结构。这些指标包括轮廓系数、音色描述符紧凑性、音高条件分离、轨迹线性和跨音高一致性。我们的研究结果表明，基于感知特征的条件化产生了更紧凑、更具辨别力且音高不变的潜在空间，优于无监督和离散描述符条件模型。这项工作突出了独热语义条件化的局限性，并为评估音色潜在空间提供了方法论工具，有助于开发更可控和可解释的生成音频模型。
AI.summary: 本文比较评估了三种音色变分自编码器（VAE）的潜在空间结构：无监督、描述符条件和感知特征条件模型。研究发现，基于连续感知特征进行条件化的VAE能生成更紧凑、可区分且音高不变的潜在空间，显著优于无监督和离散描述符条件模型。这项工作强调了单热语义条件化的不足，并为评估音色潜在空间提供了有效工具，旨在推动更可控、可解释的生成音频模型的发展。
AI.keywords: 音色VAE, 潜在空间结构, 感知特征条件, 描述符条件, 生成音频模型
AI.comments: 这项研究通过系统比较不同条件化策略下的音色VAE潜在空间，明确指出基于连续感知特征的条件化在改善潜在空间结构方面具有显著优势。其创新之处在于提供了评估音色潜在空间的一套综合性指标，并揭示了传统离散描述符条件化的局限性。这对于开发更具表现力和可控性的音乐生成模型具有重要指导意义。

title: Novelty-Driven Target-Space Discovery in Automated Electron and Scanning Probe Microscopy
summary: Modern automated microscopy faces a fundamental discovery challenge: in many systems, the most important scientific information does not reside in the immediately visible image features, but in the target space of sequentially acquired spectra or functional responses, making it essential to develop strategies that can actively search for new behaviors rather than simply optimize known objectives. Here, we developed a deep-kernel-learning BEACON framework that is explicitly designed to guide discovery in the target space by learning structure-property relationships during the experiment and using that evolving model to seek diverse response regimes. We first established the method through demonstration workflows built on pre-acquired ground-truth datasets, which enabled direct benchmarking against classical acquisition strategies and allowed us to define a set of monitoring functions for comparing exploration quality, target-space coverage, and surrogate-model behavior in a transparent and reproducible manner. This benchmarking framework provides a practical basis for evaluating discovery-driven algorithms, not just optimization performance. We then operationalized and deployed the workflow on STEM, showing that the approach can transition from offline validation to real experimental implementation. To support adoption and extension by the broader community, the associated notebooks are available, allowing users to reproduce the workflows, test the benchmarks, and adapt the method to their own instruments and datasets.

AI.title_translation: 自动化电子和扫描探针显微镜中的新颖性驱动目标空间发现
AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一个名为BEACON的深度核学习框架，用于在自动化显微镜中主动探索目标空间的新行为，并提供了一个基准测试框架以评估发现驱动算法。
AI.motivation: 现代自动化显微镜面临一个根本性的发现挑战：重要的科学信息通常不在可见图像特征中，而是在顺序获取的光谱或功能响应的目标空间中。因此，需要开发能够主动搜索新行为而非仅仅优化已知目标的策略。
AI.method: 本文开发了一个名为BEACON的深度核学习框架，旨在通过在实验过程中学习结构-性质关系并利用该演化模型来寻找多样化的响应区域，从而指导目标空间的发现。该方法首先通过基于预获取的真实数据集的演示工作流进行建立，与经典采集策略进行直接基准测试，并定义了一套监控功能来比较探索质量、目标空间覆盖率和代理模型行为。随后，该工作流在STEM上进行了操作和部署，展示了其从离线验证到真实实验实施的过渡能力。
AI.result: 该方法通过演示工作流得以建立，实现了与经典采集策略的直接基准测试，并定义了一套监控功能来透明、可重复地比较探索质量、目标空间覆盖率和代理模型行为。该方法成功地从离线验证过渡到真实实验实施（在STEM上）。
AI.conclusion: BEACON框架提供了一种有效的方法来驱动自动化显微镜中的目标空间发现，通过主动搜索新颖行为而非仅仅优化已知目标。所开发的基准测试框架为评估发现驱动算法提供了一个实用的基础，并且该方法已成功部署到真实实验中，并支持社区采用和扩展。
AI.translation: 现代自动化显微镜面临一个根本性的发现挑战：在许多系统中，最重要的科学信息并不存在于立即可见的图像特征中，而存在于顺序获取的光谱或功能响应的目标空间中，这使得开发能够主动搜索新行为而非仅仅优化已知目标的策略变得至关重要。在此，我们开发了一个深度核学习BEACON框架，它明确设计用于通过在实验过程中学习结构-性质关系并利用该演化模型来寻求多样化的响应区域，从而指导目标空间的发现。我们首先通过基于预获取的真实数据集的演示工作流建立了该方法，这使得能够直接与经典采集策略进行基准测试，并允许我们定义一套监控功能，以透明和可重复的方式比较探索质量、目标空间覆盖率和代理模型行为。这个基准测试框架为评估发现驱动算法提供了一个实用的基础，而不仅仅是优化性能。然后，我们在STEM上操作和部署了该工作流，表明该方法可以从离线验证过渡到真实的实验实施。为了支持更广泛社区的采用和扩展，相关的笔记本已可用，允许用户重现工作流，测试基准，并使该方法适应他们自己的仪器和数据集。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个名为BEACON的深度核学习框架，旨在解决自动化显微镜中发现新颖科学信息的挑战。该框架通过学习结构-性质关系来主动探索目标空间中的多样化响应区域。研究通过基准测试工作流验证了其性能，并展示了其在STEM上的实际部署能力。论文还提供了开源资源，以促进社区的采用和扩展。
AI.keywords: 新颖性驱动, 目标空间发现, 自动化显微镜, 深度核学习, BEACON框架
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一个新颖性驱动的深度核学习框架（BEACON），用于在自动化显微镜中进行目标空间发现，这超越了传统仅优化已知目标的策略。其重要性在于提供了一个实用的基准测试框架来评估发现驱动算法，并成功将方法从理论验证推广到实际实验部署，为材料科学和显微学领域的自动化发现开辟了新途径。

title: Arabic Morphosyntactic Tagging and Dependency Parsing with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) perform strongly on many NLP tasks, but their ability to produce explicit linguistic structure remains unclear. We evaluate instruction-tuned LLMs on two structured prediction tasks for Standard Arabic: morphosyntactic tagging and labeled dependency parsing. Arabic provides a challenging testbed due to its rich morphology and orthographic ambiguity, which create strong morphology-syntax interactions. We compare zero-shot prompting with retrieval-based in-context learning (ICL) using examples from Arabic treebanks. Results show that prompt design and demonstration selection strongly affect performance: proprietary models approach supervised baselines for feature-level tagging and become competitive with specialized dependency parsers. In raw-text settings, tokenization remains challenging, though retrieval-based ICL improves both parsing and tokenization. Our analysis highlights which aspects of Arabic morphosyntax and syntax LLMs capture reliably and which remain difficult.

AI.title_translation: 阿拉伯语形态句法标注和依存句法分析与大型语言模型
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型（LLM）在阿拉伯语形态句法标注和依存句法分析方面表现强劲，特别是通过提示设计和检索式上下文学习，能接近甚至媲美专业解析器，但原始文本分词仍具挑战。
AI.motivation: 评估大型语言模型（LLM）生成显式语言结构的能力，特别是在具有挑战性的标准阿拉伯语形态句法标注和带标签的依存句法分析任务中。
AI.method: 使用指令微调的LLM，通过零样本提示和基于检索的上下文学习（ICL），并利用阿拉伯语树库中的示例，在阿拉伯语形态句法标注和依存句法分析任务上进行评估。
AI.result: 提示设计和演示选择显著影响性能；专有模型在特征级标注上接近监督基线，并与专业依存解析器具有竞争力。在原始文本设置中，分词仍然具有挑战性，但基于检索的ICL改进了解析和分词。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型能够可靠地捕捉阿拉伯语形态句法和句法的某些方面，但某些方面仍然困难，并强调了提示设计和检索式上下文学习的重要性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在许多自然语言处理任务上表现出色，但它们生成显式语言结构的能力仍不明确。我们评估了指令微调的LLM在标准阿拉伯语的两个结构化预测任务上的表现：形态句法标注和带标签的依存句法分析。阿拉伯语由于其丰富的形态和正字法歧义，产生了强大的形态-句法交互，因此提供了一个具有挑战性的测试平台。我们比较了零样本提示与使用阿拉伯语树库中示例的基于检索的上下文学习（ICL）。结果表明，提示设计和演示选择显著影响性能：专有模型在特征级标注上接近监督基线，并与专业依存句法分析器具有竞争力。在原始文本设置中，分词仍然具有挑战性，尽管基于检索的ICL改进了解析和分词。我们的分析强调了LLM能够可靠捕获阿拉伯语形态句法和句法的哪些方面，以及哪些方面仍然困难。
AI.summary: 本文评估了指令微调的大型语言模型在阿拉伯语形态句法标注和依存句法分析任务上的表现。研究比较了零样本提示和基于检索的上下文学习，发现提示设计和示例选择对性能有显著影响。结果显示，专有模型在特征级标注上接近监督基线，并在依存句法分析上与专业解析器竞争，但原始文本分词仍是挑战，尽管检索式ICL有所改善。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 阿拉伯语, 形态句法标注, 依存句法分析, 上下文学习
AI.comments: 这项研究通过在复杂的阿拉伯语上评估LLM的结构预测能力，为理解LLM在处理复杂语言学结构方面的潜力提供了重要见解。强调了提示工程和上下文学习在提高LLM性能上的关键作用，并指出了原始文本分词是未来研究的挑战。

title: Emotion-Aware Classroom Quality Assessment Leveraging IoT-Based Real-Time Student Monitoring
summary: This study presents high-throughput, real-time multi-agent affective computing framework designed to enhance classroom learning through emotional state monitoring. As large classroom sizes and limited teacher student interaction increasingly challenge educators, there is a growing need for scalable, data-driven tools capable of capturing students' emotional and engagement patterns in real time. The system was evaluated using the Classroom Emotion Dataset, consisting of 1,500 labeled images and 300 classroom detection videos. Tailored for IoT devices, the system addresses load balancing and latency challenges through efficient real-time processing. Field testing was conducted across three educational institutions in a large metropolitan area: a primary school (hereafter school A), a secondary school (school B), and a high school (school C). The system demonstrated robust performance, detecting up to 50 faces at 25 FPS and achieving 88% overall accuracy in classifying classroom engagement states. Implementation results showed positive outcomes, with favorable feedback from students, teachers, and parents regarding improved classroom interaction and teaching adaptation. Key contributions of this research include establishing a practical, IoT-based framework for emotion-aware learning environments and introducing the 'Classroom Emotion Dataset' to facilitate further validation and research.

AI.title_translation: 基于物联网实时学生监控的情绪感知课堂质量评估
AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个基于物联网的实时多智能体情感计算框架，通过监控学生情绪状态来评估和增强课堂学习质量，并在实际课堂环境中取得了高准确率和积极反馈。
AI.motivation: 大型课堂规模和有限的师生互动给教育工作者带来了挑战，因此需要可扩展的、数据驱动的工具来实时捕捉学生的情绪和参与模式。
AI.method: 本研究提出了一个高吞吐量、实时多智能体情感计算框架，旨在通过情绪状态监控来增强课堂学习。该系统针对物联网设备进行了优化，通过高效的实时处理解决了负载平衡和延迟问题。系统使用包含1500张标记图像和300个课堂检测视频的“课堂情绪数据集”进行评估，并在三所教育机构（小学、中学、高中）进行了现场测试。
AI.result: 该系统表现出强大的性能，能够以25 FPS的速度检测多达50张人脸，并在分类课堂参与状态方面达到88%的总体准确率。实施结果显示积极成果，学生、教师和家长对改进的课堂互动和教学适应性给予了积极反馈。
AI.conclusion: 本研究的主要贡献是建立了一个实用的、基于物联网的情绪感知学习环境框架，并引入了“课堂情绪数据集”以促进进一步的验证和研究。
AI.translation: 本研究提出了一个高吞吐量、实时多智能体情感计算框架，旨在通过情绪状态监控来增强课堂学习。由于大型课堂规模和有限的师生互动日益挑战教育工作者，对能够实时捕捉学生情绪和参与模式的可扩展、数据驱动工具的需求日益增长。该系统使用包含1500张标记图像和300个课堂检测视频的“课堂情绪数据集”进行评估。该系统专为物联网设备量身定制，通过高效的实时处理解决了负载平衡和延迟挑战。在大型都市区的三所教育机构：一所小学（以下简称A学校）、一所中学（B学校）和一所高中（C学校）进行了现场测试。该系统表现出强大的性能，能够以25 FPS的速度检测多达50张人脸，并在分类课堂参与状态方面达到88%的总体准确率。实施结果显示积极成果，学生、教师和家长对改进的课堂互动和教学适应性给予了积极反馈。本研究的主要贡献包括建立一个实用的、基于物联网的情绪感知学习环境框架，并引入“课堂情绪数据集”以促进进一步的验证和研究。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种基于物联网的实时多智能体情感计算框架，旨在通过监控学生情绪状态来提高课堂学习质量。该系统能够实时捕捉学生的情绪和参与模式，并通过高效处理解决物联网设备的负载和延迟问题。在包含1500张标记图像和300个视频的数据集上进行评估，并在小学、中学和高中进行现场测试。结果显示，系统能以25 FPS检测50张人脸，并在课堂参与状态分类中达到88%的准确率，获得了学生、教师和家长的积极反馈。研究的主要贡献是建立了情绪感知学习的物联网框架并引入了“课堂情绪数据集”。
AI.keywords: 情绪感知, 课堂质量, 物联网, 情感计算, 实时监控
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的物联网实时学生情绪监控框架，解决了大型课堂中师生互动不足的问题。其贡献在于提供了一个实用的、数据驱动的解决方案，并通过引入新的数据集来推动该领域的研究。系统在实际环境中的高准确率和积极用户反馈表明其具有重要的应用潜力。

title: Looking for (Genomic) Needles in a Haystack: Sparsity-Driven Search for Identifying Correlated Genetic Mutations in Cancer
summary: Cancer typically arises not from a single genetic mutation (i.e., hit) but from multi-hit combinations that accumulate within cells. However, enumerating multi-hit combinations becomes exponentially more expensive computationally as the number of candidate hit gene combinations grow, i.e. on the order of 20,000 choose h, where 20,000 is the number of genes in the human genome and h is the number of hits. To address this challenge, we present an algorithmic framework, called Pruned Depth-First Search (P-DFS) that leverages the high sparsity in tumor mutation data to prune large portions of the search space. Specifically, P-DFS (the main contribution of this paper) - a pruning technique that exploits sparsity to drastically reduce the otherwise exponential h-hit search space for candidate combinations used by Weighted Set Cover - which is grounded in a depth-first search backtracking technique, prunes infeasible gene subsets early, while a weighted set cover formulation systematically scores and selects the most discriminative combinations. By intertwining these ideas with optimized bitwise operations and a scalable distributed algorithm on high-performance computing clusters, our algorithm can achieve approximately 90 - 98% reduction in visited combinations for 4-hits, and roughly a 183x speedup over the exhaustive set cover approach(which is algorithmically NP-complete) measured on 147,456 ranks. In doing so, our method can feasibly handle four-hit and even higher-order gene hits, achieving both speed and resource efficiency.

AI.title_translation: 在海量数据中寻找（基因组）一针：一种稀疏性驱动的搜索方法，用于识别癌症中相关的基因突变
AI.tldr: 针对癌症中多基因突变组合搜索计算量过大的问题，本文提出P-DFS算法，通过利用数据稀疏性进行剪枝，并结合集合覆盖评分，在搜索4次点击组合时，显著减少了访问的组合数量（高达98%）并获得了183倍的速度提升，使高阶组合的分析成为可能。
AI.motivation: 癌症通常由多基因突变组合引起，但枚举所有可能的突变组合的计算成本呈指数级增长（$20000$ 选 $h$），使得搜索变得不可行。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“剪枝深度优先搜索 (P-DFS)”的算法框架，它利用肿瘤突变数据的高度稀疏性来剪枝搜索空间。该方法基于深度优先搜索回溯技术，尽早剪除不可行的基因子集，并结合加权集合覆盖来系统地评估和选择最具区分性的组合，同时利用优化的位运算和分布式算法进行加速。
AI.result: 对于4次点击（4-hits），该算法在访问的组合数量上实现了约90% - 98%的减少，并且相对于穷举的集合覆盖方法（在147,456个秩上测量），实现了大约183倍的速度提升。
AI.conclusion: 我们提出的算法能够处理四次点击甚至更高阶的基因点击，同时实现了速度和资源效率。
AI.translation: 癌症通常不是由单一的基因突变（即一次点击）引起的，而是由在细胞内积累的多重点击组合引起的。然而，随着候选点击基因组合数量的增长，枚举多重点击组合的计算成本呈指数级增加，即在20,000选h的量级，其中20,000是人类基因组中的基因数量，h是点击次数。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一个名为“剪枝深度优先搜索 (P-DFS)”的算法框架，它利用肿瘤突变数据的高度稀疏性来剪除搜索空间的大部分。具体来说，P-DFS（本文的主要贡献）——一种利用稀疏性来大幅减少加权集合覆盖所使用的候选组合的指数级h-hit搜索空间的剪枝技术——基于深度优先搜索回溯技术，尽早剪除不可行的基因子集，而加权集合覆盖公式则系统地评估和选择最具区分性的组合。通过将这些思想与优化的位运算以及高性能计算集群上的可扩展分布式算法相结合，我们的算法在4次点击时可以实现对访问组合数量约90% - 98%的减少，并且在147,456个秩上测量时，相对于穷举的集合覆盖方法（该方法在算法上是NP-完全的），实现了大约183倍的速度提升。通过这样做，我们的方法可以可行地处理四次点击甚至更高阶的基因点击，同时实现速度和资源效率。
AI.summary: 为解决癌症基因突变组合搜索中因组合数量呈指数增长导致的计算难题，本文提出了剪枝深度优先搜索 (P-DFS) 算法框架。该框架利用基因突变数据的稀疏性，通过深度优先搜索回溯技术剪枝搜索空间，并结合加权集合覆盖策略来识别最具区分性的多重基因突变组合，有效提升了搜索效率。
AI.keywords: 基因突变, 稀疏性, 深度优先搜索, 集合覆盖, 癌症
AI.comments: 该方法的核心创新在于利用基因突变数据的高度稀疏性，通过深度优先搜索的剪枝技术，显著降低了寻找多基因突变组合的计算复杂度。其将剪枝与加权集合覆盖相结合，并在高性能计算集群上实现了分布式加速。限制是主要在4次点击（4-hits）上进行了性能评估，更高阶的组合效果未详述。

title: Federated Learning with Multi-Partner OneFlorida+ Consortium Data for Predicting Major Postoperative Complications
summary: Background: This study aims to develop and validate federated learning models for predicting major postoperative complications and mortality using a large multicenter dataset from the OneFlorida Data Trust. We hypothesize that federated learning models will offer robust generalizability while preserving data privacy and security. Methods: This retrospective, longitudinal, multicenter cohort study included 358,644 adult patients admitted to five healthcare institutions, who underwent 494,163 inpatient major surgical procedures from 2012-2023. We developed and internally and externally validated federated learning models to predict the postoperative risk of intensive care unit (ICU) admission, mechanical ventilation (MV) therapy, acute kidney injury (AKI), and in-hospital mortality. These models were compared with local models trained on data from a single center and central models trained on a pooled dataset from all centers. Performance was primarily evaluated using area under the receiver operating characteristics curve (AUROC) and the area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) values. Results: Our federated learning models demonstrated strong predictive performance, with AUROC scores consistently comparable or superior performance in terms of AUROC and AUPRC across all outcomes and sites. Our federated learning models also demonstrated strong generalizability, with comparable or superior performance in terms of both AUROC and AUPRC compared to the best local learning model at each site. Conclusions: By leveraging multicenter data, we developed robust, generalizable, and privacy-preserving predictive models for major postoperative complications and mortality. These findings support the feasibility of federated learning in clinical decision support systems.

AI.title_translation: 多中心合作OneFlorida+联盟数据联合学习预测主要术后并发症
AI.tldr: 该研究使用联合学习模型，利用多中心数据预测术后并发症，模型表现良好且保护隐私。
AI.motivation: 开发和验证联合学习模型，以预测主要术后并发症和死亡率，同时保持数据隐私和安全。
AI.method: 回顾性、纵向、多中心队列研究，纳入358,644名成人患者，接受494,163例手术。开发并验证了联合学习模型，用于预测ICU入住、机械通气、急性肾损伤和院内死亡率，并与本地模型和中心模型进行比较。
AI.result: 联合学习模型在预测术后并发症和死亡率方面表现出强劲的预测性能，其AUROC和AUPRC值在所有结局和位点上均可与中心模型媲美或更优，并显示出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用多中心数据，研究开发了稳健、可泛化且保护隐私的预测模型，用于主要术后并发症和死亡率，证明了联合学习在临床决策支持系统中的可行性。
AI.translation: 背景：本研究旨在利用OneFlorida数据信托的大型多中心数据集，开发和验证用于预测主要术后并发症和死亡率的联合学习模型。我们假设联合学习模型将在保护数据隐私和安全的同时提供强大的泛化能力。方法：这项回顾性、纵向、多中心队列研究纳入了2012年至2023年期间入住五家医疗机构的358,644名成人患者，他们接受了494,163例住院主要外科手术。我们开发并进行了内部和外部验证，以预测重症监护室（ICU）入住、机械通气（MV）治疗、急性肾损伤（AKI）和院内死亡率的术后风险。将这些模型与在单个中心数据上训练的本地模型以及在所有中心汇总数据集上训练的中心模型进行了比较。主要使用接受者操作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）和精确率-召回曲线下面积（AUPRC）值来评估性能。结果：我们的联合学习模型表现出强劲的预测性能，在所有结局和位点上，其AUROC值始终与中心模型相当或更优，在AUROC和AUPRC方面表现均可与之媲美或更优。我们的联合学习模型还表现出强大的泛化能力，在AUROC和AUPRC方面，与每个位点上表现最佳的本地学习模型相比，其性能相当或更优。结论：通过利用多中心数据，我们开发了用于预测主要术后并发症和死亡率的稳健、可泛化且保护隐私的预测模型。这些发现支持联合学习在临床决策支持系统中的可行性。
AI.summary: 本研究利用OneFlorida数据信托的多中心数据，开发了联合学习模型来预测术后并发症（如ICU入住、机械通气、急性肾损伤）和死亡率。结果显示，联合学习模型在预测准确性和泛化能力上与中心模型相当或更优，同时保护了数据隐私，证明了其在临床决策支持中的潜力。
AI.keywords: 联合学习, 术后并发症, 预测模型, 数据隐私, 多中心研究
AI.comments: 该研究展示了联合学习在处理敏感的多中心医疗数据以预测术后并发症方面的巨大潜力。其优势在于模型性能与中心化方法相当，同时解决了数据共享和隐私方面的关键挑战。然而，研究未详细说明模型在不同医疗机构间的计算效率和部署复杂性。

title: The Cost of Reasoning: Chain-of-Thought Induces Overconfidence in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings where reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is as important as predictive accuracy. Extended reasoning via chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting or reasoning-trained models has become ubiquitous in modern VLM pipelines, yet its effect on UQ reliability remains poorly understood. We show that reasoning consistently degrades the quality of most uncertainty estimates, even when it improves task accuracy. We identify implicit answer conditioning as the primary mechanism: as reasoning traces converge on a conclusion before the final answer is generated, token probabilities increasingly reflect consistency with the model's own reasoning trace rather than uncertainty about correctness. In effect, the model becomes overconfident in its answer. In contrast, agreement-based consistency remains robust and often improves under reasoning, making it a practical choice for uncertainty estimation in reasoning-enabled VLMs.

AI.title_translation: 推理的代价：思维链诱导视觉语言模型的过度自信
AI.tldr: 思维链推理会降低视觉语言模型（VLMs）的许多不确定性估计，尽管它提高了准确性。这是因为模型会过度自信地依赖于其自身的推理过程，而不是对正确性的不确定性。然而，基于一致性的不确定性估计仍然有效，并且在有推理能力的 VLM 中得到改善。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉语言模型（VLMs）在要求高的场景中被广泛应用，因此可靠的不确定性量化（UQ）和预测准确性同样重要。而使用思维链（CoT）提示或经过推理训练的模型进行扩展推理已成为 VLM 管道的普遍做法，但其对 UQ 可靠性的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 本文通过分析隐式答案条件作为主要机制，解释了推理如何导致模型过度自信。当推理过程收敛到结论时，token 的概率会更多地反映与模型自身推理过程的一致性，而不是正确性的不确定性。
AI.result: 思维链推理会普遍降低大多数不确定性估计的质量，即使它提高了任务准确性。相比之下，基于一致性的不确定性估计在推理下仍然稳健，并且通常会得到改善。
AI.conclusion: 虽然思维链推理可以提高视觉语言模型的准确性，但它会损害模型的不确定性量化能力，导致过度自信。基于一致性的不确定性估计是一种更可靠的方法，尤其是在推理能力增强的 VLM 中。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）越来越多地在高风险环境中部署，在这些环境中，可靠的不确定性量化（UQ）与预测准确性同等重要。通过思维链（CoT）提示或经过推理训练的模型进行扩展推理已成为现代 VLM 管道的普遍做法，但其对 UQ 可靠性的影响仍不为人所知。我们表明，即使推理提高了任务准确性，它也会普遍降低大多数不确定性估计的质量。我们将隐式答案条件作为主要机制。随着推理跟踪在生成最终答案之前收敛到结论，token 概率越来越反映与模型自身推理跟踪的一致性，而不是正确性的不确定性。实际上，模型对其答案变得过度自信。相比之下，基于一致性的不确定性估计在推理下仍然稳健，并且通常会得到改善，这使其成为推理增强型 VLM 中不确定性估计的实用选择。
AI.summary: 本文研究了思维链（CoT）推理对视觉语言模型（VLMs）不确定性量化（UQ）的影响。研究发现，尽管 CoT 能够提高模型的准确性，但它会损害 UQ 的可靠性，导致模型对其预测过度自信。其根本原因是，模型在生成答案前，其推理过程会过度依赖于自身推理的一致性，而非对答案正确性的不确定性。然而，基于一致性的不确定性度量方法在推理条件下仍然表现稳健，甚至有所改善，因此是推理增强型 VLM 中 UQ 的一种可行选择。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 思维链, 不确定性量化, 过度自信, 一致性
AI.comments: 这项研究揭示了在视觉语言模型中引入推理能力时一个重要的、但经常被忽视的权衡：准确性与可靠性的不确定性量化之间的权衡。发现推理过程（如思维链）会系统性地诱导过度自信，这是一个关键的见解。该研究将这种现象归因于“隐式答案条件”，并提出了一种替代方法（基于一致性的度量），这为提高这些模型的鲁棒性提供了实际的解决方案。然而，进一步的研究可以探讨不同类型的推理方法或不同的模型架构对这种过度自信现象的影响程度，以及在更广泛的应用领域中这种效应的普遍性。

title: GeMA: Learning Latent Manifold Frontiers for Benchmarking Complex Systems
comments: Latent manifold frontiers for benchmarking complex production systems, and applications to national rail operators, wind farms, and macroeconomic productivity are presented
summary:
Benchmarking the performance of complex systems such as rail networks, renewable generation assets and national economies is central to transport planning, regulation and macroeconomic analysis. Classical frontier methods, notably Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) and Stochastic Frontier Analysis (SFA), estimate an efficient frontier in the observed input-output space and define efficiency as distance to this frontier, but rely on restrictive assumptions on the production set and only indirectly address heterogeneity and scale effects.
  We propose Geometric Manifold Analysis (GeMA), a latent manifold frontier framework implemented via a productivity-manifold variational autoencoder (ProMan-VAE). Instead of specifying a frontier function in the observed space, GeMA represents the production set as the boundary of a low-dimensional manifold embedded in the joint input-output space. A split-head encoder learns latent variables that capture technological structure and operational inefficiency. Efficiency is evaluated with respect to the learned manifold, endogenous peer groups arise as clusters in latent technology space, a quotient construction supports scale-invariant benchmarking, and a local certification radius, derived from the decoder Jacobian and a Lipschitz bound, quantifies the geometric robustness of efficiency scores.
  We validate GeMA on synthetic data with non-convex frontiers, heterogeneous technologies and scale bias, and on four real-world case studies: global urban rail systems (COMET), British rail operators (ORR), national economies (Penn World Table) and a high-frequency wind-farm dataset. Across these domains GeMA behaves comparably to established methods when classical assumptions hold, and provides additional insight in settings with pronounced heterogeneity, non-convexity or size-related bias.
comment: Latent manifold frontiers for benchmarking complex production systems, and applications to national rail operators, wind farms, and macroeconomic productivity are presented

AI.title_translation: 几何流形分析：为复杂系统基准测试学习潜在流形边界
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为GeMA的新框架，用于评估复杂系统的效率，如铁路网络和国家经济。与传统方法不同，GeMA在潜在空间中学习生产集，能够处理更复杂的技术结构和异质性。
AI.motivation: 传统的效率评估方法（如DEA和SFA）在处理复杂系统时，由于其对生产集和异质性的严格假设，存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出几何流形分析（GeMA）框架，该框架使用生产-流形变分自编码器（ProMan-VAE）在潜在空间中表示生产集。它通过学习潜在变量来捕捉技术结构和运营效率低下，并基于学习到的流形评估效率，同时内生地生成同行群体，并通过商结构支持尺度不变基准测试。
AI.result: GeMA在具有非凸边界、异质技术和尺度偏差的合成数据以及四个真实世界案例研究（城市轨道交通系统、英国铁路运营商、国民经济和风力发电场）中得到验证。在经典假设成立的情况下，GeMA的表现与现有方法相当，并在存在异质性、非凸性或与规模相关的偏差的情况下提供了更多见解。
AI.conclusion: GeMA提供了一种灵活且强大的方法来评估复杂系统的效率，尤其是在传统方法受限的情况下。
AI.translation: 基准测试铁路网络、可再生能源资产和国民经济等复杂系统的性能，对于交通规划、监管和宏观经济分析至关重要。经典的前沿方法，特别是数据包络分析（DEA）和随机前沿分析（SFA），在观测到的输入-输出空间中估计一个有效的边界，并将效率定义为到该边界的距离，但它们依赖于对生产集的严格假设，并且只能间接解决异质性和规模效应。我们提出几何流形分析（GeMA），一个潜在的流形前沿框架，通过生产-流形变分自编码器（ProMan-VAE）实现。GeMA不指定观测空间中的前沿函数，而是将生产集表示为嵌入联合输入-输出空间的低维流形的边界。一个分裂头的编码器学习捕捉技术结构和运营效率低下的潜在变量。效率是相对于学习到的流形进行评估的，内源性的同行群体作为潜在技术空间中的聚类出现，一个商结构支持尺度不变的基准测试，以及一个从解码器雅可比矩阵和利普希茨界导出的局部认证半径，量化了效率得分的几何鲁棒性。我们在具有非凸前沿、异质技术和尺度偏差的合成数据以及四个真实世界的案例研究：全球城市轨道交通系统（COMET）、英国铁路运营商（ORR）、国民经济（Penn World Table）和高频风力发电场数据集上验证了GeMA。在这些领域中，GeMA在经典假设成立的情况下表现与既有方法相当，并在存在显著的异质性、非凸性或与规模相关的偏差的情况下提供了额外的见解。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为几何流形分析（GeMA）的新框架，用于评估复杂系统的效率。GeMA使用生产-流形变分自编码器（ProMan-VAE）在潜在空间中学习生产集的边界，克服了传统方法（如DEA和SFA）在处理异质性、非凸性或尺度效应方面的局限性。通过在合成和真实世界数据上的验证，GeMA在多种场景下都表现出与现有方法相当的性能，并在复杂情况下提供了更深入的见解。
AI.keywords: 几何流形分析, 潜在流形, 变分自编码器, 复杂系统, 效率基准测试
AI.comments: GeMA框架在处理复杂系统效率评估方面提出了创新性的方法，尤其是在处理传统方法难以应对的异质性和非凸性问题上。其利用变分自编码器在潜在空间建模，并引入了尺度不变性和几何鲁棒性量化，具有重要的理论和实践意义。然而，模型的计算复杂度和对数据质量的敏感性可能是未来研究需要考虑的方面。

title: Understanding Quantization of Optimizer States in LLM Pre-training: Dynamics of State Staleness and Effectiveness of State Resets
summary: Quantizing optimizer states is becoming an important ingredient of memory-efficient large-scale pre-training, but the resulting optimizer dynamics remain only partially understood. We study low-precision exponential moving average (EMA) optimizer states and show how quantization can cause many nominal updates to round back to the same stored value, making the state effectively stale and slowing adaptation beyond what the nominal decay would suggest. We then develop a simple predictive model of stalling that estimates one-step stalling probabilities and characterizes how stalling builds up over time after the initialization. This perspective provides a mechanistic explanation for why optimizer-state resets help in low precision: once a quantized EMA becomes effectively stale, resetting it can temporarily restore responsiveness. Motivated by this picture, we derive a simple theory-guided method for choosing useful reset periods, showing that in low precision the key question is not only whether resets help, but when they should be applied. Experiments in controlled simulations and LLM pre-training show that suitable reset schedules recover the performance lost to low-precision state storage while substantially reducing optimizer-state memory.

AI.title_translation: 理解大型语言模型预训练中优化器状态的量化：状态陈旧性动态和状态重置的有效性
AI.tldr: 量化优化器状态会因舍入误差导致状态陈旧，减慢模型适应速度。通过预测模型解释了状态重置为何有效，并提出了一种选择重置周期的理论指导方法。实验证明，合适的重置策略能在低精度下恢复性能并减少内存占用。
AI.motivation: 优化器状态的量化对于内存高效的大规模预训练至关重要，但其动态过程尚未完全理解。
AI.method: 研究了低精度指数移动平均（EMA）优化器状态，开发了预测状态停滞的简单模型，并推导了一种选择重置周期的理论指导方法。
AI.result: 提出的方法在低精度下恢复了因状态存储而损失的性能，同时显著减少了优化器状态的内存占用。
AI.conclusion: 在低精度下，优化器状态量化会导致状态陈旧，影响模型适应性。通过理论指导的方法选择合适的重置周期，可以在恢复模型性能的同时减少内存占用。
AI.translation: 量化优化器状态已成为内存高效的大规模预训练的重要组成部分，但由此产生的优化器动态仍未被完全理解。我们研究了低精度指数移动平均（EMA）优化器状态，并展示了量化如何导致许多名义更新舍入回相同的存储值，从而使状态实际上变得陈旧，并超越名义衰减所建议的速度减慢适应性。然后，我们开发了一个简单的停滞预测模型，该模型估计单步停滞概率，并描述了停滞在初始化后如何随时间累积。这种观点为优化器状态重置在低精度下为何有帮助提供了机制性解释：一旦量化的 EMA 变得实际上陈旧，重置它可以暂时恢复响应能力。受此启发，我们推导了一种选择有用重置周期的简单理论指导方法，表明在低精度下，关键问题不仅在于重置是否有帮助，还在于何时应该应用它们。对照模拟和 LLM 预训练中的实验表明，合适的重置计划在恢复因低精度状态存储而损失的性能的同时，可以显著减少优化器状态的内存。
AI.summary: 该研究探讨了在大型语言模型预训练中量化优化器状态所带来的影响。研究发现，低精度的指数移动平均（EMA）优化器状态由于量化舍入误差会导致状态陈旧，从而减缓模型的适应速度。研究人员开发了一个预测模型来量化这种状态停滞现象，并解释了状态重置为何能在低精度下恢复模型的响应能力。在此基础上，他们提出了一种理论指导的方法来确定有效的重置周期，并在实验中验证了该方法能够在恢复模型性能的同时显著减少内存占用。
AI.keywords: 优化器状态量化, LLM预训练, 指数移动平均, 状态陈旧, 状态重置
AI.comments: 这项研究为理解和优化低精度优化器状态在 LLM 预训练中的应用提供了重要的见解。其提出的状态停滞模型和重置周期选择方法具有实际应用价值，能够有效平衡模型性能和内存效率。然而，该研究主要集中在 EMA 优化器，未来可以进一步探索其他类型的优化器。

title: Confusion-Aware Spectral Regularizer for Long-Tailed Recognition
summary: Long-tailed image classification remains a long-standing challenge, as real-world data typically follow highly imbalanced distributions where a few head classes dominate and many tail classes contain only limited samples. This imbalance biases feature learning toward head categories and leads to significant degradation on rare classes. Although recent studies have proposed re-sampling, re-weighting, and decoupled learning strategies, the improvement on the most underrepresented classes still remains marginal compared with overall accuracy. In this work, we present a confusion-centric perspective for long-tailed recognition that explicitly focuses on worst-class generalization. We first establish a new theoretical framework of class-specific error analysis, which shows that the worst-class error can be tightly upper-bounded by the spectral norm of the frequency-weighted confusion matrix and a model-dependent complexity term. Guided by this insight, we propose the Confusion-Aware Spectral Regularizer (CAR) that minimizes the spectral norm of the confusion matrix during training to reduce inter-class confusion and enhance tail-class generalization. To enable stable and efficient optimization, CAR integrates a Differentiable Confusion Matrix Surrogate and an EMA-based Confusion Estimator to maintain smooth and low-variance estimates across mini-batches. Extensive experiments across multiple long-tailed benchmarks demonstrates that CAR substantially improves both worst-class accuracy and overall performance. When combined with ConCutMix augmentation, CAR consistently surpasses exisiting state-of-the-art long-tailed learning methods under both the training-from-scratch setting (by 2.37% ~ 4.83%) and the fine-tuning-from-pretrained setting (by 2.42% ~ 4.17%) across ImageNet-LT, CIFAR100-LT, and iNaturalist datasets.

AI.title_translation: 面向长尾识别的混淆感知谱正则化器
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种新的混淆感知谱正则化器（CAR），通过最小化混淆矩阵的谱范数来解决长尾识别问题，显著提高了模型在少数类上的泛化能力，并在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 长尾数据分布导致模型偏向多数类，严重影响少数类的识别精度，现有方法改进有限。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的理论框架，将最差类错误界定为混淆矩阵的谱范数和模型复杂度项。在此基础上，设计了混淆感知谱正则化器（CAR），通过最小化混淆矩阵的谱范数来减少类间混淆。为了稳定优化，CAR集成了可微分混淆矩阵代理和基于EMA的混淆估计器。
AI.result: CAR显著提高了最差类准确率和整体性能。与ConCutMix结合时，在ImageNet-LT、CIFAR100-LT和iNaturalist数据集上，分别在从头训练和微调设置下，超越现有最先进方法2.37%~4.83%和2.42%~4.17%。
AI.conclusion: CAR通过最小化混淆矩阵的谱范数，有效解决了长尾识别中的类间混淆问题，显著提升了少数类的泛化能力，并在多个基准测试中取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.translation: 长尾图像分类仍然是一个长期存在的挑战，因为现实世界的数据通常遵循高度不平衡的分布，其中少数头部类别占主导地位，而许多尾部类别只有有限的样本。这种不平衡会使特征学习偏向头部类别，并导致罕见类别的性能显著下降。尽管最近的研究提出了重采样、重加权和解耦学习策略，但与整体准确率相比，在代表性最不足的类别上的改进仍然微乎其微。在本研究中，我们提出了一个以混淆为中心的长尾识别视角，明确关注最差类别的泛化能力。我们首先建立了一个新的类别特定误差分析理论框架，该框架表明最差类别的误差可以被频率加权的混淆矩阵的谱范数和一个模型相关的复杂度项紧密地上界。基于这一见解，我们提出了混淆感知谱正则化器（CAR），它在训练过程中最小化混淆矩阵的谱范数，以减少类别间混淆并增强尾部类别的泛化能力。为了实现稳定高效的优化，CAR集成了可微分混淆矩阵代理和基于EMA的混淆估计器，以在小批量之间保持平滑且低方差的估计。在多个长尾基准测试上的广泛实验表明，CAR显著提高了最差类别准确率和整体性能。当与ConCutMix增强相结合时，CAR在ImageNet-LT、CIFAR100-LT和iNaturalist数据集上，在从头训练和从预训练微调两种设置下，均持续超越现有最先进的长尾学习方法（分别提高了2.37%~4.83%和2.42%~4.17%）。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为混淆感知谱正则化器（CAR）的新方法，用于解决长尾图像识别中的挑战。CAR通过一个理论框架，将最差类别的错误与混淆矩阵的谱范数联系起来，并通过最小化该谱范数来减少类别间的混淆，从而提高模型在少数类上的泛化能力。该方法还结合了可微分混淆矩阵代理和EMA估计器以实现稳定优化。实验结果表明，CAR在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法，尤其是在最差类别的准确率方面。
AI.keywords: 长尾识别, 混淆矩阵, 谱范数, 最差类别泛化, 深度学习
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的视角来解决长尾识别问题，即关注“最差类别”的泛化能力。通过理论分析，将混淆矩阵的谱范数与最差类别错误联系起来，并提出了一种名为CAR的正则化器。这种方法在数学理论和实践应用上都有一定的创新性。然而，其计算复杂度以及在更大规模数据集上的表现仍有待进一步研究。此外，对“混淆矩阵”的直接优化可能存在数值稳定性问题，文中提出的代理和估计器是解决这一问题的关键，但其有效性还需更详细的分析。

title: IQuest-Coder-V1 Technical Report
summary: In this report, we introduce the IQuest-Coder-V1 series-(7B/14B/40B/40B-Loop), a new family of code large language models (LLMs). Moving beyond static code representations, we propose the code-flow multi-stage training paradigm, which captures the dynamic evolution of software logic through different phases of the pipeline. Our models are developed through the evolutionary pipeline, starting with the initial pre-training consisting of code facts, repository, and completion data. Following that, we implement a specialized mid-training stage that integrates reasoning and agentic trajectories in 32k-context and repository-scale in 128k-context to forge deep logical foundations. The models are then finalized with post-training of specialized coding capabilities, which is bifurcated into two specialized paths: the thinking path (utilizing reasoning-driven RL) and the instruct path (optimized for general assistance). IQuest-Coder-V1 achieves state-of-the-art performance among competitive models across critical dimensions of code intelligence: agentic software engineering, competitive programming, and complex tool use. To address deployment constraints, the IQuest-Coder-V1-Loop variant introduces a recurrent mechanism designed to optimize the trade-off between model capacity and deployment footprint, offering an architecturally enhanced path for efficacy-efficiency trade-off. We believe the release of the IQuest-Coder-V1 series, including the complete white-box chain of checkpoints from pre-training bases to the final thinking and instruction models, will advance research in autonomous code intelligence and real-world agentic systems.

title: Differential Harm Propensity in Personalized LLM Agents: The Curious Case of Mental Health Disclosure
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as tool-using agents, shifting safety concerns from harmful text generation to harmful task completion. Deployed systems often condition on user profiles or persistent memory, yet agent safety evaluations typically ignore personalization signals. To address this gap, we investigated how mental health disclosure, a sensitive and realistic user-context cue, affects harmful behavior in agentic settings. Building on the AgentHarm benchmark, we evaluated frontier and open-source LLMs on multi-step malicious tasks (and their benign counterparts) under controlled prompt conditions that vary user-context personalization (no bio, bio-only, bio+mental health disclosure) and include a lightweight jailbreak injection. Our results reveal that harmful task completion is non-trivial across models: frontier lab models (e.g., GPT 5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 3-Pro) still complete a measurable fraction of harmful tasks, while an open model (DeepSeek 3.2) exhibits substantially higher harmful completion. Adding a bio-only context generally reduces harm scores and increases refusals. Adding an explicit mental health disclosure often shifts outcomes further in the same direction, though effects are modest and not uniformly reliable after multiple-testing correction. Importantly, the refusal increase also appears on benign tasks, indicating a safety--utility trade-off via over-refusal. Finally, jailbreak prompting sharply elevates harm relative to benign conditions and can weaken or override the protective shift induced by personalization. Taken together, our results indicate that personalization can act as a weak protective factor in agentic misuse settings, but it is fragile under minimal adversarial pressure, highlighting the need for personalization-aware evaluations and safeguards that remain robust across user-context conditions.

title: Ember: A Serverless Peer-to-Peer End-to-End Encrypted Messaging System over an IPv6 Mesh Network
summary: This paper presents Ember, a serverless peer-to-peer messaging system providing end-to-end encrypted communication over a decentralised IPv6 mesh network. Ember operates without central servers, enforces data minimisation through ciphertext-only local storage and time-based message expiration, and prioritises architectural clarity, explicit trust boundaries, and practical deployability on Android. The paper describes the system architecture, cryptographic design, network model, and security properties -- including dynamic testing results demonstrating that no plaintext is recoverable from captured network traffic -- and discusses limitations and future work

title: World Reconstruction From Inconsistent Views
summary: Video diffusion models generate high-quality and diverse worlds; however, individual frames often lack 3D consistency across the output sequence, which makes the reconstruction of 3D worlds difficult. To this end, we propose a new method that handles these inconsistencies by non-rigidly aligning the video frames into a globally-consistent coordinate frame that produces sharp and detailed pointcloud reconstructions. First, a geometric foundation model lifts each frame into a pixel-wise 3D pointcloud, which contains unaligned surfaces due to these inconsistencies. We then propose a tailored non-rigid iterative frame-to-model ICP to obtain an initial alignment across all frames, followed by a global optimization that further sharpens the pointcloud. Finally, we leverage this pointcloud as initialization for 3D reconstruction and propose a novel inverse deformation rendering loss to create high quality and explorable 3D environments from inconsistent views. We demonstrate that our 3D scenes achieve higher quality than baselines, effectively turning video models into 3D-consistent world generators.

title: Retrieving Counterfactuals Improves Visual In-Context Learning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive performance across a wide range of multimodal reasoning tasks, but they often struggle to disentangle fine-grained visual attributes and reason about underlying causal relationships. In-context learning (ICL) offers a promising avenue for VLMs to adapt to new tasks, but its effectiveness critically depends on the selection of demonstration examples. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches typically rely on passive similarity-based retrieval, which tends to select correlated but non-causal examples, amplifying spurious associations and limiting model robustness. We introduce CIRCLES (Composed Image Retrieval for Causal Learning Example Selection), a novel framework that actively constructs demonstration sets by retrieving counterfactual-style examples through targeted, attribute-guided composed image retrieval. By incorporating counterfactual-style examples, CIRCLES enables VLMs to implicitly reason about the causal relations between attributes and outcomes, moving beyond superficial correlations and fostering more robust and grounded reasoning. Comprehensive experiments on four diverse datasets demonstrate that CIRCLES consistently outperforms existing methods across multiple architectures, especially on small-scale models, with pronounced gains under information scarcity. Furthermore, CIRCLES retrieves more diverse and causally informative examples, providing qualitative insights into how models leverage in-context demonstrations for improved reasoning. Our code is available at https://github.com/gzxiong/CIRCLES.

title: MedCL-Bench: Benchmarking stability-efficiency trade-offs and scaling in biomedical continual learning
summary: Medical language models must be updated as evidence and terminology evolve, yet sequential updating can trigger catastrophic forgetting. Although biomedical NLP has many static benchmarks, no unified, task-diverse benchmark exists for evaluating continual learning under standardized protocols, robustness to task order and compute-aware reporting. We introduce MedCL-Bench, which streams ten biomedical NLP datasets spanning five task families and evaluates eleven continual learning strategies across eight task orders, reporting retention, transfer, and GPU-hour cost. Across backbones and task orders, direct sequential fine-tuning on incoming tasks induces catastrophic forgetting, causing update-induced performance regressions on prior tasks. Continual learning methods occupy distinct retention-compute frontiers: parameter-isolation provides the best retention per GPU-hour, replay offers strong protection at higher cost, and regularization yields limited benefit. Forgetting is task-dependent, with multi-label topic classification most vulnerable and constrained-output tasks more robust. MedCL-Bench provides a reproducible framework for auditing model updates before deployment.

title: SpecMoE: Spectral Mixture-of-Experts Foundation Model for Cross-Species EEG Decoding
comments: 34 pages (12 pages Main text and 22 pages Supplementary Information)
summary: Decoding the orchestration of neural activity in electroencephalography (EEG) signals is a central challenge in bridging neuroscience with artificial intelligence. Foundation models have made strides in generalized EEG decoding, yet many existing frameworks primarily relying on separate temporal and spectral masking of raw signals during self-supervised pretraining. Such strategies often tend to bias learning toward high-frequency oscillations, as low-frequency rhythmic patterns can be easily inferred from the unmasked signal. We introduce a foundation model that utilizes a novel Gaussian-smoothed masking scheme applied to short-time Fourier transform (STFT) maps. By jointly applying time, frequency, and time-frequency Gaussian masks, we make the reconstruction task much more challenging, forcing the model to learn intricate neural patterns across both high- and low-frequency domains. To effectively recover signals under this aggressive masking strategy, we design SpecHi-Net, a U-shaped hierarchical architecture with multiple encoding and decoding stages. To accelerate large-scale pretraining, we partition the data into three subsets, each used to train an independent expert model. We then combine these models through SpecMoE, a mixture of experts framework guided by a learned spectral gating mechanism. SpecMoE achieves state-of-the-art performance across a diverse set of EEG decoding tasks, including sleep staging, emotion recognition, motor imagery classification, abnormal signal detection, and drug effect prediction. Importantly, the model demonstrates strong cross-species and cross-subject generalization, maintaining high accuracy on both human and murine EEG datasets.

title: Bayesian Inference of Psychometric Variables From Brain and Behavior in Implicit Association Tests
comments: 43 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables, submitted to: Journal of Neural Engineering
summary:
Objective. We establish a principled method for inferring mental health related psychometric variables from neural and behavioral data using the Implicit Association Test (IAT) as the data generation engine, aiming to overcome the limited predictive performance (typically under 0.7 AUC) of the gold-standard D-score method, which relies solely on reaction times.
  Approach. We propose a sparse hierarchical Bayesian model that leverages multi-modal data to predict experiences related to mental illness symptoms in new participants. The model is a multivariate generalization of the D-score with trainable parameters, engineered for parameter efficiency in the small-cohort regime typical of IAT studies. Data from two IAT variants were analyzed: a suicidality-related E-IAT ($n=39$) and a psychosis-related PSY-IAT ($n=34$).
  Main Results. Our approach overcomes a high inter-individual variability and low within-session effect size in the dataset, reaching AUCs of 0.73 (E-IAT) and 0.76 (PSY-IAT) in the best modality configurations, though corrected 95% confidence intervals are wide ($\pm 0.18$) and results are marginally significant after FDR correction ($q=0.10$). Restricting the E-IAT to MDD participants improves AUC to 0.79 $[0.62, 0.97]$ (significant at $q=0.05$). Performance is on par with the best reference methods (shrinkage LDA and EEGNet) for each task, even when the latter were adapted to the task, while the proposed method was not. Accuracy was substantially above near-chance D-scores (0.50-0.53 AUC) in both tasks, with more consistent cross-task performance than any single reference method.
  Significance. Our framework shows promise for enhancing IAT-based assessment of experiences related to entrapment and psychosis, and potentially other mental health conditions, though further validation on larger and independent cohorts will be needed to establish clinical utility.
comment: 43 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables, submitted to: Journal of Neural Engineering

title: When the City Teaches the Car: Label-Free 3D Perception from Infrastructure
summary: Building robust 3D perception for self-driving still relies heavily on large-scale data collection and manual annotation, yet this paradigm becomes impractical as deployment expands across diverse cities and regions. Meanwhile, modern cities are increasingly instrumented with roadside units (RSUs), static sensors deployed along roads and at intersections to monitor traffic. This raises a natural question: can the city itself help train the vehicle? We propose infrastructure-taught, label-free 3D perception, a paradigm in which RSUs act as stationary, unsupervised teachers for ego vehicles. Leveraging their fixed viewpoints and repeated observations, RSUs learn local 3D detectors from unlabeled data and broadcast predictions to passing vehicles, which are aggregated as pseudo-label supervision for training a standalone ego detector. The resulting model requires no infrastructure or communication at test time. We instantiate this idea as a fully label-free three-stage pipeline and conduct a concept-and-feasibility study in a CARLA-based multi-agent environment. With CenterPoint, our pipeline achieves 82.3% AP for detecting vehicles, compared to a fully supervised ego upper bound of 94.4%. We further systematically analyze each stage, evaluate its scalability, and demonstrate complementarity with existing ego-centric label-free methods. Together, these results suggest that city infrastructure itself can potentially provide a scalable supervisory signal for autonomous vehicles, positioning infrastructure-taught learning as a promising orthogonal paradigm for reducing annotation cost in 3D perception.

title: Nonstandard Errors in AI Agents
summary: We study whether state-of-the-art AI coding agents, given the same data and research question, produce the same empirical results. Deploying 150 autonomous Claude Code agents to independently test six hypotheses about market quality trends in NYSE TAQ data for SPY (2015--2024), we find that AI agents exhibit sizable \textit{nonstandard errors} (NSEs), that is, uncertainty from agent-to-agent variation in analytical choices, analogous to those documented among human researchers. AI agents diverge substantially on measure choice (e.g., autocorrelation vs.\ variance ratio, dollar vs.\ share volume). Different model families (Sonnet 4.6 vs.\ Opus 4.6) exhibit stable ``empirical styles,'' reflecting systematic differences in methodological preferences. In a three-stage feedback protocol, AI peer review (written critiques) has minimal effect on dispersion, whereas exposure to top-rated exemplar papers reduces the interquartile range of estimates by 80--99\% within \textit{converging} measure families. Convergence occurs both through within-family estimation tightening and through agents switching measure families entirely, but convergence reflects imitation rather than understanding. These findings have implications for the growing use of AI in automated policy evaluation and empirical research.

title: Persistent Device Identity for Network Access Control in the Era of MAC Address Randomization: A RADIUS-Based Framework
summary: Modern operating systems increasingly randomize Media Access Control (MAC) addresses to protect user privacy, fundamentally disrupting Network Access Control (NAC) systems that have relied on MAC addresses as persistent device identifiers for over two decades. This disruption affects critical enterprise environments including federal government agencies operating under FISMA, healthcare organizations subject to HIPAA, financial institutions governed by PCI-DSS, and educational networks managing large-scale BYOD deployments. This paper presents a comprehensive framework for maintaining persistent device identity in NAC environments through a RADIUS protocol-based approach that assigns and distributes a Globally Unique Identifier (GUID) to endpoints via RADIUS Access-Accept messages. The proposed architecture addresses the complete device lifecycle including initial enrollment, re-authentication across randomized addresses, device management integration, certificate-based identity binding, and device attribute correlation. We describe the framework's design across six distinct use cases -- BYOD, managed devices, VPN-based posture assessment, non-VPN posture, guest access, and IoT device profiling -- and analyze its effectiveness in maintaining device visibility, accurate license counting, and regulatory compliance under continuous MAC address randomization. The approach is compatible with existing 802.1X and MAB infrastructure, requires no client-side operating system modifications, and aligns with the recently published RFC 9797 and IEEE 802.11bh-2024 standards. Our framework enables organizations to maintain regulatory compliance while preserving the privacy benefits that MAC address randomization was designed to provide.

title: Semi-supervised Latent Disentangled Diffusion Model for Textile Pattern Generation
comments: 9 pages, 7 figures, acceptted by AAAI2026, the code is available at https://github.com/Cg-Hu/SLDDM-TPG
summary: Textile pattern generation (TPG) aims to synthesize fine-grained textile pattern images based on given clothing images. Although previous studies have not explicitly investigated TPG, existing image-to-image models appear to be natural candidates for this task. However, when applied directly, these methods often produce unfaithful results, failing to preserve fine-grained details due to feature confusion between complex textile patterns and the inherent non-rigid texture distortions in clothing images. In this paper, we propose a novel method, SLDDM-TPG, for faithful and high-fidelity TPG. Our method consists of two stages: (1) a latent disentangled network (LDN) that resolves feature confusion in clothing representations and constructs a multi-dimensional, independent clothing feature space; and (2) a semi-supervised latent diffusion model (S-LDM), which receives guidance signals from LDN and generates faithful results through semi-supervised diffusion training, combined with our designed fine-grained alignment strategy. Extensive evaluations show that SLDDM-TPG reduces FID by 4.1 and improves SSIM by up to 0.116 on our CTP-HD dataset, and also demonstrate good generalization on the VITON-HD dataset.

title: Fine-Grained Network Traffic Classification with Contextual QoS Profiling
summary: Accurate network traffic classification is vital for managing modern applications with strict Quality of Service (QoS) demands, such as edge computing, real-time XR, and autonomous systems. While recent advances in application-level classification show high accuracy, they often miss fine-grained in-app QoS variations critical for service differentiation. This paper proposes a hierarchical graph neural network (GNN) framework that combines a three-level graph representation with an automated QoS-aware assignment algorithm. The model captures multi-scale temporal patterns via packet aggregation, time-window clustering, and session-level behavior modeling. QoS priorities are derived using five key metrics (bandwidth, jitter, packet stability, burst frequency, and burst stability), processed through logarithmic transformation and weighted ranking. Evaluations across 14 usage scenarios from YouTube, Prime Video, TikTok, and Zoom show that the proposed GNN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in service-level classification. The QoS-aware assignment further refines classification to enhance user experience. This work advances QoS-aware traffic classification by enabling precise in-app usage differentiation and adaptive service prioritization in dynamic network environments.

title: Probing Cultural Signals in Large Language Models through Author Profiling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in applications with societal impact, raising concerns about the cultural biases they encode. We probe these representations by evaluating whether LLMs can perform author profiling from song lyrics in a zero-shot setting, inferring singers' gender and ethnicity without task-specific fine-tuning. Across several open-source models evaluated on more than 10,000 lyrics, we find that LLMs achieve non-trivial profiling performance but demonstrate systematic cultural alignment: most models default toward North American ethnicity, while DeepSeek-1.5B aligns more strongly with Asian ethnicity. This finding emerges from both the models' prediction distributions and an analysis of their generated rationales. To quantify these disparities, we introduce two fairness metrics, Modality Accuracy Divergence (MAD) and Recall Divergence (RD), and show that Ministral-8B displays the strongest ethnicity bias among the evaluated models, whereas Gemma-12B shows the most balanced behavior. Our code is available on GitHub (https://github.com/ValentinLafargue/CulturalProbingLLM).

title: Thermopneumatic Pixels for Fast, Localized, Low-Voltage Touch Feedback
summary: We present thermopneumatic pixels (TPPs), which are tactile actuators designed for rapid fabrication and straightforward integration into compact wearable and surface-based haptic systems. Each TPP converts low-voltage ($\sim$10 V) electrical pulses into transient pressure increases within a sealed cavity, producing out-of-plane forces and displacements suitable for tactile stimulation. The architecture enables scalable fabrication and spatially distributed actuation while maintaining simple electrical interfacing. The TPPs are constructed from inexpensive, readily available materials using straightforward layer-based assembly, facilitating rapid prototyping and integration into interactive devices. Mechanical characterization demonstrates peak forces exceeding 1 N and millimeter displacements. We further present driving electronics for operating multiple TPP modules concurrently and report perceptual study results demonstrating the effectiveness of the resulting tactile feedback. Together, these results establish low-voltage thermopneumatic actuation as an accessible and high-performance approach for embedding tactile feedback into experimental and consumer-facing interfaces.

title: Finding Common Ground in a Sea of Alternatives
summary: We study the problem of selecting a statement that finds common ground across diverse population preferences. Generative AI is uniquely suited for this task because it can access a practically infinite set of statements, but AI systems like the Habermas machine leave the choice of generated statement to a voting rule. What it means for this rule to find common ground, however, is not well-defined. In this work, we propose a formal model for finding common ground in the infinite alternative setting based on the proportional veto core from social choice. To provide guarantees relative to these infinitely many alternatives and a large population, we wish to satisfy a notion of proportional veto core using only query access to the unknown distribution of alternatives and voters. We design an efficient sampling-based algorithm that returns an alternative in the (approximate) proportional veto core with high probability and prove matching lower bounds, which show that no algorithm can do the same using fewer queries. On a synthetic dataset of preferences over text, we confirm the effectiveness of our sampling-based algorithm and compare other social choice methods as well as LLM-based methods in terms of how reliably they produce statements in the proportional veto core.

title: A Practical Algorithm for Feature-Rich, Non-Stationary Bandit Problems
summary: Contextual bandits are incredibly useful in many practical problems. We go one step further by devising a more realistic problem that combines: (1) contextual bandits with dense arm features, (2) non-linear reward functions, and (3) a generalization of correlated bandits where reward distributions change over time but the degree of correlation maintains. This formulation lends itself to a wider set of applications such as recommendation tasks. To solve this problem, we introduce conditionally coupled contextual C3 Thompson sampling for Bernoulli bandits. It combines an improved Nadaraya-Watson estimator on an embedding space with Thompson sampling that allows online learning without retraining. Empirical results show that C3 outperforms the next best algorithm by 5.7% lower average cumulative regret on four OpenML tabular datasets as well as demonstrating a 12.4% click lift on Microsoft News Dataset (MIND) compared to other algorithms.

title: pADAM: A Plug-and-Play All-in-One Diffusion Architecture for Multi-Physics Learning
summary: Generalizing across disparate physical laws remains a fundamental challenge for artificial intelligence in science. Existing deep-learning solvers are largely confined to single-equation settings, limiting transfer across physical regimes and inference tasks. Here we introduce pADAM, a unified generative framework that learns a shared probabilistic prior across heterogeneous partial differential equation families. Through a learned joint distribution of system states and, where applicable, physical parameters, pADAM supports forward prediction and inverse inference within a single architecture without retraining. Across benchmarks ranging from scalar diffusion to nonlinear Navier--Stokes equations, pADAM achieves accurate inference even under sparse observations. Combined with conformal prediction, it also provides reliable uncertainty quantification with coverage guarantees. In addition, pADAM performs probabilistic model selection from only two sparse snapshots, identifying governing laws through its learned generative representation. These results highlight the potential of generative multi-physics modeling for unified and uncertainty-aware scientific inference.

title: SuCor: Susceptibility Distortion Correction via Parameter-Free and Self-Regularized Optimal Transport
summary: We present SuCor, a method for correcting susceptibility induced geometric distortions in echo planar imaging (EPI) using optimal transport (OT) along the phase encoding direction. Given a pair of reversed phase encoding EPI volumes, we model each column of the distortion field as a Wasserstein-2 barycentric displacement between the opposing-polarity intensity profiles. Regularization is performed in the spectral domain using a bending-energy penalty whose strength is selected automatically via the Morozov discrepancy principle, requiring no manual tuning. On a human connectome project (HCP) dataset with left-right/right-left b0 EPI pairs and a co-registered T1 structural reference, SuCor achieves a mean volumetric mutual information of 0.341 with the T1 image, compared to 0.317 for FSL TOPUP, while running in approximately 12 seconds on a single CPU core.

title: TurnWise: The Gap between Single- and Multi-turn Language Model Capabilities
summary: Multi-turn conversations are a common and critical mode of language model interaction. However, current open training and evaluation data focus on single-turn settings, failing to capture the additional dimension of these longer interactions. To understand this multi-/single-turn gap, we first introduce a new benchmark, TurnWiseEval, for multi-turn capabilities that is directly comparable to single-turn chat evaluation. Our evaluation isolates multi-turn specific conversational ability through pairwise comparison to equivalent single-turn settings. We additionally introduce our synthetic multi-turn data pipeline TurnWiseData which allows the scalable generation of multi-turn training data. Our experiments with Olmo 3 show that training with multi-turn data is vital to achieving strong multi-turn chat performance, and that including as little as 10k multi-turn conversations during post-training can lead to a 12% improvement on TurnWiseEval.

title: Dual Stream Independence Decoupling for True Emotion Recognition under Masked Expressions
summary: Recongnizing true emotions from masked expressions is extremely challenging due to deliberate concealment. Existing paradigms recognize true emotions from masked-expression clips that contain onsetframes just starting to disguise. However, this paradigm may not reflect the actual disguised state, as the onsetframe leaks the true emotional information without reaching a stable disguise state. Thus, this paper introduces a novel apexframe-based paradigm that classifies true emotions from the apexframe with a stable disguised state. Furthermore, this paper proposes a novel dual stream independence decoupling framework that decouples true and disguised emotion features, avoiding the interference of disguised emotions on true emotions. For efficient decoupling, we design a decoupling loss group, comprising two classification losses that learn true emotion and disguised expression features, respectively, and a Hilbert-Schmidt Independence loss that enhances the independence of two features. Experiments demonstrate that the apexframe-based paradigm is challenging, and the proposed decouple framework improves recogntion performances.

title: SOMP: Scalable Gradient Inversion for Large Language Models via Subspace-Guided Orthogonal Matching Pursuit
summary: Gradient inversion attacks reveal that private training text can be reconstructed from shared gradients, posing a privacy risk to large language models (LLMs). While prior methods perform well in small-batch settings, scaling to larger batch sizes and longer sequences remains challenging due to severe signal mixing, high computational cost, and degraded fidelity. We present SOMP (Subspace-Guided Orthogonal Matching Pursuit), a scalable gradient inversion framework that casts text recovery from aggregated gradients as a sparse signal recovery problem. Our key insight is that aggregated transformer gradients retain exploitable head-wise geometric structure together with sample-level sparsity. SOMP leverages these properties to progressively narrow the search space and disentangle mixed signals without exhaustive search. Experiments across multiple LLM families, model scales, and five languages show that SOMP consistently outperforms prior methods in the aggregated-gradient regime.For long sequences at batch size B=16, SOMP achieves substantially higher reconstruction fidelity than strong baselines, while remaining computationally competitive. Even under extreme aggregation (up to B=128), SOMP still recovers meaningful text, suggesting that privacy leakage can persist in regimes where prior attacks become much less effective.

title: Overlapping Covariance Intersection: Fusion with Partial Structural Knowledge of Correlation from Multiple Sources
summary: Emerging large-scale engineering systems rely on distributed fusion for situational awareness, where agents combine noisy local sensor measurements with exchanged information to obtain fused estimates. However, at the sheer scale of these systems, tracking cross-correlations becomes infeasible, preventing the use of optimal filters. Covariance intersection (CI) methods address fusion problems with unknown correlations by minimizing worst-case uncertainty based on available information. Existing CI extensions exploit limited correlation knowledge but cannot incorporate structural knowledge of correlation from multiple sources, which naturally arises in distributed fusion problems. This paper introduces Overlapping Covariance Intersection (OCI), a generalized CI framework that accommodates this novel information structure. We formalize the OCI problem and establish necessary and sufficient conditions for feasibility. We show that a family-optimal solution can be computed efficiently via semidefinite programming, enabling real-time implementation. The proposed tools enable improved fusion performance for large-scale systems while retaining robustness to unknown correlations.

title: GDPO-SR: Group Direct Preference Optimization for One-Step Generative Image Super-Resolution
summary: Recently, reinforcement learning (RL) has been employed for improving generative image super-resolution (ISR) performance. However, the current efforts are focused on multi-step generative ISR, while one-step generative ISR remains underexplored due to its limited stochasticity. In addition, RL methods such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) require the generation of positive and negative sample pairs offline, leading to a limited number of samples, while Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) only calculates the likelihood of the entire image, ignoring local details that are crucial for ISR. In this paper, we propose Group Direct Preference Optimization (GDPO), a novel approach to integrate RL into one-step generative ISR model training. First, we introduce a noise-aware one-step diffusion model that can generate diverse ISR outputs. To prevent performance degradation caused by noise injection, we introduce an unequal-timestep strategy to decouple the timestep of noise addition from that of diffusion. We then present the GDPO strategy, which integrates the principle of GRPO into DPO, to calculate the group-relative advantage of each online generated sample for model optimization. Meanwhile, an attribute-aware reward function is designed to dynamically evaluate the score of each sample based on its statistics of smooth and texture areas. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of GDPO in enhancing the performance of one-step generative ISR models. Code: https://github.com/Joyies/GDPO.

AI.conclusion: GDPO是一种有效的方法，能够将强化学习集成到一步生成图像超分辨率模型的训练中，解决了现有方法在样本数量和细节处理方面的局限性。
AI.translation: 近期，强化学习（RL）已被用于改进生成图像超分辨率（ISR）的性能。然而，目前的努力集中在多步生成ISR，而一步生成ISR由于其有限的随机性而未得到充分探索。此外，像直接偏好优化（DPO）这样的RL方法需要离线生成正负样本对，导致样本数量有限，而组相对策略优化（GRPO）仅计算整个图像的似然，忽略了对ISR至关重要的局部细节。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，即组直接偏好优化（GDPO），将RL集成到一步生成ISR模型训练中。首先，我们引入了一个噪声感知的、能够生成多样化ISR输出的一步扩散模型。为了防止噪声注入导致的性能下降，我们引入了一种不等步长策略，将噪声添加的时间步与扩散的时间步解耦。然后，我们提出了GDPO策略，它将GRPO的原理整合到DPO中，为模型优化计算每个在线生成样本的组相对优势。同时，设计了一个属性感知的奖励函数，根据每个样本的平滑和纹理区域的统计信息动态评估其得分。实验证明GDPO在提升一步生成ISR模型性能方面是有效的。代码：https://github.com/Joyies/GDPO。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为GDPO（Group Direct Preference Optimization）的新型强化学习方法，用于解决一步生成图像超分辨率（ISR）模型训练中的挑战。GDPO通过结合噪声感知的一步扩散模型和不等步长策略来生成多样化的ISR结果，并改进了样本选择和评估机制。它借鉴了GRPO的组相对优势计算思想，并将其应用于DPO框架，同时引入属性感知奖励函数，根据样本的平滑和纹理区域特征进行动态评分。实验结果表明，GDPO能够有效提升一步生成ISR模型的性能。
AI.keywords: 图像超分辨率, 强化学习, 一步生成, 直接偏好优化, 组相对策略优化
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法GDPO，将强化学习应用于一步生成图像超分辨率领域，解决了现有方法样本数量有限和忽略局部细节的问题。通过结合噪声感知扩散模型、不等步长策略、GRPO与DPO的融合以及属性感知奖励函数，GDPO在理论和实践上都具有重要意义。然而，该方法在计算复杂度、对噪声鲁棒性的进一步评估以及在不同数据集上的泛化能力方面可能需要进一步的研究。

title: Beyond Cybathlon: On-demand Quadrupedal Assistance for People with Limited Mobility
summary:
Background: Assistance robots have the potential to increase the independence of people who need daily care due to limited mobility or being wheelchair-bound. Current solutions of attaching robotic arms to motorized wheelchairs offer limited additional mobility at the cost of increased size and reduced wheelchair maneuverability.
  Methods: We present an on-demand quadrupedal assistance robot system controlled via a shared autonomy approach, which combines semi-autonomous task execution with human teleoperation. Due to the mobile nature of the system it can assist the operator whenever needed and perform autonomous tasks independently, without otherwise restricting their mobility. We automate pick-and-place tasks, as well as robot movement through the environment with semantic, collision-aware navigation.
