title: GeoBridge: A Semantic-Anchored Multi-View Foundation Model Bridging Images and Text for Geo-Localization
summary: Cross-view geo-localization infers a location by retrieving geo-tagged reference images that visually correspond to a query image. However, the traditional satellite-centric paradigm limits robustness when high-resolution or up-to-date satellite imagery is unavailable. It further underexploits complementary cues across views (\eg, drone, satellite, and street) and modalities (\eg, language and image). To address these challenges, we propose GeoBridge, a novel model that performs bidirectional matching across views and supports language-to-image retrieval. Going beyond traditional satellite-centric formulations, GeoBridge builds on a novel semantic-anchor mechanism that bridges multi-view features through textual descriptions for robust, flexible localization. In support of this task, we construct GeoLoc, the first large-scale, cross-modal, and multi-view aligned dataset comprising over 50,000 pairs of drone, street-view panorama, and satellite images as well as their textual descriptions, collected from 36 countries, ensuring both geographic and semantic alignment. We performed broad evaluations across multiple tasks. Experiments confirm that GeoLoc pre-training markedly improves geo-location accuracy for GeoBridge while promoting cross-domain generalization and cross-modal knowledge transfer. Code, dataset, and pretrained models will be released at https://github.com/MiliLab/GeoBridge.

title: UserSimCRS v2: Simulation-Based Evaluation for Conversational Recommender Systems
comments: Proceedings of the 48th European Conference on Information Retrieval (ECIR '26), 2026
summary: Resources for simulation-based evaluation of conversational recommender systems (CRSs) are scarce. The UserSimCRS toolkit was introduced to address this gap. In this work, we present UserSimCRS v2, a significant upgrade aligning the toolkit with state-of-the-art research. Key extensions include an enhanced agenda-based user simulator, introduction of large language model-based simulators, integration for a wider range of CRSs and datasets, and new LLM-as-a-judge evaluation utilities. We demonstrate these extensions in a case study.
comment: Proceedings of the 48th European Conference on Information Retrieval (ECIR '26), 2026

title: Order Matters: 3D Shape Generation from Sequential VR Sketches
summary: VR sketching lets users explore and iterate on ideas directly in 3D, offering a faster and more intuitive alternative to conventional CAD tools. However, existing sketch-to-shape models ignore the temporal ordering of strokes, discarding crucial cues about structure and design intent. We introduce VRSketch2Shape, the first framework and multi-category dataset for generating 3D shapes from sequential VR sketches. Our contributions are threefold: (i) an automated pipeline that generates sequential VR sketches from arbitrary shapes, (ii) a dataset of over 20k synthetic and 900 hand-drawn sketch-shape pairs across four categories, and (iii) an order-aware sketch encoder coupled with a diffusion-based 3D generator. Our approach yields higher geometric fidelity than prior work, generalizes effectively from synthetic to real sketches with minimal supervision, and performs well even on partial sketches. All data and models will be released open-source at https://chenyizi086.github.io/VRSketch2Shape_website.

title: LeAD-M3D: Leveraging Asymmetric Distillation for Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection
comments: Johannes Meier and Jonathan Michel - both authors contributed equally. Project page: https://deepscenario.github.io/LeAD-M3D/
summary: Real-time monocular 3D object detection remains challenging due to severe depth ambiguity, viewpoint shifts, and the high computational cost of 3D reasoning. Existing approaches either rely on LiDAR or geometric priors to compensate for missing depth or sacrifice efficiency to achieve competitive accuracy. We introduce LeAD-M3D, a monocular 3D detector that achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and real-time inference without extra modalities. Our method is enabled by three key components. Asymmetric Augmentation Denoising Distillation (A2D2) transfers geometric knowledge from a clean-image teacher to a MixUp-noised student via a quality- and importance-weighted depth-feature loss, enabling stronger depth reasoning without LiDAR. 3D-aware Consistent Matching (CM$_{\text{3D}}$) improves prediction-to-ground truth assignment by integrating 3D MGIoU into the matching score, yielding stable and precise supervision. Finally, Confidence-Gated 3D Inference (CGI$_{\text{3D}}$) accelerates inference by restricting expensive 3D regression to confident regions. Together, these contributions set a new Pareto frontier for monocular 3D detection: LeAD-M3D achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on KITTI and Waymo, and the best reported car AP on Rope3D, while running up to 3.6$\,\times$ faster than prior high-accuracy models (e.g., MonoDiff). LeAD-M3D demonstrates that high fidelity and real-time monocular 3D detection is simultaneously attainable, without LiDAR, stereo, or strong geometric assumptions.
comment: Johannes Meier and Jonathan Michel - both authors contributed equally. Project page: https://deepscenario.github.io/LeAD-M3D/

title: Safe Output Regulation of Coupled Hyperbolic PDE-ODE Systems
summary: This paper presents a safe output regulation control strategy for a class of systems modeled by a coupled $2\times 2$ hyperbolic PDE-ODE structure, subject to fully distributed disturbances throughout the system. A state-feedback controller is developed by the {nonovershooting backstepping} method to simultaneously achieve exponential output regulation and enforce safety constraints on the regulated output that is the state furthest from the control input. To handle unmeasurable states and external disturbances, a state observer and a disturbance estimator are designed. Explicit bounds on the estimation errors are derived and used to construct a robust safe regulator that accounts for the uncertainties. The proposed control scheme guarantees that: 1) If the regulated output is initially within the safe region, it remains there; otherwise, it will be rescued to the safety within a prescribed time; 2) The output tracking error converges to zero exponentially; 3) The observer accurately estimates both the distributed states and external disturbances, with estimation errors converging to zero exponentially; 4) All signals in the closed-loop system remain bounded. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated through a UAV delivery scenario with a cable-suspended payload, where the payload is regulated to track a desired reference while avoiding collisions with barriers.

title: S2WMamba: A Wavelet-Assisted Mamba-Based Dual-Branch Network For Pansharpening
summary: Pansharpening fuses a high-resolution panchromatic (PAN) image with a low-resolution multispectral (LRMS) image to produce a high-resolution multispectral (HRMS) image. A key difficulty is that jointly processing PAN and MS features often entangles spatial detail enhancement with spectral fidelity. To address this feature entanglement, we propose S2WMamba, a framework that explicitly disentangles modality-specific frequency information for highly controlled crossmodal interaction. Concretely, unlike global frequency transforms, a localized 2D Haar DWT is applied to the PAN image to precisely isolate spatial edges and textures. Concurrently, a novel channel-wise 1D Haar DWT treats each pixel's spectrum as a 1D signal, isolating the shared spectral base from band-specific variations to strictly limit spectral distortion. The resulting Spectral branch injects wavelet-extracted spatial details into MS features, while the Spatial branch refines PAN features using spectra from the DWT1D process. To overcome inadequate frequency fusion, the two branches exchange information via Mambabased cross-modulation, which explicitly models long-range dependencies across these decoupled sub-bands with linear complexity. On WV3, GF2, and QB datasets, S2WMamba matches or surpasses recent strong baselines (FusionMamba, CANNet, U2Net, PanNet), improving PSNR by up to 0.23 dB and reaching an HQNR of 0.956 on full-resolution WV3. Extensive ablations justify the modality-specific DWT placement and the parallel dual-branch architecture.

title: COREA: Coupled Relightable 3D Gaussians and SDFs for Efficient Normal Alignment
summary: We present COREA, the first unified three-tasks framework that couples an SDF and relightable 3D Gaussians (3DGS) to jointly support SH-based novel-view synthesis (NVS), surface reconstruction, and inverse physically-based rendering (inverse PBR). While recent relightable 3DGS methods have progressed, inverse PBR remains bottlenecked by normal estimation, as the discrete nature of 3DGS often yields oversmoothed and unstable normals. To address this limitation, COREA couples the complementary geometric properties of an SDF and relightable 3DGS on a shared underlying surface, where geometry-constrained relightable 3DGS provides reliable depth signals to anchor SDF geometry and the continuous SDF normal field provides spatially consistent supervision for Gaussian normal learning. We couple these signals through depth-guided alignment and normal supervision with normal-aware densification, and introduce Dual-Density Control to regulate densification by balancing photometric and geometric gradients for stable, memory-efficient training. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that COREA is the only framework that supports all three tasks, achieving competitive performance overall, with particularly superior results in inverse PBR.

title: Coherent Audio-Visual Editing via Conditional Audio Generation Following Video Edits
summary: We introduce a novel pipeline for joint audio-visual editing that enhances the coherence between edited video and its accompanying audio. Our approach first applies state-of-the-art video editing techniques to produce the target video, then performs audio editing to align with the visual changes. To achieve this, we present a new video-to-audio generation model that conditions on the source audio, target video, and a text prompt. We extend the model architecture to incorporate conditional audio input and propose a data augmentation strategy that improves training efficiency. Furthermore, our model dynamically adjusts the influence of the source audio based on the complexity of the edits, preserving the original audio structure where possible. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in maintaining audio-visual alignment and content integrity.

title: A Dynamic Time Warping-Transfer Learning Approach to Transferring Knowledge in Stress-strain Behaviors from Polymers to Metals: An Affordable and Generalizable Additive Manufacturing Part Qualification Framework
summary: Part qualification in additive manufacturing (AM) ensures that additively manufactured parts can be consistently produced and reliably used in critical applications. One crucial aspect of part qualification is to determine the complex stress-strain behavior of additively manufactured parts. However, conventional part qualification techniques such as the destructive testing and non-destructive testing are costly and time consuming, especially for metal AM. To address this challenge, we develop a dynamic time warping (DTW)-transfer learning (TL) framework for AM part qualification by transferring knowledge gained from the stress-strain behaviors of additively manufactured low-cost polymers to high-performance, expensive metals. Specifically, the framework selects one single optimal polymer dataset that is the most similar to the metal dataset in the target domain using DTW among multiple polymer datasets, including Nylon, PLA, CF-ABS, and Resin. A long short-term memory (LSTM) model is then trained on one single optimal polymer dataset and tested on one of three target metal datasets, including AlSi10Mg, Ti6Al4V, and carbon steel datasets. Experimental results show that the Resin dataset is selected as the optimal polymer dataset in the source domain for the AlSi10Mg and Ti6Al4V datasets, while the Nylon dataset is selected as the optimal polymer dataset in the source domain for the carbon steel dataset. The DTWTL model trained on one single optimal polymer dataset as the source domain achieves the best predictive performance, including an average mean absolute percentage error of 12.41%, an average root mean squared error of 63.75, and an average coefficient of determination of 0.96 when three metals are used as the target domain, outperforming the vanilla LSTM model without TL as well as the TL model trained on all four polymer datasets as the source domain.

AI.title_translation: 一种动态时间规整-迁移学习方法，用于将应力-应变行为知识从聚合物转移到金属：一种经济且通用的增材制造零件鉴定框架
AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一种动态时间规整-迁移学习（DTW-TL）框架，通过将低成本聚合物的应力-应变行为知识迁移到高性能金属，以经济高效地鉴定增材制造零件。
AI.motivation: 增材制造（AM）中的零件鉴定对于确保零件在关键应用中可靠使用至关重要，但传统的破坏性或非破坏性测试成本高昂且耗时，特别是对于金属AM。
AI.method: 开发了一个动态时间规整（DTW）-迁移学习（TL）框架。该框架使用DTW从多个聚合物数据集中（包括尼龙、PLA、CF-ABS和树脂）选择与目标金属数据集最相似的单个最优聚合物数据集。然后，在一个最优聚合物数据集上训练长短期记忆（LSTM）模型，并在AlSi10Mg、Ti6Al4V和碳钢这三个目标金属数据集中的一个上进行测试。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，对于AlSi10Mg和Ti6Al4V数据集，树脂数据集被选为源域中的最优聚合物数据集；对于碳钢数据集，尼龙数据集被选为最优聚合物数据集。DTW-TL模型在单个最优聚合物数据集上训练时，在三个金属作为目标域的情况下，实现了最佳预测性能，平均平均绝对百分比误差为12.41%，平均均方根误差为63.75，平均决定系数为0.96。这优于没有TL的普通LSTM模型以及在所有四个聚合物数据集上训练的TL模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过将低成本聚合物的应力-应变行为知识迁移到高性能金属，DTW-TL框架提供了一种经济高效且通用性强的增材制造零件鉴定方法，并显著提高了预测性能。
AI.translation: 增材制造（AM）中的零件鉴定确保了增材制造零件能够持续生产并可靠地用于关键应用。零件鉴定的一个关键方面是确定增材制造零件复杂的应力-应变行为。然而，传统的零件鉴定技术，如破坏性测试和非破坏性测试，成本高昂且耗时，特别是对于金属AM。为了解决这一挑战，我们开发了一种动态时间规整（DTW）-迁移学习（TL）框架，用于AM零件鉴定，通过将从增材制造低成本聚合物的应力-应变行为中获得的知识转移到高性能、昂贵的金属。具体来说，该框架使用DTW在多个聚合物数据集（包括尼龙、PLA、CF-ABS和树脂）中选择与目标域中金属数据集最相似的单个最优聚合物数据集。然后，在一个最优聚合物数据集上训练长短期记忆（LSTM）模型，并在AlSi10Mg、Ti6Al4V和碳钢这三个目标金属数据集中的一个上进行测试。实验结果表明，对于AlSi10Mg和Ti6Al4V数据集，树脂数据集被选为源域中的最优聚合物数据集，而对于碳钢数据集，尼龙数据集被选为源域中的最优聚合物数据集。当使用三种金属作为目标域时，在单个最优聚合物数据集上训练的DTW-TL模型实现了最佳预测性能，包括平均平均绝对百分比误差为12.41%，平均均方根误差为63.75，平均决定系数为0.96，优于没有TL的普通LSTM模型以及在所有四个聚合物数据集上训练的TL模型。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种动态时间规整-迁移学习（DTW-TL）框架，旨在解决增材制造（AM）零件鉴定中高成本和耗时的应力-应变行为测试问题。该框架通过DTW从低成本聚合物中选择与目标金属最相似的数据集，并利用LSTM模型将聚合物的应力-应变知识迁移到高性能金属。实验证明，该DTW-TL模型在预测金属应力-应变行为方面表现出色，其性能优于传统方法，为AM零件鉴定提供了一种经济高效且通用的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 增材制造, 零件鉴定, 动态时间规整, 迁移学习, 应力-应变行为
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于结合了动态时间规整（DTW）和迁移学习（TL），以解决增材制造中金属零件应力-应变行为鉴定的高成本问题。通过从低成本聚合物中智能选择最优源数据进行知识迁移，显著降低了实验成本和时间，同时保持了高预测精度。这种方法具有很强的通用性和实际应用价值，为AM领域提供了一个经济高效的质量控制框架。

title: Exposing Hidden Biases in Text-to-Image Models via Automated Prompt Search
comments: Accepted (poster) at the ICLR 2026 Workshop for Algorithmic Fairness Across Alignment Procedures and Agentic Systems
summary: Text-to-image (TTI) diffusion models have achieved remarkable visual quality, yet they have been repeatedly shown to exhibit social biases across sensitive attributes such as gender, race and age. To mitigate these biases, existing approaches frequently depend on curated prompt datasets - either manually constructed or generated with large language models (LLMs) - as part of their training and/or evaluation procedures. Beside the curation cost, this also risks overlooking unanticipated, less obvious prompts that trigger biased generation, even in models that have undergone debiasing. In this work, we introduce Bias-Guided Prompt Search (BGPS), a framework that automatically generates prompts that aim to maximize the presence of biases in the resulting images. BGPS comprises two components: (1) an LLM instructed to produce attribute-neutral prompts and (2) attribute classifiers acting on the TTI's internal representations that steer the decoding process of the LLM toward regions of the prompt space that amplify the image attributes of interest. We conduct extensive experiments on Stable Diffusion 1.5 and a state-of-the-art debiased model and discover an array of subtle and previously undocumented biases that severely deteriorate fairness metrics. Crucially, the discovered prompts are interpretable, i.e they may be entered by a typical user, quantitatively improving the perplexity metric compared to a prominent hard prompt optimization counterpart. Our findings uncover TTI vulnerabilities, while BGPS expands the bias search space and can act as a new evaluation tool for bias mitigation.
comment: Accepted (poster) at the ICLR 2026 Workshop for Algorithmic Fairness Across Alignment Procedures and Agentic Systems

AI.title_translation: 通过自动化提示搜索揭示文生图模型中的隐藏偏见
AI.tldr: 本文提出Bias-Guided Prompt Search (BGPS)框架，自动生成提示以最大化文生图模型中的偏见，揭示了即使是去偏模型也存在的微妙且未曾记录的隐藏社会偏见。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到图像（TTI）模型偏见缓解方法依赖于人工或LLM生成的精心策划的提示数据集，这不仅成本高昂，还可能忽略意外的、不明显的偏见触发提示，即使是经过去偏处理的模型也可能存在这些问题。
AI.method: 本文引入了偏见引导提示搜索（Bias-Guided Prompt Search, BGPS）框架，它自动生成旨在最大化图像中偏见存在的提示。BGPS包含两个组件：(1) 一个被指示生成属性中性提示的大型语言模型（LLM）；(2) 作用于TTI内部表示的属性分类器，这些分类器引导LLM的解码过程，使其朝向放大目标图像属性的提示空间区域。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion 1.5和最先进的去偏模型上进行了广泛实验，发现了许多微妙且以前未曾记录的偏见，这些偏见严重损害了公平性指标。重要的是，发现的提示是可解释的（即普通用户可以输入），与突出的硬提示优化方法相比，定量地改善了困惑度指标。
AI.conclusion: 我们的发现揭示了TTI模型的漏洞，而BGPS扩展了偏见搜索空间，可以作为偏见缓解的一种新评估工具。
AI.translation: 文本到图像（TTI）扩散模型已经达到了卓越的视觉质量，但它们被反复证明在性别、种族和年龄等敏感属性上表现出社会偏见。为了缓解这些偏见，现有方法常常依赖于精心策划的提示数据集——无论是手动构建还是使用大型语言模型（LLM）生成——作为其训练和/或评估程序的一部分。除了策划成本外，这还可能忽视那些意想不到的、不太明显的触发偏见生成的提示，即使是经过去偏处理的模型也是如此。在这项工作中，我们引入了偏见引导提示搜索（Bias-Guided Prompt Search, BGPS），一个自动生成旨在最大化生成图像中偏见存在的提示的框架。BGPS包含两个组件：(1) 一个被指示生成属性中性提示的LLM；(2) 作用于TTI内部表示的属性分类器，这些分类器引导LLM的解码过程，使其朝向放大目标图像属性的提示空间区域。我们在Stable Diffusion 1.5和最先进的去偏模型上进行了广泛实验，发现了许多微妙且以前未曾记录的偏见，这些偏见严重损害了公平性指标。重要的是，发现的提示是可解释的，即普通用户可以输入，与突出的硬提示优化方法相比，定量地改善了困惑度指标。我们的发现揭示了TTI模型的漏洞，而BGPS扩展了偏见搜索空间，可以作为偏见缓解的一种新评估工具。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为偏见引导提示搜索（BGPS）的自动化框架，旨在通过自动生成提示来揭示文本到图像（TTI）模型中隐藏的社会偏见。与依赖人工策划提示的传统方法不同，BGPS利用大型语言模型（LLM）生成属性中性提示，并通过作用于TTI内部表示的属性分类器进行引导，以最大化图像中偏见的表现。实验结果表明，该方法在Stable Diffusion 1.5和去偏模型中发现了大量微妙且未曾记录的偏见，揭示了TTI模型的脆弱性。BGPS不仅扩展了偏见搜索空间，还可作为偏见缓解的新评估工具。
AI.keywords: 文生图模型, 社会偏见, 自动化提示搜索, 偏见引导提示搜索, 公平性指标
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于其自动化偏见发现的方法，通过结合LLM和TTI模型内部表示的属性分类器，能够系统性地探索提示空间，发现传统方法可能遗漏的微妙偏见。这对于提高偏见检测的全面性和评估去偏模型的真正有效性至关重要。其重要性在于提供了一个更鲁棒的评估工具，有助于开发更公平的文生图系统。

title: Analyzing Planner Design Trade-offs for MAPF under ADG-based Realistic Execution
summary: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) algorithms are increasingly deployed in industrial warehouses and automated manufacturing facilities, where robots must operate reliably under real-world physical constraints. However, existing MAPF evaluation frameworks typically rely on simplified robot models, leaving a substantial gap between algorithmic benchmarks and practical performance. Recent frameworks such as SMART combine kinodynamic modeling with execution based on the Action Dependency Graph (ADG), enabling realistic, large-scale MAPF evaluation. Building on this capability, this work investigates how key planner design choices influence performance under realistic execution settings. We systematically study three fundamental factors: (1) the relationship between solution optimality and execution performance, (2) the sensitivity of system performance to inaccuracies in kinodynamic modeling, and (3) the tradeoff between model accuracy and plan optimality. Empirically, we examine these factors to understand how these design choices affect performance in realistic scenarios. We highlight open challenges and research directions to steer the community toward practical, real-world deployment.

AI.title_translation: 分析ADG驱动的现实执行下的MAPF规划器设计权衡
AI.tldr: 研究了MAPF规划器的设计选择（最优性、模型准确性）在考虑真实机器人运动学和基于ADG的执行时的性能影响，并指出了实际部署的挑战和方向。
AI.motivation: 现有的MAPF评估框架通常依赖简化的机器人模型，导致算法基准与实际性能之间存在显著差距。需要研究关键的规划器设计选择如何在现实执行设置下影响性能。
AI.method: 系统地研究了三个基本因素：解的最优性与执行性能的关系、系统性能对动力学模型不准确性的敏感性，以及模型准确性与规划最优性之间的权衡。通过实证检验这些因素在现实场景中的影响。
AI.result: 实证研究了三个关键设计因素如何影响在现实场景中的性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究突出了开放的挑战和研究方向，以引导社区实现实际、世界级的部署。
AI.translation: 多智能体路径查找（MAPF）算法越来越多地应用于工业仓库和自动化制造设施，其中机器人在现实物理约束下必须可靠运行。然而，现有的MAPF评估框架通常依赖简化的机器人模型，这使得算法基准与实际性能之间存在巨大差距。最近的框架，如SMART，将动力学建模与基于动作依赖图（ADG）的执行相结合，实现了现实的、大规模的MAPF评估。在此基础上，本研究调查了关键的规划器设计选择如何在现实执行环境中影响性能。我们系统地研究了三个基本因素：（1）解的最优性与执行性能之间的关系，（2）系统性能对动力学模型不准确性的敏感性，以及（3）模型准确性与规划最优性之间的权衡。通过实证检验这些因素，我们旨在了解这些设计选择如何影响现实场景中的性能。我们重点介绍了开放的挑战和研究方向，以引导社区实现实际、世界级的部署。
AI.summary: 本文旨在研究在基于动作依赖图（ADG）的现实执行设置下，多智能体路径查找（MAPF）规划器的关键设计选择（如最优性、模型准确性等）如何影响其性能。研究通过SMART等框架，系统地分析了这些权衡，为实现更实用的MAPF部署指明了方向。
AI.keywords: MAPF, 规划器设计权衡, ADG, 现实执行, 动力学模型
AI.comments: 这项工作通过将MAPF规划与基于ADG的现实执行相结合，系统地分析了规划器设计选择对实际性能的影响，填补了理论基准与实际部署之间的差距。其创新之处在于对最优性、模型不准确性和模型准确性之间权衡的深入实证研究。限制在于分析是基于SMART框架的，其普适性可能受限于该框架的特定假设。

title: Long-LRM++: Preserving Fine Details in Feed-Forward Wide-Coverage Reconstruction
summary: Recent advances in generalizable Gaussian splatting (GS) have enabled feed-forward reconstruction of scenes from tens of input views. Long-LRM notably scales this paradigm to 32 input images at $950\times540$ resolution, achieving 360° scene-level reconstruction in a single forward pass. However, directly predicting millions of Gaussian parameters at once remains highly error-sensitive: small inaccuracies in positions or other attributes lead to noticeable blurring, particularly in fine structures such as text. In parallel, implicit representation methods such as LVSM and LaCT have demonstrated significantly higher rendering fidelity by compressing scene information into model weights rather than explicit Gaussians, and decoding RGB frames using the full transformer or TTT backbone. However, this computationally intensive decompression process for every rendered frame makes real-time rendering infeasible. These observations raise key questions: Is the deep, sequential "decompression" process necessary? Can we retain the benefits of implicit representations while enabling real-time performance? We address these questions with Long-LRM++, a model that adopts a semi-explicit scene representation combined with a lightweight decoder. Long-LRM++ matches the rendering quality of LaCT on DL3DV while achieving real-time 14 FPS rendering on an A100 GPU, overcoming the speed limitations of prior implicit methods. Our design also scales to 64 input views at the $950\times540$ resolution, demonstrating strong generalization to increased input lengths. Additionally, Long-LRM++ delivers superior novel-view depth prediction on ScanNetv2 compared to direct depth rendering from Gaussians. Extensive ablation studies validate the effectiveness of each component in the proposed framework.

AI.title_translation: Long-LRM++：在前馈式广覆盖重建中保留精细细节
AI.tldr: Long-LRM++通过结合半显式场景表示和轻量级解码器，实现了高保真、实时、广覆盖的场景重建，解决了现有方法在精细细节和实时性方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有广义高斯splatting（如Long-LRM）在预测大量高斯参数时对误差敏感，导致精细结构（如文本）模糊。而隐式表示方法（如LVSM和LaCT）虽然渲染保真度更高，但计算密集型的解压缩过程使得实时渲染不可行。因此，本文旨在解决如何在保留隐式表示优势的同时实现实时性能的问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了Long-LRM++模型，该模型采用半显式场景表示与轻量级解码器相结合的方式。
AI.result: Long-LRM++在DL3DV数据集上达到了与LaCT相当的渲染质量，并在A100 GPU上实现了14 FPS的实时渲染，克服了先前隐式方法的实时性限制。它还能扩展到64个950x540分辨率的输入视图。此外，Long-LRM++在ScanNetv2数据集上提供了优于直接从高斯渲染的新视角深度预测。广泛的消融研究验证了所提出框架中每个组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Long-LRM++通过引入半显式场景表示和轻量级解码器，成功地在广覆盖场景重建中实现了高保真度与实时性能的结合，克服了传统高斯splatting在细节表现上的不足以及纯隐式方法在实时性上的限制。
AI.translation: 最近广义高斯splatting (GS) 的进展使得从数十个输入视图进行场景的前馈重建成为可能。Long-LRM 显著地将这种范式扩展到32张950x540分辨率的输入图像，在单次前向传播中实现了360°场景级重建。然而，直接一次性预测数百万个高斯参数仍然对误差高度敏感：位置或其他属性上的微小不准确会导致明显的模糊，尤其是在文本等精细结构中。与此同时，LVSM和LaCT等隐式表示方法通过将场景信息压缩到模型权重而不是显式高斯中，并使用完整的Transformer或TTT骨干网络解码RGB帧，展示了显著更高的渲染保真度。然而，这种对每个渲染帧都进行的计算密集型解压缩过程使得实时渲染不可行。这些观察引出了关键问题：深度、顺序的“解压缩”过程是必要的吗？我们能否在实现实时性能的同时保留隐式表示的优势？我们通过Long-LRM++解决了这些问题，该模型采用了半显式场景表示与轻量级解码器相结合的方式。Long-LRM++在DL3DV上达到了LaCT的渲染质量，同时在A100 GPU上实现了14 FPS的实时渲染，克服了先前隐式方法的速度限制。我们的设计还可扩展到64个950x540分辨率的输入视图，展示了对增加输入长度的强大泛化能力。此外，与直接从高斯渲染深度相比，Long-LRM++在ScanNetv2上提供了卓越的新视角深度预测。广泛的消融研究验证了所提出框架中每个组件的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Long-LRM++，一个用于广覆盖场景重建的模型，旨在解决现有广义高斯splatting方法在精细细节上的模糊问题，以及隐式表示方法在实时渲染方面的限制。Long-LRM++结合了半显式场景表示和轻量级解码器，实现了与高保真隐式方法相当的渲染质量，同时在A100 GPU上达到了14 FPS的实时渲染速度。该模型还展示了对更多输入视图的良好泛化能力，并在新视角深度预测方面表现出色。
AI.keywords: 高斯splatting, 隐式表示, 实时渲染, 新视角合成, 场景重建
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一种半显式场景表示与轻量级解码器相结合的方法，成功地弥合了显式高斯splatting在速度和覆盖范围方面的优势与隐式表示在渲染保真度方面的优势之间的鸿沟。通过解决高斯splatting对细节的敏感性以及隐式表示的实时性瓶颈，Long-LRM++为实时、高保真、广覆盖的3D场景重建提供了一个有前景的解决方案，对于AR/VR和机器人等领域具有重要意义。

title: Vision-Language Models for Infrared Industrial Sensing in Additive Manufacturing Scene Description
summary: Many manufacturing environments operate in low-light conditions or within enclosed machines where conventional vision systems struggle. Infrared cameras provide complementary advantages in such environments. Simultaneously, supervised AI systems require large labeled datasets, which makes zero-shot learning frameworks more practical for applications including infrared cameras. Recent advances in vision-language foundation models (VLMs) offer a new path in zero-shot predictions from paired image-text representations. However, current VLMs cannot understand infrared camera data since they are trained on RGB data. This work introduces VLM-IRIS (Vision-Language Models for InfraRed Industrial Sensing), a zero-shot framework that adapts VLMs to infrared data by preprocessing infrared images captured by a FLIR Boson sensor into RGB-compatible inputs suitable for CLIP-based encoders. We demonstrate zero-shot workpiece presence detection on a 3D printer bed where temperature differences between the build plate and workpieces make the task well-suited for thermal imaging. VLM-IRIS converts the infrared images to magma representation and applies centroid prompt ensembling with a CLIP ViT-B/32 encoder to achieve high accuracy on infrared images without any model retraining. These findings demonstrate that the proposed improvements to VLMs can be effectively extended to thermal applications for label-free monitoring.

AI.title_translation: 用于增材制造场景描述中红外工业传感的视觉-语言模型

AI.method: 本工作引入VLM-IRIS，一个零样本框架，通过将FLIR Boson传感器捕获的红外图像预处理为RGB兼容输入，使其适用于基于CLIP的编码器，从而使VLM适应红外数据。VLM-IRIS将红外图像转换为岩浆表示，并使用CLIP ViT-B/32编码器应用质心提示集成。

AI.keywords: 视觉-语言模型, 红外传感, 零样本学习, 增材制造, 图像预处理

title: Fast-FoundationStereo: Real-Time Zero-Shot Stereo Matching
summary: Stereo foundation models achieve strong zero-shot generalization but remain computationally prohibitive for real-time applications. Efficient stereo architectures, on the other hand, sacrifice robustness for speed and require costly per-domain fine-tuning. To bridge this gap, we present Fast-FoundationStereo, a family of architectures that achieve, for the first time, strong zero-shot generalization at real-time frame rate. We employ a divide-and-conquer acceleration strategy with three components: (1) knowledge distillation to compress the hybrid backbone into a single efficient student; (2) blockwise neural architecture search for automatically discovering optimal cost filtering designs under latency budgets, reducing search complexity exponentially; and (3) structured pruning for eliminating redundancy in the iterative refinement module. Furthermore, we introduce an automatic pseudo-labeling pipeline used to curate 1.4M in-the-wild stereo pairs to supplement synthetic training data and facilitate knowledge distillation. The resulting model can run over 10x faster than FoundationStereo while closely matching its zero-shot accuracy, thus establishing a new state-of-the-art among real-time methods. Project page: https://nvlabs.github.io/Fast-FoundationStereo/

AI.title_translation: Fast-FoundationStereo: 实时零样本立体匹配
AI.tldr: Fast-FoundationStereo首次实现了在实时帧率下具有强大零样本泛化能力的立体匹配，比现有基础模型快10倍且精度相当。
AI.motivation: 现有的立体基础模型计算成本高，不适用于实时应用；而高效立体架构虽然速度快但鲁棒性差，且需要昂贵的逐领域微调。本文旨在弥合零样本泛化能力和实时计算效率之间的差距。
AI.method: 本文提出了Fast-FoundationStereo架构，采用分而治之的加速策略，包括：1) 知识蒸馏，将混合骨干网络压缩成高效学生模型；2) 块式神经架构搜索，在延迟预算下自动发现最佳成本过滤设计，指数级降低搜索复杂度；3) 结构化剪枝，消除迭代细化模块中的冗余。此外，还引入了自动伪标签管线，收集140万个真实世界立体对以补充训练数据并促进知识蒸馏。

AI.conclusion: Fast-FoundationStereo首次成功实现了在实时帧率下强大的零样本泛化能力，解决了现有立体匹配方法在计算效率和泛化能力之间的矛盾。
AI.translation: 立体基础模型实现了强大的零样本泛化能力，但对于实时应用来说计算成本过高。另一方面，高效的立体架构为了速度牺牲了鲁棒性，并且需要昂贵的逐领域微调。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了Fast-FoundationStereo，这是一个架构家族，首次在实时帧率下实现了强大的零样本泛化能力。我们采用了一种分而治之的加速策略，包含三个组件：(1) 知识蒸馏，将混合骨干网络压缩成一个高效的学生模型；(2) 块式神经架构搜索，用于在延迟预算下自动发现最佳成本过滤设计，指数级降低搜索复杂度；以及 (3) 结构化剪枝，用于消除迭代细化模块中的冗余。此外，我们引入了一个自动伪标签管线，用于整理140万个野外立体对，以补充合成训练数据并促进知识蒸馏。由此产生的模型运行速度比FoundationStereo快10倍以上，同时与其零样本精度非常接近，从而在实时方法中建立了新的最先进水平。项目页面：https://nvlabs.github.io/Fast-FoundationStereo/

AI.keywords: 立体匹配, 零样本, 实时, 知识蒸馏, 神经架构搜索
