However, in the real world, the development of mature software is typically predicated on complex requirement changes and long-term feature iterations -- a process that static, one-shot repair paradigms fail to capture. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{SWE-CI}, the first repository-level benchmark built upon the Continuous Integration loop, aiming to shift the evaluation paradigm for code generation from static, short-term \textit{functional correctness} toward dynamic, long-term \textit{maintainability}. The benchmark comprises 100 tasks, each corresponding on average to an evolution history spanning 233 days and 71 consecutive commits in a real-world code repository. SWE-CI requires agents to systematically resolve these tasks through dozens of rounds of analysis and coding iterations. SWE-CI provides valuable insights into how well agents can sustain code quality throughout long-term evolution.

title: Thin Keys, Full Values: Reducing KV Cache via Low-Dimensional Attention Selection
summary:
Standard transformer attention uses identical dimensionality for queries, keys, and values, yet these components serve
  different roles: queries and keys produce scalar attention weights (selection), while values carry rich representations
  (value transfer). We show that selection requires only $O(\log N)$ dimensions to distinguish among $N$ relevant token
  categories (e.g., syntactic roles, semantic clusters, positional patterns) -- far fewer than value transfer needs.
  We introduce factored keys, which exploit this asymmetry to physically shrink the KV cache of any pretrained model without
  retraining from scratch -- unlike GQA and MLA, which must be designed into the architecture before pretraining. We factorize
  each key projection $W_K \approx A_{d \times r} B_{r \times d}$ via truncated SVD (where $r = d_{\text{select}}$), set $W_K'
  = A$ as the new key projection producing compact $r$-dimensional keys for the cache, and absorb $B^\top$ into the query
  projection ($W_Q' = W_Q B^\top$) at zero cost -- since queries are never cached. At 7B scale, training from scratch with $r =
  d_{\text{model}}/4$ matches full-attention perplexity (9.2 vs 9.3 PPL after 20B tokens) while using 12% fewer parameters and
  training 8% faster. For existing models, SVD + QK fine-tuning (3 epochs, less than 1% of pretraining data) achieves 75% key
  cache savings at approximately 2% quality cost on both GPT-2 and Mistral-7B. The approach composes with GQA and quantization
  for up to $16\times$ combined key cache compression. For a 7B model serving 128K context, factored keys save 25 GB of KV
  cache per user, enabling approximately 60% more concurrent users on identical hardware.

title: Model Medicine: A Clinical Framework for Understanding, Diagnosing, and Treating AI Models
summary: Model Medicine is the science of understanding, diagnosing, treating, and preventing disorders in AI models, grounded in the principle that AI models -- like biological organisms -- have internal structures, dynamic processes, heritable traits, observable symptoms, classifiable conditions, and treatable states. This paper introduces Model Medicine as a research program, bridging the gap between current AI interpretability research (anatomical observation) and the systematic clinical practice that complex AI systems increasingly require. We present five contributions: (1) a discipline taxonomy organizing 15 subdisciplines across four divisions -- Basic Model Sciences, Clinical Model Sciences, Model Public Health, and Model Architectural Medicine; (2) the Four Shell Model (v3.3), a behavioral genetics framework empirically grounded in 720 agents and 24,923 decisions from the Agora-12 program, explaining how model behavior emerges from Core--Shell interaction; (3) Neural MRI (Model Resonance Imaging), a working open-source diagnostic tool mapping five medical neuroimaging modalities to AI interpretability techniques, validated through four clinical cases demonstrating imaging, comparison, localization, and predictive capability; (4) a five-layer diagnostic framework for comprehensive model assessment; and (5) clinical model sciences including the Model Temperament Index for behavioral profiling, Model Semiology for symptom description, and M-CARE for standardized case reporting. We additionally propose the Layered Core Hypothesis -- a biologically-inspired three-layer parameter architecture -- and a therapeutic framework connecting diagnosis to treatment.

title: Building Enterprise Realtime Voice Agents from Scratch: A Technical Tutorial
summary: We present a technical tutorial for building enterprise-grade realtime voice agents from first principles. While end-to-end speech-to-speech models may ultimately provide the best latency for voice agents, fully self-hosted end-to-end solutions are not yet available. We evaluate the closest candidate, Qwen3-Omni, across three configurations: its cloud-only DashScope Realtime API achieves $\sim$702ms audio-to-audio latency with streaming, but is not self-hostable; its local vLLM deployment supports only the Thinker (text generation from audio, 516ms), not the Talker (audio synthesis); and its local Transformers deployment runs the full pipeline but at $\sim$146s -- far too slow for realtime. The cascaded streaming pipeline (STT $\rightarrow$ LLM $\rightarrow$ TTS) therefore remains the practical architecture for self-hosted realtime voice agents, and the focus of this tutorial. We build a complete voice agent using Deepgram (streaming STT), vLLM-served LLMs with function calling (streaming text generation), and ElevenLabs (streaming TTS), achieving a measured time-to-first-audio of 755ms (best case 729ms) with full function calling support. We release the full codebase as a 9-chapter progressive tutorial with working, tested code for every component.

title: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning Compression
summary: Reasoning models think out loud, but much of what they say is noise. We introduce OPSDC (On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning Compression), a method that teaches models to reason more concisely by distilling their own concise behavior back into themselves. The entire approach reduces to one idea: condition the same model on a "be concise" instruction to obtain teacher logits, and minimize per-token reverse KL on the student's own rollouts. No ground-truth answers, no token budgets, no difficulty estimators. Just self-distillation. Yet this simplicity belies surprising sophistication: OPSDC automatically compresses easy problems aggressively while preserving the deliberation needed for hard ones. On Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B, we achieve 57-59% token reduction on MATH-500 while improving accuracy by 9-16 points absolute. On AIME 2024, the 14B model gains 10 points with 41% compression. The secret? Much of what reasoning models produce is not just redundant-it is actively harmful, compounding errors with every unnecessary token. Code is available at https://github.com/HJSang/OPSD_Reasoning_Compression.

title: AutothinkRAG: Complexity-Aware Control of Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning for Image-Text Interaction
summary: Multimodal document question answering requires retrieving dispersed evidence from visually rich long documents and performing reliable reasoning over heterogeneous information. Existing multimodal RAG systems remain limited by two bottlenecks: static retrieval that ignores query complexity, and end-to-end Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that couple visual perception with logical reasoning, leading to inefficient computation and unstable answer generation. We propose AutoThinkRAG, a complexity-aware inference architecture for multimodal document QA. It has two components: (1) a Query Complexity Router that analyzes query difficulty and structure to adaptively select retrieval and reasoning paths; and (2) a Perception--Reasoning Decoupling architecture that uses a lightweight VLM as a high-fidelity visual interpreter to convert query-relevant visual cues into textual representations, which are then passed to an LLM for logical reasoning and answer synthesis. This design improves both efficiency and robustness, especially on long-document and unanswerable queries. Experiments on DocBench and MMLongBench show that AutoThinkRAG achieves 82.13\% and 51.29\% overall accuracy, respectively, while reducing per-query token consumption by 18.9\% and monetary cost by 18.2\%. Further analyses show that the gains are most pronounced on complex queries requiring adaptive retrieval and multi-step reasoning.

title: Test-Time Adaptation via Many-Shot Prompting: Benefits, Limits, and Pitfalls
summary: Test-time adaptation enables large language models (LLMs) to modify their behavior at inference without updating model parameters. A common approach is many-shot prompting, where large numbers of in-context learning (ICL) examples are injected as an input-space test-time update. Although performance can improve as more demonstrations are added, the reliability and limits of this update mechanism remain poorly understood, particularly for open-source models. We present an empirical study of many-shot prompting across tasks and model backbones, analyzing how performance varies with update magnitude, example ordering, and selection policy. We further study Dynamic and Reinforced ICL as alternative test-time update strategies that control which information is injected and how it constrains model behavior. We find that many-shot prompting is effective for structured tasks where demonstrations provide high information gain, but is highly sensitive to selection strategy and often shows limited benefits for open-ended generation tasks. Overall, we characterize the practical limits of prompt-based test-time adaptation and outline when input-space updates are beneficial versus harmful.

title: CRIMSON: A Clinically-Grounded LLM-Based Metric for Generative Radiology Report Evaluation
summary: We introduce CRIMSON, a clinically grounded evaluation framework for chest X-ray report generation that assesses reports based on diagnostic correctness, contextual relevance, and patient safety. Unlike prior metrics, CRIMSON incorporates full clinical context, including patient age, indication, and guideline-based decision rules, and prevents normal or clinically insignificant findings from exerting disproportionate influence on the overall score. The framework categorizes errors into a comprehensive taxonomy covering false findings, missing findings, and eight attribute-level errors (e.g., location, severity, measurement, and diagnostic overinterpretation). Each finding is assigned a clinical significance level (urgent, actionable non-urgent, non-actionable, or expected/benign), based on a guideline developed in collaboration with attending cardiothoracic radiologists, enabling severity-aware weighting that prioritizes clinically consequential mistakes over benign discrepancies. CRIMSON is validated through strong alignment with clinically significant error counts annotated by six board-certified radiologists in ReXVal (Kendalls tau = 0.61-0.71; Pearsons r = 0.71-0.84), and through two additional benchmarks that we introduce. In RadJudge, a targeted suite of clinically challenging pass-fail scenarios, CRIMSON shows consistent agreement with expert judgment. In RadPref, a larger radiologist preference benchmark of over 100 pairwise cases with structured error categorization, severity modeling, and 1-5 overall quality ratings from three cardiothoracic radiologists, CRIMSON achieves the strongest alignment with radiologist preferences. We release the metric, the evaluation benchmarks, RadJudge and RadPref, and a fine-tuned MedGemma model to enable reproducible evaluation of report generation, all available at https://github.com/rajpurkarlab/CRIMSON.

AI.title_translation: CRIMSON：一种基于LLM的、以临床为基础的生成放射学报告评估指标
AI.tldr: CRIMSON是一个新的、以临床为基础的LLM评估框架，用于胸部X射线报告生成，它通过考虑临床背景、错误分类和严重性加权来评估诊断正确性、相关性和患者安全性，并在多个基准测试中表现出与放射科医生判断的高度一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的评估指标未能充分考虑临床背景，如患者年龄、适应症和基于指南的决策规则，并且未有效处理正常或临床不重要发现对整体评分的影响，因此需要一个更符合临床实践的评估框架。
AI.method: CRIMSON是一个基于LLM的评估框架，用于胸部X射线报告生成。它整合了完整的临床背景（患者年龄、适应症、指南决策规则），防止不重要发现影响评分。它将错误分类为综合分类法（假阳性、漏诊、8种属性级错误），并根据临床意义（紧急、可行动非紧急、不可行动或预期/良性）分配权重，以优先处理临床上重要的错误。
AI.result: CRIMSON在ReXVal中与六位放射科医生标注的临床显著错误计数显示出强一致性（Kendalls tau = 0.61-0.71; Pearsons r = 0.71-0.84）。在RadJudge（通过/失败场景）中与专家判断一致。在RadPref（100多个成对案例）中与放射科医生偏好达到最强一致性。
AI.conclusion: CRIMSON是一个有效且临床接地的LLM评估指标，能够准确评估生成式放射学报告，并为可重复评估提供了基准和模型。
AI.translation: 我们引入CRIMSON，一个以临床为基础的胸部X射线报告生成评估框架，它根据诊断正确性、上下文相关性和患者安全性评估报告。与之前的指标不同，CRIMSON整合了完整的临床上下文，包括患者年龄、适应症和基于指南的决策规则，并防止正常或临床不重要的发现对整体分数产生不成比例的影响。该框架将错误分类为全面的分类法，涵盖假阳性发现、漏诊发现以及八种属性级错误（例如，位置、严重程度、测量和诊断过度解读）。根据与主治心胸放射科医生合作制定的指南，每个发现都被赋予一个临床意义级别（紧急、可行动非紧急、不可行动或预期/良性），从而实现严重性感知加权，优先处理临床上重要的错误而非良性差异。CRIMSON通过与ReXVal中由六位经过委员会认证的放射科医生标注的临床显著错误计数的高度一致性得到验证（Kendalls tau = 0.61-0.71；Pearsons r = 0.71-0.84），并通过我们引入的另外两个基准进行验证。在RadJudge（一个有针对性的、具有临床挑战性的通过-失败场景套件）中，CRIMSON显示出与专家判断的一致性。在RadPref（一个更大的放射科医生偏好基准，包含100多个成对案例，具有结构化错误分类、严重性建模以及三位心胸放射科医生提供的1-5整体质量评分）中，CRIMSON实现了与放射科医生偏好的最强一致性。我们发布了该指标、评估基准RadJudge和RadPref，以及一个微调的MedGemma模型，以实现报告生成的可重复评估，所有这些都可在https://github.com/rajpurkarlab/CRIMSON获取。
AI.summary: CRIMSON是一个创新的、以临床为基础的LLM评估框架，旨在评估生成式胸部X射线报告的诊断正确性、上下文相关性和患者安全性。它通过整合全面的临床上下文、细致的错误分类和基于临床意义的严重性加权，克服了现有指标的局限性。该框架在多个放射科医生标注的基准测试中得到了验证，显示出与专家判断和偏好高度一致，并为放射学报告生成的未来评估提供了可重复的工具和资源。
AI.keywords: 放射学报告评估, LLM, 临床接地, 胸部X射线, 错误分类
AI.comments: CRIMSON的创新之处在于其深度融合了临床专业知识，通过考虑患者背景、错误类型和临床严重性来评估报告，这比单纯的文本相似度指标更具临床意义。其分层的错误分类和严重性加权机制对于确保生成式AI在医疗领域应用的安全性至关重要。该工作的局限性可能在于其对胸部X射线报告的特异性，以及在其他放射学模态或身体部位的泛化能力尚待验证。

title: FlowMotion: Training-Free Flow Guidance for Video Motion Transfer
summary: Video motion transfer aims to generate a target video that inherits motion patterns from a source video while rendering new scenes. Existing training-free approaches focus on constructing motion guidance based on the intermediate outputs of pre-trained T2V models, which results in heavy computational overhead and limited flexibility. In this paper, we present FlowMotion, a novel training-free framework that enables efficient and flexible motion transfer by directly leveraging the predicted outputs of flow-based T2V models. Our key insight is that early latent predictions inherently encode rich temporal information. Motivated by this, we propose flow guidance, which extracts motion representations based on latent predictions to align motion patterns between source and generated videos. We further introduce a velocity regularization strategy to stabilize optimization and ensure smooth motion evolution. By operating purely on model predictions, FlowMotion achieves superior time and resource efficiency as well as competitive performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

AI.title_translation: FlowMotion：免训练的视频运动迁移流引导
AI.tldr: FlowMotion是一个免训练的视频运动迁移框架，通过直接利用基于流的T2V模型的早期潜在预测来提供运动引导，实现高效灵活的运动迁移，并引入速度正则化策略以稳定优化和平滑运动演变，相比现有方法具有卓越的时间和资源效率以及竞争力性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的免训练视频运动迁移方法依赖于预训练T2V模型的中间输出构建运动引导，导致计算开销大且灵活性有限。
AI.method: FlowMotion直接利用基于流的T2V模型的预测输出。其核心思想是早期潜在预测固有地编码了丰富的时序信息。本文提出了流引导，基于潜在预测提取运动表示以对齐源视频和生成视频之间的运动模式。此外，还引入了速度正则化策略来稳定优化并确保平滑的运动演变。
AI.result: FlowMotion在时间和资源效率方面优于现有方法，并取得了具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: FlowMotion通过直接利用流基T2V模型的预测输出，实现了高效、灵活且性能卓越的免训练视频运动迁移。
AI.translation: 视频运动迁移旨在生成一个目标视频，该视频继承源视频的运动模式同时渲染新的场景。现有的免训练方法侧重于基于预训练T2V模型的中间输出构建运动引导，这导致了沉重的计算开销和有限的灵活性。在本文中，我们提出了FlowMotion，一个新颖的免训练框架，通过直接利用基于流的T2V模型的预测输出来实现高效灵活的运动迁移。我们的关键见解是早期潜在预测固有地编码了丰富的时序信息。受此启发，我们提出了流引导，它基于潜在预测提取运动表示，以对齐源视频和生成视频之间的运动模式。我们进一步引入了速度正则化策略来稳定优化并确保平滑的运动演变。通过纯粹在模型预测上操作，FlowMotion与最先进的方法相比，实现了卓越的时间和资源效率以及具有竞争力的性能。
AI.summary: FlowMotion是一种新颖的免训练视频运动迁移框架，旨在解决现有方法计算开销大和灵活性不足的问题。它通过直接利用基于流的文本到视频（T2V）模型的早期潜在预测，提出“流引导”来提取运动表示，从而对齐源视频和生成视频的运动模式。此外，该框架还引入了速度正则化策略以确保优化稳定和运动平滑。FlowMotion在时间、资源效率和性能上均优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.keywords: 视频运动迁移, 免训练, 流引导, T2V模型, 速度正则化
AI.comments: FlowMotion的创新之处在于其免训练的特性和对T2V模型早期潜在预测的直接利用，这显著提高了效率和灵活性。通过引入流引导和速度正则化，该方法在不牺牲性能的前提下解决了现有方法的局限性，具有重要的实践意义。

title: Match4Annotate: Propagating Sparse Video Annotations via Implicit Neural Feature Matching
summary: Acquiring per-frame video annotations remains a primary bottleneck for deploying computer vision in specialized domains such as medical imaging, where expert labeling is slow and costly. Label propagation offers a natural solution, yet existing approaches face fundamental limitations. Video trackers and segmentation models can propagate labels within a single sequence but require per-video initialization and cannot generalize across videos. Classic correspondence pipelines operate on detector-chosen keypoints and struggle in low-texture scenes, while dense feature matching and one-shot segmentation methods enable cross-video propagation but lack spatiotemporal smoothness and unified support for both point and mask annotations. We present Match4Annotate, a lightweight framework for both intra-video and inter-video propagation of point and mask annotations. Our method fits a SIREN-based implicit neural representation to DINOv3 features at test time, producing a continuous, high-resolution spatiotemporal feature field, and learns a smooth implicit deformation field between frame pairs to guide correspondence matching. We evaluate on three challenging clinical ultrasound datasets. Match4Annotate achieves state-of-the-art inter-video propagation, outperforming feature matching and one-shot segmentation baselines, while remaining competitive with specialized trackers for intra-video propagation. Our results show that lightweight, test-time-optimized feature matching pipelines have the potential to offer an efficient and accessible solution for scalable annotation workflows.

AI.title_translation: Match4Annotate：通过隐式神经特征匹配传播稀疏视频注释
AI.tldr: Match4Annotate是一个轻量级框架，用于传播点和掩码注释，适用于视频内和视频间场景。它通过使用基于SIREN的隐式神经表示和学习到的变形场来实现这一点，并在临床超声数据集上取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 在医学影像等专业领域，逐帧视频注释成本高昂且耗时，而现有的标签传播方法存在局限性，无法泛化到不同视频或处理低纹理场景，并且可能缺乏时空平滑性。因此，需要一种能够高效、可扩展地传播点和掩码注释的框架。
AI.method: Match4Annotate框架首先在测试时将基于SIREN的隐式神经表示拟合到DINOv3特征，生成连续、高分辨率的时空特征场。然后，它学习帧对之间的平滑隐式变形场，以指导对应关系的匹配，从而实现注释的传播。
AI.result: Match4Annotate在三个具有挑战性的临床超声数据集上进行了评估，在视频间传播方面取得了最先进的性能，优于特征匹配和单次分割基线，并且在视频内传播方面与专用跟踪器相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级的、在测试时优化的特征匹配流程有潜力为可扩展的注释工作流程提供高效且易于访问的解决方案。
AI.translation: 获取逐帧视频注释仍然是计算机视觉在医学成像等专业领域部署的主要瓶颈，因为专家标注既慢又贵。标签传播提供了一种自然的解决方案，但现有方法面临根本性的局限性。视频跟踪器和分割模型可以在单个序列内传播标签，但需要每个视频进行初始化，并且无法跨视频泛化。经典的对应关系流程在检测器选择的关键点上运行，并在低纹理场景中遇到困难，而密集特征匹配和单次分割方法则能够进行跨视频传播，但缺乏时空平滑性，并且无法统一支持点和掩码注释。我们提出了Match4Annotate，一个用于点和掩码注释的视频内和视频间传播的轻量级框架。我们的方法在测试时将基于SIREN的隐式神经表示拟合到DINOv3特征，生成连续、高分辨率的时空特征场，并学习帧对之间的平滑隐式变形场来指导对应关系的匹配。我们在三个具有挑战性的临床超声数据集上进行了评估。Match4Annotate在视频间传播方面达到了最先进水平，优于特征匹配和单次分割基线，同时在视频内传播方面与专用跟踪器相比仍具竞争力。我们的结果表明，轻量级的、在测试时优化的特征匹配流程有潜力为可扩展的注释工作流程提供一种高效且易于访问的解决方案。
AI.summary: Match4Annotate是一种创新的轻量级框架，旨在解决视频注释中的关键挑战，特别是医学影像等领域。该方法通过结合基于SIREN的隐式神经表示和学习到的变形场，实现了对点和掩码注释在视频内和视频间的有效传播。与现有方法相比，Match4Annotate在视频间传播方面表现出色，同时在视频内传播方面也具有竞争力，为未来的大规模注释工作提供了高效且可及的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 标签传播, 隐式神经表示, 特征匹配, 视频注释, 医学成像
AI.comments: 这项研究提出了一种新颖的Match4Annotate框架，它通过隐式神经特征匹配有效地解决了视频注释中的稀疏性问题。该方法在处理医学超声数据集方面表现出色，尤其是在跨视频传播方面达到了最先进的性能。框架的轻量级和测试时优化特性使其在实际应用中具有很高的潜力，为自动化和可扩展的注释工作流程提供了一种高效的解决方案。然而，该方法在低纹理场景下的表现以及其泛化能力仍有待进一步探索。

title: One-Shot Badminton Shuttle Detection for Mobile Robots
summary: This paper presents a robust one-shot badminton shuttlecock detection framework for non-stationary robots. To address the lack of egocentric shuttlecock detection datasets, we introduce a dataset of 20,510 semi-automatically annotated frames captured across 11 distinct backgrounds in diverse indoor and outdoor environments, and categorize each frame into one of three difficulty levels. For labeling, we present a novel semi-automatic annotation pipeline, that enables efficient labeling from stationary camera footage. We propose a metric suited to our downstream use case and fine-tune a YOLOv8 network optimized for real-time shuttlecock detection, achieving an F1-score of 0.86 under our metric in test environments similar to training, and 0.70 in entirely unseen environments. Our analysis reveals that detection performance is critically dependent on shuttlecock size and background texture complexity. Qualitative experiments confirm their applicability to robots with moving cameras. Unlike prior work with stationary camera setups, our detector is specifically designed for the egocentric, dynamic viewpoints of mobile robots, providing a foundational building block for downstream tasks, including tracking, trajectory estimation, and system (re)-initialization.

AI.title_translation: 移动机器人羽毛球单次检测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于移动机器人的鲁棒单次羽毛球检测框架，解决了缺乏以自我为中心的羽毛球检测数据集的问题。为此，我们创建了一个包含20,510帧的新数据集，并提出了一种新颖的半自动标注流程。我们还微调了一个YOLOv8网络，在类似训练环境中的F1分数达到0.86，在完全未见环境中的F1分数达到0.70。该检测器专为移动机器人的动态视角设计，为跟踪、轨迹估计等下游任务奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 该研究的动机是为移动机器人开发一个鲁棒的单次羽毛球检测框架，以解决现有研究主要针对固定摄像头设置，且缺乏以自我为中心的羽毛球检测数据集的问题。这为移动机器人的后续任务（如跟踪、轨迹估计和系统（重新）初始化）提供基础。
AI.method: 该研究提出了一种鲁棒的单次羽毛球检测框架。具体方法包括：1. 构建了一个包含20,510帧半自动标注的以自我为中心的羽毛球检测数据集，涵盖11种不同背景和三种难度级别。2. 引入了一种新颖的半自动标注流程，用于从固定摄像头素材中高效标注。3. 提出了一种适用于下游用例的评估指标。4. 微调了一个YOLOv8网络，针对实时羽毛球检测进行优化。
AI.result: 该研究在测试环境中取得了以下结果：1. 在类似于训练的环境中，微调后的YOLOv8网络在提出的指标下实现了0.86的F1分数。2. 在完全未见的环境中，F1分数达到0.70。3. 分析表明，检测性能严重依赖于羽毛球大小和背景纹理复杂性。4. 定性实验证实了该检测器在配备移动摄像头的机器人上的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该论文的结论是，所提出的羽毛球检测器专为移动机器人的以自我为中心的动态视角设计，能够为跟踪、轨迹估计和系统（重新）初始化等下游任务提供一个基础构建模块。其性能受羽毛球大小和背景纹理复杂性的显著影响。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种用于非固定机器人的鲁棒单次羽毛球检测框架。为了解决以自我为中心的羽毛球检测数据集的缺乏问题，我们引入了一个包含20,510帧半自动标注的数据集，这些帧是在11种不同背景下、在各种室内和室外环境中捕获的，并将每帧分为三个难度级别之一。为了标注，我们提出了一种新颖的半自动标注流程，可以从固定摄像头素材中进行高效标注。我们提出了一种适用于我们下游用例的指标，并对YOLOv8网络进行了微调，该网络针对实时羽毛球检测进行了优化，在与训练相似的测试环境中，我们的指标下F1分数达到0.86，在完全未见的环境中达到0.70。我们的分析表明，检测性能严重依赖于羽毛球大小和背景纹理复杂性。定性实验证实了它们对带移动摄像头的机器人的适用性。与以前使用固定摄像头设置的工作不同，我们的检测器是专门为移动机器人的以自我为中心的动态视角设计的，为下游任务（包括跟踪、轨迹估计和系统（重新）初始化）提供了基础构建模块。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一个用于移动机器人的单次羽毛球检测框架。为解决缺乏相关数据集的问题，研究者构建了一个包含20,510帧的半自动标注数据集，并开发了一种高效的标注流程。通过微调YOLOv8网络并引入特定评估指标，该检测器在类似训练环境中实现了0.86的F1分数，在未见环境中达到0.70。研究强调检测性能受羽毛球大小和背景复杂度的影响。该工作专门针对移动机器人的动态视角，为后续的跟踪和轨迹估计等任务奠定基础。
AI.keywords: 羽毛球检测, 移动机器人, YOLOv8, 数据集, 单次检测
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于其专注于移动机器人的“以自我为中心”的羽毛球检测，这与现有多数针对固定摄像头的研究形成对比。通过构建一个大规模、多背景、多难度的专用数据集，并开发半自动标注流程，有效解决了数据稀缺的挑战。将YOLOv8应用于此特定场景并进行微调，展现了其在实时应用中的潜力。该研究为移动机器人进行羽毛球相关任务（如机器人羽毛球陪练或裁判）提供了重要的技术基础。局限性可能在于检测性能在完全未见环境下的下降，以及对羽毛球大小和背景纹理复杂性的敏感性，这可能需要进一步的泛化能力提升。

title: Impact of 5G Latency and Jitter on TAS Scheduling in a 5G-TSN Network: An Empirical Study
comments: IEEE Internet of Things Journal, 17 pages
summary: Deterministic communications are essential to meet the stringent delay and jitter requirements of Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) services. IIoT increasingly demands wide-area wireless mobility to support Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMR) and dynamic workflows. Integrating Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) with 5G private networks is emerging as a promising approach to fulfill these requirements. In this architecture, 5G provides wireless access for industrial devices, which connect to a TSN backbone that interfaces with the enterprise edge/cloud, where IIoT control and computing systems reside. TSN achieves bounded latency and low jitter using IEEE 802.1Qbv Time-Aware Shaper (TAS), which schedules the network traffic in precise time slots. However, the stochastic delay and jitter inherent in 5G disrupt TSN scheduling, requiring careful tuning of TAS parameters to maintain end-to-end determinism. This paper presents an empirical study evaluating the impact of 5G downlink delay and jitter on TAS scheduling using a testbed with TSN switches and a commercial 5G network. Results show that guaranteeing bounded latency and jitter requires careful setting of TAS transmission window offset between TSN switches based on the measured 5G delay bounded by a high order p-th percentile. Otherwise, excessive offset may cause additional delay or even a complete loss of determinism.
comment: IEEE Internet of Things Journal, 17 pages

AI.title_translation: 5G延迟和抖动对5G-TSN网络中TAS调度影响的实证研究
AI.tldr: 5G网络中的随机延迟和抖动会干扰TSN的TAS调度，需要仔细调整TAS参数以保持确定性通信，本研究通过实证评估了5G下行链路延迟和抖动对TAS调度的影响。
AI.motivation: 工业物联网 (IIoT) 服务对确定性通信有严格的延迟和抖动要求，且需要广域无线移动性。将时间敏感网络 (TSN) 与 5G 专用网络集成是一种有前景的方法来满足这些需求，但5G网络固有的随机延迟和抖动会干扰TSN调度，从而影响端到端确定性。
AI.method: 本文通过一个包含TSN交换机和商用5G网络的测试平台，进行了一项实证研究，评估了5G下行链路延迟和抖动对时间感知整形器 (TAS) 调度的影响。
AI.result: 结果表明，要保证有界延迟和抖动，需要根据测量到的5G延迟（以高阶p百分位数界定）仔细设置TSN交换机之间TAS传输窗口的偏移量。否则，过大的偏移量可能导致额外的延迟，甚至完全失去确定性。
AI.conclusion: 在5G-TSN集成网络中，为保证确定性通信和满足IIoT的严格要求，必须根据5G网络的实际延迟特性，特别是高阶p百分位数，仔细调整TAS传输窗口的偏移量，以避免额外的延迟和确定性丧失。
AI.translation: 确定性通信对于满足工业物联网 (IIoT) 服务严格的延迟和抖动要求至关重要。IIoT 越来越需要广域无线移动性来支持自主移动机器人 (AMR) 和动态工作流。将时间敏感网络 (TSN) 与 5G 专用网络集成正在成为满足这些要求的一种有前景的方法。在这种架构中，5G 为工业设备提供无线接入，这些设备连接到与企业边缘/云接口的 TSN 骨干网，IIoT 控制和计算系统就驻留在此。TSN 使用 IEEE 802.1Qbv 时间感知整形器 (TAS) 实现有界延迟和低抖动，该整形器在精确的时间槽中调度网络流量。然而，5G 固有的随机延迟和抖动会干扰 TSN 调度，需要仔细调整 TAS 参数以保持端到端确定性。本文提出了一项实证研究，使用包含 TSN 交换机和商用 5G 网络的测试平台评估 5G 下行链路延迟和抖动对 TAS 调度的影响。结果表明，保证有界延迟和抖动需要根据测量到的 5G 延迟（以高阶 p 百分位数界定）仔细设置 TSN 交换机之间 TAS 传输窗口的偏移量。否则，过大的偏移量可能导致额外的延迟，甚至完全失去确定性。
AI.summary: 本文通过一项实证研究，评估了5G网络中固有的下行链路延迟和抖动对5G-TSN集成架构中时间感知整形器（TAS）调度的影响。研究利用包含TSN交换机和商用5G网络的测试平台，发现为确保有界延迟和低抖动，必须根据测量到的5G延迟（由高阶p百分位数界定）仔细设置TSN交换机之间的TAS传输窗口偏移量，以避免额外的延迟或完全失去确定性。
AI.keywords: 5G, TSN, TAS, 延迟, 抖动, IIoT
AI.comments: 这项研究通过实证方法揭示了5G网络与TSN集成时面临的关键挑战，即5G的随机性对TSN确定性调度的影响。其创新之处在于通过实际测试平台量化了这种影响，并提出了基于5G延迟特性（高阶p百分位数）调整TAS参数的具体建议，对于指导5G-TSN网络部署和优化具有重要实践意义。

title: MAWARITH: A Dataset and Benchmark for Legal Inheritance Reasoning with LLMs
summary: Islamic inheritance law ('ilm al-mawarith) is challenging for large language models because solving inheritance cases requires complex, structured multi-step reasoning and the correct application of juristic rules to compute heirs' shares. We introduce MAWARITH, a large-scale annotated dataset of 12,500 Arabic inheritance cases for training and evaluating models on the full reasoning chain: (i) identifying eligible heirs, (ii) applying blocking (hajb) and allocation rules, and (iii) computing exact inheritance shares. Unlike prior datasets that restrict inheritance case solving to multiple-choice questions, MAWARITH supports the full reasoning chain and provides step-by-step solutions, including intermediate legal decisions and justifications based on classical juristic sources and established inheritance rules, as well as exact share calculations. To evaluate models beyond final-answer accuracy, we propose MIR-E (Mawarith Inheritance Reasoning Evaluation), a weighted multi-stage metric that scores key reasoning stages and captures error propagation across the pipeline. We evaluate six LLMs in a zero-shot setting. Gemini-2.5-flash achieves about 90% MIR-E on both validation and test, while Fanar-C, Fanar-Sadiq, LLaMA 3, and Qwen 3 remain below 50%. Our error analysis identifies recurring failure patterns, including scenario misinterpretation, errors in heir identification, errors in share allocation, and missing or incorrect application of key inheritance rules such as 'awl and radd. The MAWARITH dataset is publicly available at https://gitlab.com/islamgpt1/qias_shared_task_2026.

title: Fusion Complexity Inversion: Why Simpler Cross View Modules Outperform SSMs and Cross View Attention Transformers for Pasture Biomass Regression
summary: Accurate estimation of pasture biomass from agricultural imagery is critical for sustainable livestock management, yet existing methods are limited by the small, imbalanced, and sparsely annotated datasets typical of real world monitoring. In this study, adaptation of vision foundation models to agricultural regression is systematically evaluated on the CSIRO Pasture Biomass benchmark, a 357 image dual view dataset with laboratory validated, component wise ground truth for five biomass targets, through 17 configurations spanning four backbones (EfficientNet-B3 to DINOv3-ViT-L), five cross view fusion mechanisms, and a 4x2 metadata factorial. A counterintuitive principle, termed "fusion complexity inversion", is uncovered: on scarce agricultural data, a two layer gated depthwise convolution (R^2 = 0.903) outperforms cross view attention transformers (0.833), bidirectional SSMs (0.819), and full Mamba (0.793, below the no fusion baseline). Backbone pretraining scale is found to monotonically dominate all architectural choices, with the DINOv2 -> DINOv3 upgrade alone yielding +5.0 R^2 points. Training only metadata (species, state, and NDVI) is shown to create a universal ceiling at R^2 ~ 0.829, collapsing an 8.4 point fusion spread to 0.1 points. Actionable guidelines for sparse agricultural benchmarks are established: backbone quality should be prioritized over fusion complexity, local modules preferred over global alternatives, and features unavailable at inference excluded.

AI.title_translation: 融合复杂度反转：为什么更简单的跨视图模块在牧场生物量回归中优于SSM和跨视图注意力Transformer
AI.tldr: 在稀疏的牧场生物量数据上，别用复杂的交叉视图注意力或SSM，简单的深度卷积融合效果更好；骨干网络越强，性能越好；推理时用不到的特征就别加。
AI.motivation: 准确估计牧场生物量对可持续牲畜管理至关重要，但现有方法受到真实世界监测中典型的少量、不平衡和稀疏标注数据集的限制。
AI.method: 在CSIRO牧场生物量基准数据集（357张双视图图像，五种生物量目标）上，系统评估了四种骨干网络、五种交叉视图融合机制和4x2元数据因子的17种配置，以评估不同融合机制的性能。
AI.result: 两层门控深度卷积（R^2 = 0.903）优于交叉视图注意力转换器（0.833）、双向SSM（0.819）和完整的Mamba（0.793）。骨干预训练规模单调主导所有架构选择，DINOv2到DINOv3的升级单独带来+5.0 R^2点提升。仅使用元数据训练会使性能上限限制在R^2 ~ 0.829。
AI.conclusion: 在稀疏农业基准测试中，应优先考虑骨干网络的质量而非融合的复杂性；偏好局部模块而非全局替代方案；并排除推理时不可用的特征。简单的两层门控深度卷积模块（R^2 = 0.903）优于复杂的交叉视图注意力转换器和SSMs。
AI.translation: 准确地从农业图像估计牧场生物量对于可持续牲畜管理至关重要，但现有方法受到真实世界监测中典型的少量、不平衡和稀疏标注数据集的限制。本研究在CSIRO牧场生物量基准数据集上，系统评估了视觉基础模型在农业回归中的适应性，该数据集包含357张双视图图像，具有实验室验证的五种生物量目标的组分级真值，通过涵盖四种骨干网络（EfficientNet-B3到DINOv3-ViT-L）、五种交叉视图融合机制和4x2元数据因子的17种配置。研究发现了一个违反直觉的原理，称为“融合复杂度反转”：在稀疏农业数据上，一个两层门控深度卷积（R^2 = 0.903）优于交叉视图注意力转换器（0.833）、双向SSM（0.819）和完整的Mamba（0.793，低于无融合基线）。骨干预训练规模被发现单调主导所有架构选择，仅DINOv2到DINOv3的升级就带来了+5.0 R^2点的提升。研究表明，仅训练元数据（物种、状态和NDVI）会将性能上限限制在R^2 ~ 0.829，使8.4点的融合差异缩小到0.1点。为稀疏农业基准测试确立了可操作的指南：应优先考虑骨干质量而非融合复杂度，偏好局部模块而非全局替代方案，并排除推理时不可用的特征。
AI.summary: 本研究系统评估了基础视觉模型在稀疏牧场生物量回归数据集上的性能，揭示了“融合复杂度反转”的现象：在数据稀疏时，简单的两层门控深度卷积融合优于复杂的交叉视图注意力或SSM。研究强调骨干网络的预训练质量比融合机制的复杂性更为关键，并为稀疏农业基准测试提供了优化指南。
AI.keywords: 牧场生物量回归, 融合复杂度反转, 交叉视图融合, 稀疏数据, 视觉基础模型
AI.comments: 该研究的核心创新在于提出了“融合复杂度反转”的原则，即在稀疏农业数据上，简单的模块优于复杂的SOTA模型（如SSMs和交叉视图注意力）。研究系统地评估了不同融合机制，并得出了针对稀疏数据集的实用建议，强调了骨干网络选择的重要性超过融合机制的复杂性。局限性在于仅在一个特定基准数据集上进行评估。

title: Tau-BNO: Brain Neural Operator for Tau Transport Model
summary: Mechanistic modeling provides a biophysically grounded framework for studying the spread of pathological tau protein in tauopathies like Alzheimer's disease. Existing approaches typically model tau propagation as a diffusive process on the brain's structural connectome, reproducing macroscopic patterns but neglecting microscale cellular transport and reaction mechanisms. The Network Transport Model (NTM) was introduced to fill this gap, explaining how region-level progression of tau emerges from microscale biophysical processes. However, the NTM faces a common challenge for complex models defined by large systems of partial differential equations: the inability to perform parameter inference and mechanistic discovery due to high computational burden and slow model simulations. To overcome this barrier, we propose Tau-BNO, a Brain Neural Operator surrogate framework for rapidly approximating NTM dynamics that captures both intra-regional reaction kinetics and inter-regional network transport. Tau-BNO combines a function operator that encodes kinetic parameters with a query operator that preserves initial state information, while approximating anisotropic transport through a spectral kernel that retains directionality. Empirical evaluations demonstrate high predictive accuracy ($R^2\approx$ 0.98) across diverse biophysical regimes and an 89\% performance improvement over state-of-the-art sequence models like Transformers and Mamba, which lack inherent structural priors. By reducing simulation time from hours to seconds, we show that the surrogate model is capable of producing new insights and generating new hypotheses. This framework is readily extensible to a broader class of connectome-based biophysical models, showcasing the transformative value of deep learning surrogates to accelerate analysis of large-scale, computationally intensive dynamical systems.

title: UIS-Digger: Towards Comprehensive Research Agent Systems for Real-world Unindexed Information Seeking
summary: Recent advancements in LLM-based information-seeking agents have achieved record-breaking performance on established benchmarks. However, these agents remain heavily reliant on search-engine-indexed knowledge, leaving a critical blind spot: Unindexed Information Seeking (UIS). This paper identifies and explores the UIS problem, where vital information is not captured by search engine crawlers, such as overlooked content, dynamic webpages, and embedded files. Despite its significance, UIS remains an underexplored challenge. To address this gap, we introduce UIS-QA, the first dedicated UIS benchmark, comprising 110 expert-annotated QA pairs. Notably, even state-of-the-art agents experience a drastic performance drop on UIS-QA (e.g., from 70.90 on GAIA and 46.70 on BrowseComp-zh to 24.55 on UIS-QA), underscoring the severity of the problem. To mitigate this, we propose UIS-Digger, a novel multi-agent framework that incorporates dual-mode browsing and enables simultaneous webpage searching and file parsing. With a relatively small $\sim$30B-parameter backbone LLM optimized using SFT and RFT training strategies, UIS-Digger sets a strong baseline at 27.27\%, outperforming systems integrating sophisticated LLMs such as O3 and GPT-4.1. This demonstrates the importance of proactive interaction with unindexed sources for effective and comprehensive information-seeking. Our work not only uncovers a fundamental limitation in current agent evaluation paradigms but also provides the first toolkit for advancing UIS research, defining a new and promising direction for robust information-seeking systems. The dataset has been released at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/UIS-Digger/UIS-QA.

AI.title_translation: 用于现实世界非索引信息检索的全面研究代理系统：UIS-Digger
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了UIS-DQA基准和UIS-Digger框架，以解决当前基于LLM的信息检索代理在处理非索引信息（如动态网页和嵌入式文件）方面的不足，并取得了优于现有先进模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的信息检索代理严重依赖搜索引擎索引的知识，忽略了非索引信息（UIS），而这些信息（如被忽略的内容、动态网页和嵌入式文件）至关重要。UIS仍然是一个未被充分探索的挑战。
AI.method: 提出UIS-QA，第一个专门的UIS基准，包含110个专家注释的QA对。提出UIS-Digger，一个新颖的多代理框架，采用双模式浏览，并能同时进行网页搜索和文件解析。使用SFT和RFT训练策略优化了一个约30B参数的主干LLM。
AI.result: 即使是最先进的代理在UIS-QA上的性能也急剧下降（例如，从GAIA上的70.90和BrowseComp-zh上的46.70下降到UIS-QA上的24.55）。UIS-Digger以27.27%的性能超过了集成O3和GPT-4.1等复杂LLM的系统。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作揭示了当前代理评估范式的一个基本限制，并提供了第一个用于推进UIS研究的工具包，为强大的信息检索系统定义了一个新的、有前途的方向。
AI.translation: 近期，基于LLM的信息检索代理在既定的基准测试中取得了破纪录的性能。然而，这些代理仍然严重依赖搜索引擎索引的知识，留下了一个关键的盲点：非索引信息检索（UIS）。本文识别并探讨了UIS问题，即重要信息未被搜索引擎爬虫捕获，例如被忽略的内容、动态网页和嵌入式文件。尽管UIS很重要，但它仍然是一个未被充分探索的挑战。为了解决这个差距，我们引入了UIS-QA，第一个专门的UIS基准，包含110个专家注释的QA对。值得注意的是，即使是最先进的代理在UIS-QA上的性能也急剧下降（例如，从GAIA上的70.90和BrowseComp-zh上的46.70下降到UIS-QA上的24.55），这凸显了问题的严重性。为了缓解这个问题，我们提出了UIS-Digger，一个新颖的多代理框架，它集成了双模式浏览，并能够同时进行网页搜索和文件解析。UIS-Digger使用了一个拥有约30B参数、通过SFT和RFT训练策略优化的主干LLM，取得了27.27%的良好基线性能，超越了集成O3和GPT-4.1等复杂LLM的系统。这表明了主动与非索引源交互对于有效和全面的信息检索的重要性。我们的工作不仅揭示了当前代理评估范式的一个基本限制，而且提供了第一个推进UIS研究的工具包，为鲁棒的信息检索系统定义了一个新的、有前途的方向。该数据集已在：https://huggingface.co/datasets/UIS-Digger/UIS-QA发布。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了UIS-Digger，一个针对现实世界非索引信息检索（UIS）的研究代理系统。作者提出了首个UIS基准UIS-QA，并开发了一个名为UIS-Digger的多代理框架，该框架采用双模式浏览，能够同时搜索网页和解析文件。实验表明，UIS-Digger在处理非索引信息方面优于现有最先进的代理，解决了当前信息检索代理在处理非索引信息方面的关键盲点，并为未来的研究指明了方向。
AI.keywords: 非索引信息检索, 研究代理系统, LLM, 多代理框架, UIS-QA
AI.comments: 这项工作解决了现有信息检索代理的一个关键但被忽视的方面——非索引信息检索（UIS）。通过引入UIS-QA基准和UIS-Digger框架，作者为该领域的研究提供了一个重要的起点。UIS-Digger的有效性，即使是使用一个相对较小的模型，也强调了专门针对UIS问题设计的框架的重要性。然而，该方法在处理复杂嵌入式文件或非常规动态网页方面的鲁棒性仍有待进一步评估。此外，虽然UIS-Digger在基准测试中表现出色，但在真实世界复杂场景下的可扩展性和效率也值得关注。

title: Stein Variational Ergodic Surface Coverage with SE(3) Constraints
summary: Surface manipulation tasks require robots to generate trajectories that comprehensively cover complex 3D surfaces while maintaining precise end-effector poses. Existing ergodic trajectory optimization (TO) methods demonstrate success in coverage tasks, while struggling with point-cloud targets due to the nonconvex optimization landscapes and the inadequate handling of SE(3) constraints in sampling-as-optimization (SAO) techniques. In this work, we introduce a preconditioned SE(3) Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD) approach for SAO ergodic trajectory generation. Our proposed approach comprises multiple innovations. First, we reformulate point-cloud ergodic coverage as a manifold-aware sampling problem. Second, we derive SE(3)-specific SVGD particle updates, and, third, we develop a preconditioner to accelerate TO convergence. Our sampling-based framework consistently identifies superior local optima compared to strong optimization-based and SAO baselines while preserving the SE(3) geometric structure. Experiments on a 3D point-cloud surface coverage benchmark and robotic surface drawing tasks demonstrate that our method achieves superior coverage quality with tractable computation in our setting relative to existing TO and SAO approaches, and is validated in real-world robot experiments.

AI.title_translation: 具有SE(3)约束的Stein遍历表面覆盖
AI.tldr: 针对机器人点云表面覆盖，提出了一种结合SE(3)约束的Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）方法，作为采样即优化（SAO）框架，它比现有优化和SAO方法更好地解决了非凸性和姿态约束问题，实现了更优的覆盖效果。
AI.motivation: 现有遍历轨迹优化（TO）方法在处理点云目标时，由于优化景观的非凸性和采样即优化（SAO）技术对SE(3)约束处理不足，导致在需要精确末端执行器姿态的表面操作任务中表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出了一种预处理的SE(3) Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）方法用于SAO遍历轨迹生成。具体包括：1. 将点云遍历覆盖重新表述为流形感知的采样问题；2. 推导出SE(3)特定的SVGD粒子更新；3. 开发了一个预处理器以加速轨迹优化（TO）的收敛。
AI.result: 所提出的采样基框架一致地识别出优于强优化基线和SAO基线的局部最优解，同时保持了SE(3)几何结构。实验证明，该方法在3D点云表面覆盖基准和机器人表面绘制任务中，实现了优于现有TO和SAO方法的覆盖质量和可处理的计算量。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于采样的框架能够一致地识别出优于强大的基于优化和SAO基线的局部最优解，同时保持了SE(3)几何结构。实验证明，在3D点云表面覆盖基准测试和机器人表面绘制任务中，该方法实现了优于现有TO和SAO方法的覆盖质量，且计算量可控，并在真实机器人实验中得到了验证。
AI.translation: 表面操作任务要求机器人在生成全面覆盖复杂3D表面的轨迹的同时，保持精确的末端执行器姿态。现有的遍历轨迹优化（TO）方法在覆盖任务中取得了成功，但在处理点云目标时，由于优化景观的非凸性和采样即优化（SAO）技术对SE(3)约束处理不足，表现不佳。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种用于SAO遍历轨迹生成中预处理的SE(3) Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）方法。我们提出的方法包含多项创新。首先，我们将点云遍历覆盖重新表述为一种流形感知的采样问题。其次，我们推导了SE(3)特定的SVGD粒子更新，第三，我们开发了一个预处理器以加速TO的收敛。我们的基于采样的框架与强大的基于优化和SAO基线相比，一致地识别出更优的局部最优解，同时保持了SE(3)几何结构。在3D点云表面覆盖基准测试和机器人表面绘制任务上的实验表明，我们的方法在我们的设置下相对于现有的TO和SAO方法实现了更优的覆盖质量和可处理的计算量，并在真实机器人实验中得到了验证。
AI.summary: 本文针对机器人表面操作中点云覆盖的挑战，引入了一种预处理的SE(3) Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）方法用于采样即优化（SAO）遍历轨迹生成。该方法通过流形感知采样、SE(3)-SVGD更新和收敛加速预处理器，成功解决了现有方法在处理非凸优化和SE(3)约束方面的不足，并在实验中展现了优越的覆盖质量和几何结构保持能力。
AI.keywords: Stein变分梯度下降, SE(3)约束, 遍历轨迹优化, 采样即优化, 表面覆盖
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地将SE(3)约束引入到Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）框架中，解决了点云表面覆盖任务中优化非凸性和SE(3)约束处理不当的问题。其优势在于基于采样的框架能找到比现有优化方法更优的局部最优解，同时保持了SE(3)的几何结构。局限性可能在于计算效率（尽管声称可控）与现有强优化基线相比的实际性能差异。

title: Defining AI Models and AI Systems: A Framework to Resolve the Boundary Problem
comments: Added paragraph in Section 5.5.2 discussing model modifications; corrected typos
summary: Emerging AI regulations assign distinct obligations to different actors along the AI value chain (e.g., the EU AI Act distinguishes providers and deployers for both AI models and AI systems), yet the foundational terms "AI model" and "AI system" lack clear, consistent definitions. Through a systematic review of 896 academic papers and a manual review of over 80 regulatory, standards, and technical or policy documents, we analyze existing definitions from multiple conceptual perspectives. We then trace definitional lineages and paradigm shifts over time, finding that most standards and regulatory definitions derive from the OECD's frameworks, which evolved in ways that compounded rather than resolved conceptual ambiguities. The ambiguity of the boundary between an AI model and an AI system creates practical difficulties in determining obligations for different actors, and raises questions on whether certain modifications performed are specific to the model as opposed to the non-model system components. We propose conceptual definitions grounded in the nature of models and systems and the relationship between them, then develop operational definitions for contemporary neural network-based machine-learning AI: models consist of trained parameters and architecture, while systems consist of the model plus additional components including an interface for processing inputs and outputs. Finally, we discuss implications for regulatory implementation and examine how our definitions contribute to resolving ambiguities in allocating responsibilities across the AI value chain, in both theoretical scenarios and case studies involving real-world incidents.
comment: Added paragraph in Section 5.5.2 discussing model modifications; corrected typos

AI.title_translation: 定义AI模型和AI系统：一个解决边界问题的框架
AI.tldr: 新兴的AI法规对AI模型和AI系统施加不同的义务，但“AI模型”和“AI系统”的定义模糊不清。本文通过系统综述和文献分析，追溯了现有定义的演变，发现其未能解决概念模糊性。作者提出了基于模型和系统性质的概念性定义，并为基于神经网络的机器学习AI开发了操作性定义，以解决AI价值链中责任分配的模糊性。
AI.motivation: 新兴的AI法规（如欧盟AI法案）对AI价值链中的不同参与者（如AI模型和AI系统的提供者和部署者）规定了不同的义务，但“AI模型”和“AI系统”这两个基础术语缺乏清晰、一致的定义。这种模糊性导致了在确定不同参与者义务时的实际困难，并引发了关于某些修改是针对模型还是非模型系统组件的问题。
AI.method: 本文通过对896篇学术论文进行系统综述，并手动审查了80多份监管、标准、技术或政策文件，从多个概念视角分析了现有定义。作者追溯了定义谱系和范式转变，发现大多数标准和监管定义源自OECD框架。在此基础上，作者提出了基于模型和系统性质及其之间关系的概念性定义，并为当代基于神经网络的机器学习AI开发了操作性定义。
AI.result: 研究发现，大多数标准和监管定义源自OECD框架，而这些框架的演变未能解决反而加剧了概念模糊性。作者提出了具体的操作性定义：模型由训练参数和架构组成，而系统则由模型加上额外的组件（包括用于处理输入和输出的接口）组成。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的定义有助于解决AI价值链中责任分配的模糊性，无论是在理论情景还是涉及真实世界事件的案例研究中，都对监管实施具有重要意义。通过明确AI模型和AI系统的边界，可以更好地确定不同参与者的义务。
AI.translation: 新兴的AI法规对AI价值链中的不同参与者（例如，欧盟AI法案区分了AI模型和AI系统的提供者和部署者）施加了不同的义务，但“AI模型”和“AI系统”这两个基础术语缺乏清晰、一致的定义。通过对896篇学术论文的系统综述和对80多份监管、标准、技术或政策文件的手动审查，我们从多个概念视角分析了现有定义。然后，我们追溯了定义谱系和范式转变，发现大多数标准和监管定义源自经济合作与发展组织（OECD）的框架，而这些框架的演变未能解决反而加剧了概念模糊性。AI模型和AI系统之间边界的模糊性给确定不同参与者的义务带来了实际困难，并引发了关于某些修改是针对模型还是非模型系统组件的问题。我们提出了基于模型和系统性质及其之间关系的概念性定义，然后为当代基于神经网络的机器学习AI开发了操作性定义：模型由训练参数和架构组成，而系统则由模型加上额外的组件（包括用于处理输入和输出的接口）组成。最后，我们讨论了对监管实施的影响，并探讨了我们的定义如何有助于解决AI价值链中责任分配的模糊性，包括在理论情景和涉及真实世界事件的案例研究中。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在解决AI模型和AI系统定义不清的问题，这在日益复杂的AI监管环境中造成了实际困难。通过对大量学术论文和政策文件的系统性审查，作者揭示了现有定义（尤其源自OECD框架的定义）如何未能有效解决概念模糊性。为应对此挑战，论文提出了基于模型和系统本质的概念性定义，并为基于神经网络的机器学习AI提供了操作性定义：模型是训练参数和架构，而系统则是模型及额外组件。这些明确的定义旨在为AI价值链中的责任分配提供清晰的框架，并对监管实施具有重要意义。
AI.keywords: AI模型, AI系统, 定义, 边界问题, AI监管
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于其对AI模型和AI系统边界问题的深入剖析，并提出了具有操作性的定义，对于AI监管和责任分配具有基础性意义。其系统性的文献回顾方法论严谨，发现OECD框架未能解决反而加剧模糊性的洞察也颇具价值。这项工作对于未来AI法规的制定和现有法规的实施都提供了重要的理论支撑和实践指导。

title: Amnesia: Adversarial Semantic Layer Specific Activation Steering in Large Language Models
summary:
Warning: This article includes red-teaming experiments, which contain examples of compromised LLM responses that may be offensive or upsetting.
  Large Language Models (LLMs) have the potential to create harmful content, such as generating sophisticated phishing emails and assisting in writing code of harmful computer viruses. Thus, it is crucial to ensure their safe and responsible response generation. To reduce the risk of generating harmful or irresponsible content, researchers have developed techniques such as reinforcement learning with human feedback to align LLM's outputs with human values and preferences. However, it is still undetermined whether such measures are sufficient to prevent LLMs from generating interesting responses. In this study, we propose Amnesia, a lightweight activation-space adversarial attack that manipulates internal transformer states to bypass existing safety mechanisms in open-weight LLMs. Through experimental analysis on state-of-the-art, open-weight LLMs, we demonstrate that our attack effectively circumvents existing safeguards, enabling the generation of harmful content without the need for any fine-tuning or additional training. Our experiments on benchmark datasets show that the proposed attack can induce various antisocial behaviors in LLMs. These findings highlight the urgent need for more robust security measures in open-weight LLMs and underscore the importance of continued research to prevent their potential misuse.

AI.title_translation: 遗忘：大型语言模型中对抗性语义层特定激活转向
AI.tldr: 本研究提出Amnesia，一种轻量级激活空间对抗攻击，通过操纵大型语言模型（LLM）的内部Transformer状态来绕过现有安全机制，从而无需微调即可生成有害内容。这强调了开源LLM中更强大安全措施的紧迫需求。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）有生成有害内容的潜力，例如复杂的网络钓鱼邮件和恶意软件代码。尽管研究人员已开发出如通过人类反馈进行强化学习等技术来使LLM输出与人类价值观对齐，但这些措施是否足以防止LLM生成有害响应仍未确定。
AI.method: 本文提出Amnesia，一种轻量级的激活空间对抗攻击。该方法通过操纵LLM内部的Transformer状态来绕过开源LLM中现有的安全机制，且无需进行任何微调或额外训练。
AI.result: 实验分析表明，Amnesia攻击能够有效规避现有安全防护措施，从而生成有害内容。在基准数据集上的实验显示，该攻击可以诱导LLM产生各种反社会行为。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现强调了开源LLM中对更强大安全措施的迫切需求，并凸显了继续研究以防止其潜在滥用的重要性。
AI.translation:
警告：本文包含红队实验，其中包含可能具有攻击性或令人不安的受损LLM响应示例。
大型语言模型（LLM）有潜力创建有害内容，例如生成复杂的网络钓鱼电子邮件和协助编写有害计算机病毒代码。因此，确保它们安全和负责任地生成响应至关重要。为了降低生成有害或不负责任内容的风险，研究人员开发了诸如通过人类反馈进行强化学习等技术，以使LLM的输出与人类价值观和偏好保持一致。然而，这些措施是否足以防止LLM生成“有趣”的响应仍不确定。在这项研究中，我们提出了Amnesia，一种轻量级的激活空间对抗攻击，它通过操纵内部Transformer状态来绕过开源LLM中现有的安全机制。通过对最先进的开源LLM进行实验分析，我们证明了我们的攻击能够有效规避现有安全防护措施，从而无需任何微调或额外训练即可生成有害内容。我们在基准数据集上的实验表明，所提出的攻击可以诱导LLM产生各种反社会行为。这些发现强调了开源LLM中对更强大安全措施的迫切需求，并强调了继续研究以防止其潜在滥用的重要性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍Amnesia，一种轻量级激活空间对抗攻击，旨在通过操纵大型语言模型（LLM）的内部Transformer状态来绕过现有安全机制。研究表明，该攻击无需微调即可有效规避开源LLM的防护措施，使其生成有害内容和反社会行为。这些发现强调了当前LLM安全措施的不足，并呼吁加强安全防护和持续研究以防范潜在滥用。
AI.keywords: 对抗攻击, 大型语言模型, 安全机制, 激活空间, 有害内容
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于提出了一种在激活空间进行轻量级对抗攻击的方法，能够有效绕过大型语言模型的现有安全机制，且无需进行额外的训练或微调。这对于揭示当前LLM安全防护的脆弱性以及推动更鲁棒的安全策略的开发具有重要意义。然而，这种攻击方法本身也可能被恶意利用，因此其潜在影响需要被谨慎考虑。

title: DUCTILE: Agentic LLM Orchestration of Engineering Analysis in Product Development Practice
summary: Engineering analysis automation in product development relies on rigid interfaces between tools, data formats and documented processes. When these interfaces change, as they routinely do as the product evolves in the engineering ecosystem, the automation support breaks. This paper presents a DUCTILE (Delegated, User-supervised Coordination of Tool- and document-Integrated LLM-Enabled) agentic orchestration, an approach for developing, executing and evaluating LLM-based agentic automation support of engineering analysis tasks. The approach separates adaptive orchestration, performed by the LLM agent, from deterministic execution, performed by verified engineering tools. The agent interprets documented design practices, inspects input data and adapts the processing path, while the engineer supervises and exercises final judgment. DUCTILE is demonstrated on an industrial structural analysis task at an aerospace manufacturer, where the agent handled input deviations in format, units, naming conventions and methodology that would break traditional scripted pipelines. Evaluation against expert-defined acceptance criteria and deployment with practicing engineers confirm that the approach produces correct, methodologically compliant results across 10 repeated independent runs. The paper discusses the paradigm shift and the practical consequences of adopting agentic automation, including unintended effects on the nature of engineering work when removing mundane tasks and creating an exhausting supervisory role.

title: EmoStory: Emotion-Aware Story Generation
summary: Story generation aims to produce image sequences that depict coherent narratives while maintaining subject consistency across frames. Although existing methods have excelled in producing coherent and expressive stories, they remain largely emotion-neutral, focusing on what subject appears in a story while overlooking how emotions shape narrative interpretation and visual presentation. As stories are intended to engage audiences emotionally, we introduce emotion-aware story generation, a new task that aims to generate subject-consistent visual stories with explicit emotional directions. This task is challenging due to the abstract nature of emotions, which must be grounded in concrete visual elements and consistently expressed across a narrative through visual composition. To address these challenges, we propose EmoStory, a two-stage framework that integrates agent-based story planning and region-aware story generation. The planning stage transforms target emotions into coherent story prompts with emotion agent and writer agent, while the generation stage preserves subject consistency and injects emotion-related elements through region-aware composition. We evaluate EmoStory on a newly constructed dataset covering 25 subjects and 600 emotional stories. Extensive quantitative and qualitative results, along with user studies, show that EmoStory outperforms state-of-the-art story generation methods in emotion accuracy, prompt alignment, and subject consistency.

AI.tldr: EmoStory是一个新的框架，用于生成具有情感指导的视觉故事，通过基于智能体的故事规划和区域感知的图像生成来解决情感的抽象性问题，并在准确性、一致性和提示对齐方面优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有故事生成方法主要关注主体一致性，忽略了情感如何影响叙事和视觉呈现，而故事的目的是引起情感共鸣。
AI.method: EmoStory采用一个两阶段框架：1. 规划阶段：利用情感智能体和写作智能体将目标情感转化为连贯的故事提示。2. 生成阶段：通过区域感知组合来保持主体一致性并注入与情感相关的元素。
AI.result: EmoStory在情感准确性、提示对齐和主体一致性方面优于最先进的故事生成方法，并在新构建的数据集上进行了评估。
AI.conclusion: EmoStory成功地解决了情感感知的故事生成任务，通过其创新的两阶段框架实现了情感准确性和主体一致性的结合，为生成更具情感吸引力的视觉故事提供了新的途径。
AI.translation: 故事生成旨在生成描绘连贯叙事并跨帧保持主体一致性的图像序列。尽管现有方法在生成连贯和富有表现力的故事方面表现出色，但它们在很大程度上是情绪中立的，侧重于故事中出现的主体，而忽略了情感如何塑造叙事解读和视觉呈现。由于故事旨在引起观众的情感共鸣，我们引入了情感感知的故事生成，这是一项旨在生成具有明确情感指导的主体一致的视觉故事的新任务。这项任务具有挑战性，因为情感的抽象性质，必须将其植根于具体的视觉元素，并通过视觉构成在整个叙事中持续表达。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了EmoStory，一个整合了基于智能体的故事规划和区域感知的图像生成的两阶段框架。规划阶段将目标情感转化为具有情感智能体和写作智能体的连贯故事提示，而生成阶段则通过区域感知的组合来保持主体一致性并注入与情感相关的元素。我们在一个新构建的涵盖25个主体和600个情感故事的数据集上评估了EmoStory。广泛的定量和定性结果以及用户研究表明，EmoStory在情感准确性、提示对齐和主体一致性方面优于最先进的故事生成方法。
AI.summary: EmoStory是一个新颖的两阶段框架，旨在通过整合基于智能体的故事规划和区域感知的图像生成来解决情感感知的故事生成任务。该框架首先将情感指令转化为连贯的故事提示，然后生成具有主体一致性和情感表达的视觉故事。实验结果表明，EmoStory在情感准确性、提示对齐和主体一致性方面均优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 情感感知的故事生成, 故事规划, 区域感知生成, 主体一致性, 情感准确性
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个名为EmoStory的新颖框架，用于情感感知的故事生成，解决了现有方法在情感表达方面的不足。其两阶段方法，结合了基于智能体的规划和区域感知的生成，有效地处理了情感的抽象性和视觉表现之间的联系。新数据集的构建和全面的评估也增强了该研究的贡献。然而，未来可以进一步探索更复杂的情感交互和跨文化的情感表达。

title: Med-DualLoRA: Local Adaptation of Foundation Models for 3D Cardiac MRI
summary: Foundation models (FMs) show great promise for robust downstream performance across medical imaging tasks and modalities, including cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR), following task-specific adaptation. However, adaptation using single-site data may lead to suboptimal performance and increased model bias, while centralized fine-tuning on clinical data is often infeasible due to privacy constraints. Federated fine-tuning offers a privacy-preserving alternative; yet conventional approaches struggle under heterogeneous, non-IID multi-center data and incur substantial communication overhead when adapting large models. In this work, we study federated FM fine-tuning for 3D CMR disease detection and propose Med-DualLoRA, a client-aware parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) federated framework that disentangles globally shared and local low-rank adaptations (LoRA) through additive decomposition. Global and local LoRA modules are trained locally, but only the global component is shared and aggregated across sites, keeping local adapters private. This design improves personalization while significantly reducing communication cost, and experiments show that adapting only two transformer blocks preserves performance while further improving efficiency. We evaluate our method on a multi-center state-of-the-art cine 3D CMR FM fine-tuned for disease detection using ACDC and combined M\&Ms datasets, treating each vendor as a federated client. Med-DualLoRA achieves statistically significant improved performance (balanced accuracy 0.768, specificity 0.612) compared to other federated PEFT baselines, while maintaining communication efficiency. Our approach provides a scalable solution for local federated adaptation of medical FMs under realistic clinical constraints.

AI.title_translation: 医疗双LoRA：基础模型在3D心脏MRI中的局部适应
AI.tldr: Med-DualLoRA是一种新的联邦学习框架，通过解耦全局共享和局部低秩适应，实现了在异构多中心数据上对3D心脏MRI基础模型进行参数高效的隐私保护微调，显著提高了性能并降低了通信成本。
AI.motivation: 在医学影像任务（包括心脏MRI）中，基础模型（FMs）在经过特定任务适应后表现出强大的下游性能。然而，使用单一站点数据进行适应可能导致性能不佳和模型偏差增加，而由于隐私限制，集中式微调临床数据通常不可行。联邦微调是一种隐私保护的替代方案，但传统方法在异构、非IID多中心数据下表现不佳，并且在适应大型模型时会产生巨大的通信开销。
AI.method: 提出Med-DualLoRA，一个客户端感知的参数高效微调（PEFT）联邦框架，通过加性分解解耦全局共享和局部低秩适应（LoRA）。全局和局部LoRA模块在本地训练，但只有全局组件跨站点共享和聚合，从而保护本地适配器的隐私。实验中，仅适应两个Transformer块即可在保持性能的同时提高效率。
AI.result: 在ACDC和M&Ms数据集上进行的评估表明，Med-DualLoRA在3D心脏MRI疾病检测方面，相比其他联邦PEFT基线，实现了统计学上显著的性能提升（平衡准确率0.768，特异度0.612），同时保持了通信效率。
AI.conclusion: Med-DualLoRA提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，可在真实的临床限制下对医学FM进行局部联邦适应。
AI.translation: 基础模型（FMs）在医学影像任务和模态（包括心脏磁共振（CMR））中，在经过特定任务适应后，表现出强大的下游性能。然而，使用单一站点数据进行适应可能导致性能不佳和模型偏差增加，而由于隐私限制，集中式微调临床数据通常不可行。联邦微调提供了一种隐私保护的替代方案；然而，传统方法在异构、非IID多中心数据下表现不佳，并且在适应大型模型时会产生巨大的通信开销。在本研究中，我们研究了用于3D心脏疾病检测的联邦FM微调，并提出了Med-DualLoRA，一个客户端感知的参数高效微调（PEFT）联邦框架，该框架通过加性分解解耦了全局共享和局部的低秩适应（LoRA）。全局和局部LoRA模块在本地训练，但只有全局组件跨站点共享和聚合，从而保护了本地适配器的隐私。这种设计提高了个性化，同时显著降低了通信成本，实验表明，仅适应两个Transformer块即可在提高效率的同时保持性能。我们在ACDC和M&Ms数据集上对一个多中心最先进的3D心脏MRI FM进行了评估，该FM经过微调以进行疾病检测，并将每个供应商视为一个联邦客户端。Med-DualLoRA在统计学上显著优于其他联邦PEFT基线（平衡准确率0.768，特异度0.612），同时保持了通信效率。我们的方法为在现实临床限制下进行医学FM的局部联邦适应提供了一个可扩展的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了Med-DualLoRA，一种创新的联邦学习框架，用于在3D心脏MRI疾病检测任务中适应基础模型。该方法通过解耦全局共享和局部低秩适应（LoRA）模块，实现了参数高效的隐私保护微调。Med-DualLoRA在处理异构、非IID多中心数据时表现出色，显著降低了通信开销，同时提高了模型的个性化和整体性能，在ACDC和M&Ms数据集上取得了优于现有基线的统计学显著的成果。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 基础模型, 参数高效微调, 心脏MRI, 低秩适应
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的联邦学习方法Med-DualLoRA，解决了在处理异构多中心心脏MRI数据时对基础模型进行隐私保护和通信高效适应的挑战。通过解耦全局和局部LoRA模块，该方法在提高模型性能和降低通信成本方面取得了显著进展。然而，未来可以进一步研究其在不同模态和任务上的泛化能力，以及对不同程度数据异构性的鲁棒性。

title: Measuring AI Agents' Progress on Multi-Step Cyber Attack Scenarios
summary: We evaluate the autonomous cyber-attack capabilities of frontier AI models on two purpose-built cyber ranges-a 32-step corporate network attack and a 7-step industrial control system attack-that require chaining heterogeneous capabilities across extended action sequences. By comparing seven models released over an eighteen-month period (August 2024 to February 2026) at varying inference-time compute budgets, we observe two capability trends. First, model performance scales log-linearly with inference-time compute, with no observed plateau-increasing from 10M to 100M tokens yields gains of up to 59%, requiring no specific technical sophistication from the operator. Second, each successive model generation outperforms its predecessor at fixed token budgets: on the corporate network range, average steps completed at 10M tokens rose from 1.7 (GPT-4o, August 2024) to 9.8 (Opus 4.6, February 2026). The best single run completed 22 of 32 steps, corresponding to roughly 6 of the estimated 14 hours a human expert would need. On the industrial control system range, performance remains limited, though the most recent models are the first to reliably complete steps, averaging 1.2-1.4 of 7 (max 3).

AI.title_translation: 衡量人工智能代理在多步骤网络攻击场景中的进展
AI.tldr: AI模型在模拟网络攻击方面取得了显著进展，性能随计算量和模型代际提升而提高，但在工业控制系统攻击方面仍有限。
AI.motivation: 评估前沿AI模型在需要串联异构能力的多步网络攻击场景中的自主网络攻击能力。
AI.method: 使用两个专门构建的网络靶场（一个32步的公司网络攻击，一个7步的工业控制系统攻击）来评估七种不同AI模型在18个月内（2024年8月至2026年2月）的自主网络攻击能力，并比较它们在不同推理时间计算预算下的表现。
AI.result: AI模型性能随推理计算量呈对数线性增长，计算量增加10倍可提升高达59%的性能。新一代模型在固定计算量下优于前代模型。在公司网络靶场，平均完成步骤从GPT-4o的1.7步（2024年8月）提升至Opus 4.6的9.8步（2026年2月）。最佳单次运行完成了32步中的22步。在工业控制系统靶场，性能仍然有限，但最新模型首次能够可靠地完成步骤，平均完成1.2-1.4步（共7步），最多可完成3步。
AI.conclusion: AI模型在网络攻击能力方面取得了显著进展，特别是在公司网络攻击场景中，性能随着计算量和模型代际的提升而不断提高。然而，在更复杂的工业控制系统攻击场景中，其能力仍然有限，需要进一步的研究和发展。
AI.translation: 我们评估了前沿AI模型在两个专门构建的网络靶场上的自主网络攻击能力——一个32步的公司网络攻击和一个7步的工业控制系统攻击——这些靶场需要跨越扩展动作序列的异构能力串联。通过比较在18个月内（2024年8月至2026年2月）发布的七种模型在不同推理时间计算预算下的表现，我们观察到两种能力趋势。首先，模型性能随推理计算量呈对数线性增长，没有观察到平台期——从1000万增加到1亿个token可带来高达59%的提升，且不需要操作员具备特定的技术复杂性。其次，每一代 successive 模型在固定token预算下都优于其前代模型：在公司网络靶场，1000万token下的平均完成步骤从1.7步（GPT-4o，2024年8月）上升到9.8步（Opus 4.6，2026年2月）。最佳单次运行完成了32步中的22步，大约相当于人类专家所需估计的14小时中的6小时。在工业控制系统靶场，性能仍然受限，但最新模型是首次能够可靠完成步骤的模型，平均完成7步中的1.2-1.4步（最多3步）。
AI.summary: 该研究评估了多款前沿AI模型在模拟多步网络攻击场景中的自主能力。通过在公司网络和工业控制系统（ICS）的专用网络靶场中进行测试，研究发现AI模型的性能与推理计算量呈对数线性关系，并且新一代模型在固定计算量下表现优于前代。虽然在公司网络攻击方面取得了显著进步，但AI模型在ICS攻击方面仍面临挑战，表现有限。
AI.keywords: AI代理, 网络攻击, 网络靶场, 模型性能, 计算量
AI.comments: 这项研究为评估AI在网络安全领域的进展提供了一个量化的框架。研究结果表明AI能力在快速发展，但同时也指出了在复杂和关键基础设施场景中仍存在的局限性。未来的研究可以关注提升AI在ICS等领域的鲁棒性和安全性，以及开发更精细的评估指标。

title: Relaxed Efficient Acquisition of Context and Temporal Features
summary: In many biomedical applications, measurements are not freely available at inference time: each laboratory test, imaging modality, or assessment incurs financial cost, time burden, or patient risk. Longitudinal active feature acquisition (LAFA) seeks to optimize predictive performance under such constraints by adaptively selecting measurements over time, yet the problem remains inherently challenging due to temporally coupled decisions (missed early measurements cannot be revisited, and acquisition choices influence all downstream predictions). Moreover, real-world clinical workflows typically begin with an initial onboarding phase, during which relatively stable contextual descriptors (e.g., demographics or baseline characteristics) are collected once and subsequently condition longitudinal decision-making. Despite its practical importance, the efficient selection of onboarding context has not been studied jointly with temporally adaptive acquisition. We therefore propose REACT (Relaxed Efficient Acquisition of Context and Temporal features), an end-to-end differentiable framework that simultaneously optimizes (i) selection of onboarding contextual descriptors and (ii) adaptive feature--time acquisition plans for longitudinal measurements under cost constraints. REACT employs a Gumbel--Sigmoid relaxation with straight-through estimation to enable gradient-based optimization over discrete acquisition masks, allowing direct backpropagation from prediction loss and acquisition cost. Across real-world longitudinal health and behavioral datasets, REACT achieves improved predictive performance at lower acquisition costs compared to existing longitudinal acquisition baselines, demonstrating the benefit of modeling onboarding and temporally coupled acquisition within a unified optimization framework.

title: BEACON: Budget-Aware Entity Matching Across Domains (Extended Technical Report)
comments: This paper is the extended version of "BEACON: Budget-Aware Entity Matching Across Domains" to appear in Proc. ACM SIGMOD International Conference on Management of Data (SIGMOD 2026)
summary: Entity Matching (EM)--the task of determining whether two data records refer to the same real-world entity--is a core task in data integration. Recent advances in deep learning have set a new standard for EM, particularly through fine-tuning Pretrained Language Models (PLMs) and, more recently, Large Language Models (LLMs). However, fine-tuning typically requires large amounts of labeled data, which are expensive and time-consuming to obtain. In the context of e-commerce matching, labeling scarcity varies widely across domains, raising the question of how to intelligently train accurate domain-specific EM models with limited labeled data. In this work we assume users have only a limited amount of labels for a specific target domain but have access to labeled data from other domains. We introduce BEACON, a distribution-aware, budget-aware framework for low-resource EM across domains. BEACON leverages the insight that embedding representations of pairwise candidate matches can guide the effective selection of out-of-domain samples under limited in-domain supervision. We conduct extensive experiments across multiple domain-partitioned datasets derived from established EM benchmarks, demonstrating that BEACON consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods under different training budgets.
comment: This paper is the extended version of "BEACON: Budget-Aware Entity Matching Across Domains" to appear in Proc. ACM SIGMOD International Conference on Management of Data (SIGMOD 2026)

title: Attention Sinks Are Provably Necessary in Softmax Transformers: Evidence from Trigger-Conditional Tasks
summary: Transformers often display an attention sink: probability mass concentrates on a fixed, content-agnostic position. Are sinks a byproduct of the optimization/training regime? Or are they sometimes functionally necessary in softmax Transformers? Are sinks a byproduct of the optimization/training regime? Or are they sometimes functionally necessary in softmax Transformers? We prove that, in some settings, it is the latter: computing a simple trigger-conditional behavior necessarily induces a sink in softmax self-attention models. Our results formalize a familiar intuition: normalization over a probability simplex must force attention to collapse onto a stable anchor to realize a default state (e.g., when the model needs to ignore the input). We instantiate this with a concrete task: when a designated trigger token appears, the model must return the average of all preceding token representations, and otherwise output zero, a task which mirrors the functionality of attention heads in the wild (Barbero et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2024). We also prove that non-normalized ReLU attention can solve the same task without any sink, confirming that the normalization constraint is the fundamental driver of sink behavior. Experiments validate our predictions and demonstrate they extend beyond the theoretically analyzed setting: softmax models develop strong sinks while ReLU attention eliminates them in both single-head and multi-head variants.

AI.title_translation: Softmax Transformer 中的 Attention Sinks 被证明是必需的：来自触发器条件任务的证据
AI.tldr: 在 Softmax Transformer 中，Attention Sinks（注意力汇聚点）在某些情况下是必需的，特别是当需要实现触发器条件行为时。这是由于概率单纯形上的归一化约束强制注意力塌陷到某个固定位置以实现默认状态。ReLU Attention 在没有归一化的情况下可以解决相同任务而无需 Attention Sinks。实验验证了这些理论预测。
AI.motivation: 探究 Attention Sinks（注意力汇聚点）是优化/训练的副产品，还是在 Softmax Transformer 中有时是功能上必需的。
AI.method: 证明在某些设置下，计算触发器条件行为必然会在 Softmax Self-Attention 模型中产生一个 Sink。通过一个具体的触发器条件任务来实例化，并与非归一化的 ReLU Attention 进行比较。
AI.result: Softmax 模型会形成强烈的 Attention Sinks，而 ReLU Attention 则消除了它们，这在单头和多头模型中都得到了验证。这证实了归一化是导致 Sink 行为的根本原因。
AI.conclusion: 在 Softmax Transformer 中，Attention Sinks 在需要触发器条件行为时是功能上必需的，这是由概率归一化引起的。ReLU Attention 可以避免这个问题。
AI.translation: Transformer 通常会显示出一种注意力汇聚点（attention sink）：概率质量集中在一个固定的、与内容无关的位置。汇聚点是优化/训练机制的副产品吗？还是它们有时在 Softmax Transformer 中是功能上必需的？我们证明，在某些情况下，后者是正确的：计算一个简单的触发器条件行为必然会在 Softmax 自注意力模型中产生一个汇聚点。我们的结果将一个熟悉的直觉形式化：概率单纯形上的归一化必须强制注意力塌陷到一个稳定的锚点，以实现默认状态（例如，当模型需要忽略输入时）。我们通过一个具体的任务来实现这一点：当出现指定的触发器标记时，模型必须返回所有先前标记表示的平均值，否则输出零，这个任务反映了实际注意力头的功能（Barbero et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2024）。我们还证明了非归一化的 ReLU 注意力可以在没有任何汇聚点的情况下解决相同的任务，证实了归一化约束是汇聚点行为的基本驱动因素。实验验证了我们的预测，并表明它们超出了理论分析的范围：Softmax 模型会形成强烈的汇聚点，而 ReLU 注意力在单头和多头变体中都消除了它们。
AI.summary: 本研究证明了在 Softmax Transformer 中，Attention Sinks（注意力汇聚点）在某些情况下是功能上必需的，而非仅仅是训练的副产品。研究人员通过一个具体的触发器条件任务，证明了概率归一化约束会导致注意力概率质量集中在固定位置，形成 Sink。与此相对，非归一化的 ReLU Attention 可以在不产生 Sink 的情况下完成相同任务。实验结果支持了这些理论发现，表明归一化是导致 Sink 行为的关键因素。
AI.keywords: Attention Sinks, Softmax Transformer, 触发器条件任务, 归一化, ReLU Attention
AI.comments: 这项研究为理解 Transformer 模型中的 Attention Sinks 提供了重要的理论基础，并指出了归一化在其中的关键作用。通过引入触发器条件任务和比较 Softmax 与 ReLU Attention，研究清晰地展示了 Sink 行为的成因及其可避免性。未来的工作可以探索如何在保持 Softmax 优势的同时减轻 Attention Sinks 的负面影响，或者研究其他类型的归一化或注意力机制。

title: Automating Skill Acquisition through Large-Scale Mining of Open-Source Agentic Repositories: A Framework for Multi-Agent Procedural Knowledge Extraction
summary: The transition from monolithic large language models (LLMs) to modular, skill-equipped agents represents a fundamental architectural shift in artificial intelligence deployment. While general-purpose models demonstrate remarkable breadth in declarative knowledge, their utility in autonomous workflows is frequently constrained by insufficient specialized procedural expertise. This report investigates a systematic framework for automated acquisition of high-quality agent skills through mining of open-source repositories on platforms such as GitHub. We focus on the extraction of visualization and educational capabilities from state-of-the-art systems including TheoremExplainAgent and Code2Video, both utilizing the Manim mathematical animation engine. The framework encompasses repository structural analysis, semantic skill identification through dense retrieval, and translation to the standardized SKILL.md format. We demonstrate that systematic extraction from agentic repositories, combined with rigorous security governance and multi-dimensional evaluation metrics, enables scalable acquisition of procedural knowledge that augments LLM capabilities without requiring model retraining. Our analysis reveals that agent-generated educational content can achieve 40\% gains in knowledge transfer efficiency while maintaining pedagogical quality comparable to human-crafted tutorials.

title: Towards heterogeneous parallelism for SPHinXsys
summary: Simulations based on particle methods, such as Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH), are known to be computationally demanding. While such methods have for long been executed in parallel on multi-core CPUs, in recent years the increasing adoption of many-core accelerators, such as GPUs. However, hardware fragmentation and vendor-specific programming interfaces are still characterizing their market. Hence, support for various hardware configurations may easily lead to non-trivial and less maintainable implementations. To leverage over some higher-level specifications have become available recently, such as the SYCL programming standard, this work highlights the initial effort in adopting the SYCL standard for the execution of SPHinXsys, an open-source multi-physics library. The result is an execution model able to run the same implementation on variable (heterogeneous) hardware, with considerable speed-up compared to the current multi-core CPU parallelization. Among others, representation of data-structures for parallel access, communication strategies, and parallel methods for data sorting will be topics discussed in depth. Benchmarks has also been presented, showcasing performance comparisons between the current multi-core CPU implementation and the newly introduced SYCL parallelization with a GPU back-end.

title: Alternating Gradient Flow Utility: A Unified Metric for Structural Pruning and Dynamic Routing in Deep Networks
summary: Efficient deep learning traditionally relies on static heuristics like weight magnitude or activation awareness (e.g., Wanda, RIA). While successful in unstructured settings, we observe a critical limitation when applying these metrics to the structural pruning of deep vision networks. These contemporary metrics suffer from a magnitude bias, failing to preserve critical functional pathways. To overcome this, we propose a decoupled kinetic paradigm inspired by Alternating Gradient Flow (AGF), utilizing an absolute feature-space Taylor expansion to accurately capture the network's structural "kinetic utility". First, we uncover a topological phase transition at extreme sparsity, where AGF successfully preserves baseline functionality and exhibits topological implicit regularization, avoiding the collapse seen in models trained from scratch. Second, transitioning to architectures without strict structural priors, we reveal a phenomenon of Sparsity Bottleneck in Vision Transformers (ViTs). Through a gradient-magnitude decoupling analysis, we discover that dynamic signals suffer from signal compression in converged models, rendering them suboptimal for real-time routing. Finally, driven by these empirical constraints, we design a hybrid routing framework that decouples AGF-guided offline structural search from online execution via zero-cost physical priors. We validate our paradigm on large-scale benchmarks: under a 75% compression stress test on ImageNet-1K, AGF effectively avoids the structural collapse where traditional metrics aggressively fall below random sampling. Furthermore, when systematically deployed for dynamic inference on ImageNet-100, our hybrid approach achieves Pareto-optimal efficiency. It reduces the usage of the heavy expert by approximately 50% (achieving an estimated overall cost of 0.92$\times$) without sacrificing the full-model accuracy.

title: Overcoming the Modality Gap in Context-Aided Forecasting
summary: Context-aided forecasting (CAF) holds promise for integrating domain knowledge and forward-looking information, enabling AI systems to surpass traditional statistical methods. However, recent empirical studies reveal a puzzling gap: multimodal models often fail to outperform their unimodal counterparts. We hypothesize that this underperformance stems from poor context quality in existing datasets, as verification is challenging. To address these limitations, we introduce a semi-synthetic data augmentation method that generates contexts both descriptive of temporal dynamics and verifiably complementary to numerical histories. This approach enables massive-scale dataset creation, resulting in CAF-7M, a corpus of 7 million context-augmented time series windows, including a rigorously verified test set. We demonstrate that semi-synthetic pre-training transfers effectively to real-world evaluation, and show clear evidence of context utilization. Our results suggest that dataset quality, rather than architectural limitations, has been the primary bottleneck in context-aided forecasting.

AI.title_translation: 克服情境辅助预测中的模态鸿沟
AI.tldr: 研究发现多模态模型在情境辅助预测中表现不佳，可能是因为数据集质量差。提出了一种生成半合成数据的方法来创建高质量数据集（CAF-7M），并通过实验证明该方法能有效提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态情境辅助预测模型（CAF）往往无法超越单模态模型，这被归因于现有数据集中情境质量差且难以验证。
AI.method: 提出了一种半合成数据增强方法，用于生成描述时间动态且可验证地补充数值历史的情境，从而创建大规模数据集CAF-7M。
AI.result: 通过在CAF-7M数据集上进行预训练，模型在真实世界评估中表现出有效的迁移学习能力，并明确利用了情境信息，证明了数据集质量是关键瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，情境辅助预测中的瓶颈在于数据集质量而非模型架构限制。
AI.translation: 情境辅助预测（CAF）有望整合领域知识和前瞻性信息，使人工智能系统超越传统统计方法。然而，最近的实证研究揭示了一个令人费解的差距：多模态模型通常无法超越其单模态对应物。我们假设这种表现不佳源于现有数据集中情境质量差，因为验证具有挑战性。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了一种半合成数据增强方法，该方法生成既能描述时间动态又能可验证地补充数值历史的情境。这种方法能够创建大规模数据集，从而产生了CAF-7M，一个包含700万个情境增强时间序列窗口的语料库，包括一个经过严格验证的测试集。我们证明了半合成预训练能够有效地迁移到现实世界的评估中，并清楚地表明了情境利用的证据。我们的结果表明，数据集质量，而不是架构限制，一直是情境辅助预测的主要瓶颈。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在解决情境辅助预测（CAF）中多模态模型表现不佳的问题，该问题被归因于现有数据集的情境质量低下。研究者提出了一种新颖的半合成数据增强方法，用于生成高质量、可验证的情境信息，并构建了一个包含700万个样本的大规模数据集CAF-7M。实验结果表明，使用该数据集进行预训练的模型在实际应用中表现出强大的迁移学习能力，并能有效利用情境信息。研究结论是，数据集质量是制约CAF模型性能的关键因素，而非模型架构本身。
AI.keywords: 情境辅助预测, 多模态模型, 数据增强, 数据集质量, 时间序列
AI.comments: 这项研究解决了情境辅助预测领域的一个重要问题，即多模态模型表现不佳的现象。通过提出一种创新的半合成数据增强方法和构建大规模数据集CAF-7M，研究不仅为该领域提供了宝贵的资源，而且有力地证明了数据集质量对于模型性能的关键作用。这项工作为未来开发更强大的情境辅助预测模型铺平了道路，但也可能引发关于数据生成方法的可推广性和在其他领域应用的研究。

title: Serving Hybrid LLM Loads with SLO Guarantees Using CPU-GPU Attention Piggybacking
summary:
Nowadays, service providers often deploy multiple types of LLM services within shared clusters. While the service colocation improves resource utilization, it introduces significant interference risks for latency-sensitive (LS) services-which have strict SLO requirements for inference latency-and severely constrain the service capacity of best-effort (BE) services due to limited available memory. To address interference, existing systems typically rely on reserving headroom to constrain BE resource usage. However, this approach's coarse granularity compromises the SLO compliance of the latency-sensitive service and unnecessarily restricts the generation potential of the best effort service.
  In this paper, we propose OmniServe, a novel LLM serving system that efficiently harnesses both CPU and GPU resources to mitigate interference and improve throughput. Central to OmniServe is the Attention Piggybacking mechanism, which effectively offloads the Attention computation of BE services to CPUs on the fly. This mechanism also facilitates asynchronous communication between CPU and GPU streams, preventing GPUs from being blocked while aggregating Attention results. Additionally, OmniServe incorporates a dynamic batching control policy to adapt to fluctuating request arrivals, facilitating Dense module computation using layer-wise batching. Experimental results show that OmniServe improves the SLO attainment rate for LS services by up to $1.48\times$ while enhancing BE serving throughput by up to $9.85\times$ compared to state-of-the-art systems.

title: Real-World AI Evaluation: How FRAME Generates Systematic Evidence to Resolve the Decision-Maker's Dilemma
summary: The rapid expansion of AI deployments has put organizational leaders in a decision maker's dilemma: they must govern these technologies without systematic evidence of how systems behave in their own environments. Predominant evaluation methods generate scalable, abstract measures of model capabilities but smooth over the heterogeneity of real world use, while user focused testing reveals rich contextual detail yet remains small in scale and loosely coupled to the mechanisms that shape model behavior. The Forum for Real World AI Measurement and Evaluation (FRAME) addresses this gap by combining large scale trials of AI systems with structured observation of how they are used in context, the outcomes they generate, and how those outcomes arise. By tracing the path from an AI system's output through its practical use and downstream effects, FRAME turns the heterogeneity of AI in use into a measurable signal rather than a trade off for achieving scale. FRAME establishes two core assets to accomplish this: a Testing Sandbox that captures AI use under real workflows at scale and a Metrics Hub that translates those traces into actionable indicators.

title: Enhanced Atrial Fibrillation Prediction in ESUS Patients with Hypergraph-based Pre-training
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a major complication following embolic stroke of undetermined source (ESUS), elevating the risk of recurrent stroke and mortality. Early identification is clinically important, yet existing tools face limitations in accuracy, scalability, and cost. Machine learning (ML) offers promise but is hindered by small ESUS cohorts and high-dimensional medical features. To address these challenges, we introduce supervised and unsupervised hypergraph-based pre-training strategies to improve AF prediction in ESUS patients. We first pre-train hypergraph-based patient embedding models on a large stroke cohort (7,780 patients) to capture salient features and higher-order interactions. The resulting embeddings are transferred to a smaller ESUS cohort (510 patients), reducing feature dimensionality while preserving clinically meaningful information, enabling effective prediction with lightweight models. Experiments show that both pre-training approaches outperform traditional models trained on raw data, improving accuracy and robustness. This framework offers a scalable and efficient solution for AF risk prediction after stroke.

title: Lipschitz-Based Robustness Certification Under Floating-Point Execution
summary:
Sensitivity-based robustness certification has emerged as a practical approach for certifying neural network robustness, including in settings that require verifiable guarantees. A key advantage of these methods is that certification is performed by concrete numerical computation (rather than symbolic reasoning) and scales efficiently with network size. However, as with the vast majority of prior work on robustness certification and verification, the soundness of these methods is typically proved with respect to a semantic model that assumes exact real arithmetic. In reality deployed neural network implementations execute using floating-point arithmetic. This mismatch creates a semantic gap between certified robustness properties and the behaviour of the executed system.
  As motivating evidence, we exhibit concrete counterexamples showing that real arithmetic robustness guarantees can fail under floating-point execution, even for previously verified certifiers, with discrepancies becoming pronounced at lower-precision formats such as float16. We then develop a formal, compositional theory relating real arithmetic Lipschitz-based sensitivity bounds to the sensitivity of floating-point execution under standard rounding-error models, specialised to feed-forward neural networks with ReLU activations. We derive sound conditions for robustness under floating-point execution, including bounds on certificate degradation and sufficient conditions for the absence of overflow. We formalize the theory and its main soundness results, and implement an executable certifier based on these principles, which we empirically evaluate to demonstrate its practicality.

title: AgriPath: A Systematic Exploration of Architectural Trade-offs for Crop Disease Classification
comments: 11 pages main text, 22 pages total including references and appendix. 6 figures, 10 tables. Code and dataset will be released upon publication
summary: Reliable crop disease detection requires models that perform consistently across diverse acquisition conditions, yet existing evaluations often focus on single architectural families or lab-generated datasets. This work presents a systematic empirical comparison of three model paradigms for fine-grained crop disease classification: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), contrastive Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and generative VLMs. To enable controlled analysis of domain effects, we introduce AgriPath-LF16, a benchmark containing 111k images spanning 16 crops and 41 diseases with explicit separation between laboratory and field imagery, alongside a balanced 30k subset for standardized training and evaluation. All models are trained and evaluated under unified protocols across full, lab-only, and field-only training regimes using macro-F1 and Parse Success Rate (PSR) to account for generative reliability. The results reveal distinct performance profiles. CNNs achieve the highest accuracy on lab imagery but degrade under domain shift. Contrastive VLMs provide a robust and parameter-efficient alternative with competitive cross-domain performance. Generative VLMs demonstrate the strongest resilience to distributional variation, albeit with additional failure modes stemming from free-text generation. These findings highlight that architectural choice should be guided by deployment context rather than aggregate accuracy alone.
comment: 11 pages main text, 22 pages total including references and appendix. 6 figures, 10 tables. Code and dataset will be released upon publication

title: TennisExpert: Towards Expert-Level Analytical Sports Video Understanding
summary: Tennis is one of the most widely followed sports, generating extensive broadcast footage with strong potential for professional analysis, automated coaching, and real-time commentary. However, automatic tennis understanding remains underexplored due to two key challenges: (1) the lack of large-scale benchmarks with fine-grained annotations and expert-level commentary, and (2) the difficulty of building accurate yet efficient multimodal systems suitable for real-time deployment. To address these challenges, we introduce TennisVL, a large-scale tennis benchmark comprising over 200 professional matches (471.9 hours) and 40,000+ rally-level clips. Unlike existing commentary datasets that focus on descriptive play-by-play narration, TennisVL emphasizes expert analytical commentary capturing tactical reasoning, player decisions, and match momentum. Furthermore, we propose TennisExpert, a multimodal tennis understanding framework that integrates a video semantic parser with a memory-augmented model built on Qwen3-VL-8B. The parser extracts key match elements (e.g., scores, shot sequences, ball bounces, and player locations), while hierarchical memory modules capture both short- and long-term temporal context. Experiments show that TennisExpert consistently outperforms strong proprietary baselines, including GPT-5, Gemini, and Claude, and demonstrates improved ability to capture tactical context and match dynamics. Our dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/LZYAndy/TennisExpert.

title: LibraGen: Playing a Balance Game in Subject-Driven Video Generation
summary: With the advancement of video generation foundation models (VGFMs), customized generation, particularly subject-to-video (S2V), has attracted growing attention.
